/-
Author: @toskua
-/
module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Group.HaarL2.CharacterMultiplierContinuous
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalAction.RegularCoefficientAlgebra

/-!
# The original character conjugation equations on Haar L2

Connes's actual positive character multipliers fix the original coefficient
operators and multiply the original Haar left implementer by chi(g).
These are the exact generator equations needed by the later restricted
normal dual action; its invariance, normality and predual orbit fields remain
separate construction prerequisites.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open MeasureTheory MeasureTheory.HaarL2 Filter
open scoped ENNReal Topology InnerProductSpace CStarAlgebra

namespace VonNeumannAlgebra
namespace NormalAction

noncomputable section

universe uG uH

variable {G : Type uG} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
  [LocallyCompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
variable {H : Type uH} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
variable {M : VonNeumannAlgebra H}
variable (μ : Measure G) [μ.Regular]

/-- Actual positive-character conjugation fixes every original regular coefficient operator. -/
theorem characterMultiplier_fix_regularCoefficient (α : NormalAction G M)
    (χ : PontryaginDual G) (x : M) :
    (characterMultiplierUnitary (H := H) μ χ : Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) *
      regularCoefficient μ α x * star (characterMultiplierUnitary (H := H) μ χ :
        Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) = regularCoefficient μ α x := by
  have hstar : star (characterMultiplierUnitary (H := H) μ χ : Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) =
      (characterMultiplierUnitary (H := H) μ χ⁻¹ : Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) :=
    congrArg (fun U : unitary (Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) => U.val)
      ((characterMultiplierUnitaryHom (H := H) μ).map_inv χ).symm
  rw [hstar]
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro ξ
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [characterMultiplier_ae_eq μ χ
      (regularCoefficient μ α x (characterMultiplier μ χ⁻¹ ξ)),
    regularCoefficient_ae_eq μ α x (characterMultiplier μ χ⁻¹ ξ),
    characterMultiplier_ae_eq μ χ⁻¹ ξ, regularCoefficient_ae_eq μ α x ξ] with s h₁ h₂ h₃ h₄
  change characterMultiplier (H := H) μ χ
    (regularCoefficient μ α x (characterMultiplier μ χ⁻¹ ξ)) s = regularCoefficient μ α x ξ s
  rw [h₁, h₂, h₃, h₄, map_smul, ← mul_smul]
  have hchar : ((χ s : Circle) : ℂ) * ((χ⁻¹ s : Circle) : ℂ) = 1 := by
    change ((χ s : Circle) : ℂ) * (((χ s)⁻¹ : Circle) : ℂ) = 1
    rw [← Circle.coe_mul, mul_inv_cancel, Circle.coe_one]
  rw [hchar, one_smul]

variable [μ.IsHaarMeasure]

/-- Actual positive-character conjugation gives Connes's exact chi(g) scaling of the Haar left implementer. -/
theorem characterMultiplier_scale_haarLeftRegular (χ : PontryaginDual G) (g : G) :
    (characterMultiplierUnitary (H := H) μ χ : Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) *
      (StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.haarLeftRegular G μ H g :
        Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) *
      star (characterMultiplierUnitary (H := H) μ χ : Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) =
        ((χ g : Circle) : ℂ) •
          (StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.haarLeftRegular G μ H g :
            Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) := by
  have hstar : star (characterMultiplierUnitary (H := H) μ χ : Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) =
      (characterMultiplierUnitary (H := H) μ χ⁻¹ : Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) :=
    congrArg (fun U : unitary (Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) => U.val)
      ((characterMultiplierUnitaryHom (H := H) μ).map_inv χ).symm
  rw [hstar]
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro ξ
  apply Lp.ext
  let L : Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ :=
    StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.haarLeftRegular G μ H g
  have houter := characterMultiplier_ae_eq μ χ (L (characterMultiplier μ χ⁻¹ ξ))
  have hleft := StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.haarLeftRegular_ae_eq G μ H g
    (characterMultiplier μ χ⁻¹ ξ)
  have hinner := characterMultiplier_ae_eq μ χ⁻¹ ξ
  have hpres : MeasurePreserving (fun s : G => g⁻¹ * s) μ μ := measurePreserving_smul g⁻¹ μ
  have hquasi : QuasiMeasurePreserving (fun s : G => g⁻¹ * s) μ μ :=
    ⟨hpres.measurable, by rw [hpres.map_eq]⟩
  have hinner' := hquasi.ae_eq_comp hinner
  filter_upwards [houter, hleft, hinner', Lp.coeFn_smul (((χ g : Circle) : ℂ)) (L ξ),
    StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.haarLeftRegular_ae_eq G μ H g ξ] with s h₁ h₂ h₃ h₄ h₅
  change characterMultiplier (H := H) μ χ (L (characterMultiplier μ χ⁻¹ ξ)) s =
    (((χ g : Circle) : ℂ) • L ξ) s
  simp only [Function.comp_apply] at h₃
  rw [h₁, h₂, h₃, h₄]
  change ((χ s : Circle) : ℂ) • (((χ⁻¹ (g⁻¹ * s) : Circle) : ℂ) • ξ (g⁻¹ * s)) =
    ((χ g : Circle) : ℂ) • L ξ s
  rw [h₅, ← mul_smul]
  have hchar : ((χ s : Circle) : ℂ) * ((χ⁻¹ (g⁻¹ * s) : Circle) : ℂ) =
      ((χ g : Circle) : ℂ) := by
    have hcircle : χ s * χ⁻¹ (g⁻¹ * s) = χ g := by
      change χ s * (χ (g⁻¹ * s))⁻¹ = χ g
      rw [map_mul, map_inv, mul_inv_rev, inv_inv, ← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel, one_mul]
    simpa only [Circle.coe_mul] using congrArg (fun z : Circle => (z : ℂ)) hcircle
  rw [hchar]

end

end NormalAction
end VonNeumannAlgebra

/-
Author: @toskua
-/
module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalAction.TensorCoefficient
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalAction.CoefficientNormality
public import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Function.LpSeminorm.Indicator
public import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Measure.OpenPos
public import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Measure.Typeclasses.Finite
public import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Measure.Restrict

/-!
# Faithfulness of the original Haar coefficient representation

The actual indicator of a measurable finite-Haar neighborhood, multiplied by
an original Hilbert vector, is an actual Lp H 2 vector. If an original coefficient
operator vanishes, its exact a.e. formula makes the continuous inverse-action
vector orbit vanish on that open neighborhood. Haar full support promotes the
a.e. equality to the original pointwise equality, including at the identity.

This supplies injectivity needed by the original normal faithful coefficient
inclusion and source crossed-product constructor. The exact H-first tensor
coefficient inherits it through the already proved original unitary coordinates.
Normality and membership in the spatial ambient remain separate prerequisites.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open MeasureTheory Filter
open scoped ENNReal Topology TensorProduct InnerProductSpace CStarAlgebra

namespace VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalAction

noncomputable section

universe uG uH

variable {G : Type uG} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
  [LocallyCompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
variable {H : Type uH} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
variable {M : VonNeumannAlgebra H}
variable (μ : Measure G) [μ.IsHaarMeasure] [μ.Regular]

/-- The actual original regular coefficient star representation on Haar Lp is injective. -/
theorem regularCoefficient_injective (α : NormalAction G M) :
    Function.Injective (regularCoefficientHom μ α) := by
  classical
  have hzero (x : M) (hx : regularCoefficientHom μ α x = 0) : x = 0 := by
    change regularCoefficient μ α x = 0 at hx
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
    intro v
    change (x : H →L[ℂ] H) v = 0
    obtain ⟨V, hVone, hVopen, hVfinite⟩ := μ.exists_isOpen_measure_lt_top (1 : G)
    have hVmeas : MeasurableSet V := hVopen.measurableSet
    have hMem : MemLp (V.indicator fun _ : G => v) 2 μ :=
      memLp_indicator_const 2 hVmeas.nullMeasurableSet v (Or.inr hVfinite.ne)
    let ξ : Lp H 2 μ := hMem.toLp (V.indicator fun _ : G => v)
    have hξ : (ξ : G → H) =ᵐ[μ] V.indicator (fun _ : G => v) := hMem.coeFn_toLp
    let F : G → H := fun s => (α s⁻¹ x : H →L[ℂ] H) v
    have hF : Continuous F := (continuous_vector_apply α x v).comp continuous_inv
    have hCoeff := regularCoefficient_ae_eq μ α x ξ
    rw [hx] at hCoeff
    have hAE : ∀ᵐ s ∂μ, s ∈ V → F s = 0 := by
      filter_upwards [hCoeff, hξ, Lp.coeFn_zero H 2 μ] with s hsCoeff hsξ hsZero
      intro hsV
      have hξv : ξ s = v := by
        rw [hsξ]
        exact Set.indicator_of_mem hsV (fun _ : G => v)
      change (α s⁻¹ x : H →L[ℂ] H) v = 0
      exact (congrArg (fun w : H => (α s⁻¹ x : H →L[ℂ] H) w) hξv).symm.trans
        (hsCoeff.symm.trans hsZero)
    have hAEV : F =ᵐ[μ.restrict V] (fun _ : G => (0 : H)) :=
      (ae_restrict_iff' hVmeas).2 hAE
    have hZeroContinuous : Continuous (fun _ : G => (0 : H)) := continuous_const
    have hEq := Measure.eqOn_open_of_ae_eq (μ := μ) hAEV hVopen
      hF.continuousOn hZeroContinuous.continuousOn
    have hOne : F (1 : G) = 0 := hEq hVone
    have hFone : F (1 : G) = (x : H →L[ℂ] H) v := by
      dsimp only [F]
      simp only [inv_one, map_one, NormalStarAlgEquiv.one_apply]
    exact hFone.symm.trans hOne
  intro x y hxy
  have hmap : regularCoefficientHom μ α (x - y) = 0 := by
    rw [map_sub, hxy, sub_self]
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp (hzero (x - y) hmap)

/-- The exact original H-first tensor coefficient representation is injective through the verified coordinates. -/
theorem regularCoefficientTensor_injective (α : NormalAction G M) :
    Function.Injective (regularCoefficientTensorHom μ α) := by
  let Φ := L2.tensorToLpRight (𝕜 := ℂ) (H := H) μ
  intro x y hxy
  apply regularCoefficient_injective μ α
  have hConj : Φ.symm.conjStarAlgEquiv (regularCoefficientHom μ α x) =
      Φ.symm.conjStarAlgEquiv (regularCoefficientHom μ α y) := hxy
  exact Φ.symm.conjStarAlgEquiv.injective hConj

/-- The literal original spatial normal coefficient homomorphism is faithful. -/
theorem regularCoefficientSpatialNormalHom_injective (α : NormalAction G M) :
    Function.Injective (regularCoefficientSpatialNormalHom μ α) := by
  intro x y hxy
  apply regularCoefficientTensor_injective μ α
  exact congrArg (fun z : spatialTensorProduct M (⊤ : VonNeumannAlgebra (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) =>
    (z : UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) →L[ℂ]
      UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)))) hxy

end

end VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalAction

/-
Author: @toskua
-/
module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalHom.VectorFunctionalCriterion
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalAction.RegularCoefficientAlgebra
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalAction.SpatialCoefficient
public import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Integral.Bochner.ContinuousLinearMap
public import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Function.LpSpace.Indicator

/-!
# Normality of the actual original regular coefficient maps

For original compact-support vector pairs, the inverse predual orbit of
their literal vector functional has compact support and a Bochner integral
in the actual closed predual. Evaluation gives the original regular
coefficient functional. Norm closure and actual L2 density extend this to
all pairs. The original H-first tensor isometry transports the same vector
coefficients into the proved spatial subtype without a same-space unitary
assumption. The stronger Connes M tensor LInfinity target remains separate.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open MeasureTheory Filter
open MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra
open scoped ENNReal Topology CompactlySupported TensorProduct InnerProductSpace CStarAlgebra

namespace VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalAction

noncomputable section

universe uG uH

variable {G : Type uG} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
  [LocallyCompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
variable {H : Type uH} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
variable {M : VonNeumannAlgebra H}
variable (μ : Measure G) [μ.Regular]

/-- The original compact-support vector coefficient is an actual normal functional by its predual integral. -/
theorem regularCoefficient_compactVectorFunctional_mem_normalFunctionalSpace [μ.IsHaarMeasure]
    (α : NormalAction G M) (f g : C_c(G, H)) :
    representationCoefficient (regularCoefficientHom μ α)
      (MeasureTheory.HaarL2.compactSupportInclusion μ g)
      (MeasureTheory.HaarL2.compactSupportInclusion μ f) ∈ normalFunctionalSpace M := by
  let j₀ : M →ₗ[ℂ] (H →L[ℂ] H) := LinearMap.ofClass M.toStarSubalgebra.subtype
  let j : M →L[ℂ] (H →L[ℂ] H) := j₀.mkContinuous 1 (by
    intro x
    change ‖(x : H →L[ℂ] H)‖ ≤ 1 * ‖x‖
    rw [one_mul]
    exact le_rfl)
  let Ev : H →L[ℂ] (H →L[ℂ] H) →L[ℂ] H := ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℂ H
  let J : H →L[ℂ] M →L[ℂ] H := (Ev.flip.comp j).flip
  let V : H →L⋆[ℂ] H →L[ℂ] StrongDual ℂ M :=
    ContinuousLinearMap.bilinearComp (ContinuousLinearMap.compL ℂ M H ℂ) (innerSL ℂ) J
  have hj (x : M) : j x = (x : H →L[ℂ] H) := by
    dsimp only [j]
    rw [LinearMap.mkContinuous_apply]
    rfl
  have hEv (a : H) (T : H →L[ℂ] H) : Ev a T = T a :=
    ContinuousLinearMap.apply_apply a T
  have hJ (a : H) (x : M) : J a x = (j x) a := by
    dsimp only [J]
    rw [ContinuousLinearMap.flip_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.flip_apply]
    exact hEv a (j x)
  have hEval (a b : H) (x : M) : V a b x = inner ℂ a ((x : H →L[ℂ] H) b) := by
    calc
      V a b x = innerSL ℂ a (J b x) := by
        simp only [V, ContinuousLinearMap.bilinearComp_apply,
          ContinuousLinearMap.compL_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply]
      _ = inner ℂ a ((j x) b) := by rw [hJ, innerSL_apply_apply]
      _ = inner ℂ a ((x : H →L[ℂ] H) b) := by rw [hj]
  have hV (a b : H) : V a b = vectorFunctional M a b := by
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
    intro x
    exact (hEval a b x).trans (vectorFunctional_apply M a b x).symm
  have hpredual (s : G) (φ : normalFunctionalSpace M) : ‖α.predualAction s φ‖ ≤ ‖φ‖ := by
    change ‖(α.predualAction s φ : StrongDual ℂ M)‖ ≤ ‖φ‖
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (norm_nonneg φ)
    intro x
    rw [predualAction_apply]
    calc
      ‖(φ : StrongDual ℂ M) ((α s).symm x)‖ ≤ ‖φ‖ * ‖(α s).symm x‖ :=
        (φ : StrongDual ℂ M).le_opNorm ((α s).symm x)
      _ ≤ ‖φ‖ * ‖x‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (NonUnitalStarAlgHom.norm_apply_le (α s).symm.toNormalStarAlgHom.toStarAlgHom x)
        (norm_nonneg φ)
  let φ (s : G) : normalFunctionalSpace M :=
    ⟨V (f s) (g s), by rw [hV]; exact vectorFunctional_mem_normalFunctionalSpace M (f s) (g s)⟩
  let F (s : G) : normalFunctionalSpace M := α.predualAction s (φ s)
  have hφ : Continuous φ := by
    exact Continuous.subtype_mk
      ((V.continuous.comp (map_continuous f)).clm_apply (map_continuous g)) _
  have hF : Continuous F := by
    rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
    intro s₀
    apply tendsto_iff_norm_sub_tendsto_zero.mpr
    have hfirst : Tendsto (fun s => ‖φ s - φ s₀‖) (𝓝 s₀) (𝓝 0) := by
      have hc : Continuous (fun s : G => ‖φ s - φ s₀‖) := by
        simpa only [Pi.sub_apply] using
          (hφ.sub (continuous_const : Continuous (fun _ : G => φ s₀))).norm
      simpa only [sub_self, norm_zero] using hc.tendsto s₀
    have hsecond : Tendsto (fun s => ‖α.predualAction s (φ s₀) - α.predualAction s₀ (φ s₀)‖)
        (𝓝 s₀) (𝓝 0) := by
      have hc : Continuous (fun s : G => ‖α.predualAction s (φ s₀) - α.predualAction s₀ (φ s₀)‖) := by
        simpa only [Pi.sub_apply] using
          ((α.predualAction_continuous (φ s₀)).sub
            (continuous_const : Continuous (fun _ : G => α.predualAction s₀ (φ s₀)))).norm
      simpa only [sub_self, norm_zero] using hc.tendsto s₀
    have hbound (s : G) : ‖F s - F s₀‖ ≤
        ‖φ s - φ s₀‖ + ‖α.predualAction s (φ s₀) - α.predualAction s₀ (φ s₀)‖ := by
      calc
        ‖F s - F s₀‖ =
            ‖α.predualAction s (φ s - φ s₀) +
              (α.predualAction s (φ s₀) - α.predualAction s₀ (φ s₀))‖ := by
          rw [map_sub, sub_add_sub_cancel]
        _ ≤ ‖α.predualAction s (φ s - φ s₀)‖ +
            ‖α.predualAction s (φ s₀) - α.predualAction s₀ (φ s₀)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        _ ≤ ‖φ s - φ s₀‖ + ‖α.predualAction s (φ s₀) - α.predualAction s₀ (φ s₀)‖ :=
          add_le_add (hpredual s (φ s - φ s₀)) le_rfl
    exact squeeze_zero (fun s => norm_nonneg (F s - F s₀)) hbound
      (by simpa only [zero_add] using hfirst.add hsecond)
  have hFc : HasCompactSupport F := by
    refine HasCompactSupport.intro f.hasCompactSupport ?_
    intro s hs
    have hf : f s = 0 := image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hs
    have hφzero : φ s = 0 := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
      intro x
      change V (f s) (g s) x = 0
      rw [hV, vectorFunctional_apply, hf, inner_zero_left]
    change α.predualAction s (φ s) = 0
    rw [hφzero, map_zero]
  let _ : NormedSpace ℝ (normalFunctionalSpace M) :=
    NormedSpace.restrictScalars ℝ ℂ (normalFunctionalSpace M)
  have hFLp : MemLp F 1 μ := hF.memLp_of_hasCompactSupport hFc
  have hFI : Integrable F μ := memLp_one_iff_integrable.mp hFLp
  let I : normalFunctionalSpace M := ∫ s, F s ∂μ
  have hI (x : M) : (I : StrongDual ℂ M) x =
      ∫ s, inner ℂ (f s) ((α s⁻¹ x : H →L[ℂ] H) (g s)) ∂μ := by
    change normalFunctionalEvaluation M x I = _
    rw [← (normalFunctionalEvaluation M x).integral_comp_comm hFI]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun s => by
      change normalFunctionalEvaluation M x (F s) =
        inner ℂ (f s) ((α s⁻¹ x : H →L[ℂ] H) (g s))
      calc
        normalFunctionalEvaluation M x (F s) = (F s : StrongDual ℂ M) x :=
          normalFunctionalEvaluation_apply M x (F s)
        _ = (φ s : StrongDual ℂ M) ((α s).symm x) := predualAction_apply α s (φ s) x
        _ = V (f s) (g s) ((α s).symm x) := rfl
        _ = inner ℂ (f s) (((α s).symm x : H →L[ℂ] H) (g s)) := hEval (f s) (g s) ((α s).symm x)
        _ = inner ℂ (f s) ((α s⁻¹ x : H →L[ℂ] H) (g s)) := by rw [map_inv]; rfl
  let r := regularCoefficientHom μ α
  have hrep (x : M) :
      representationCoefficient r (MeasureTheory.HaarL2.compactSupportInclusion μ g)
          (MeasureTheory.HaarL2.compactSupportInclusion μ f) x =
        ∫ s, inner ℂ (f s) ((α s⁻¹ x : H →L[ℂ] H) (g s)) ∂μ := by
    calc
      representationCoefficient r (MeasureTheory.HaarL2.compactSupportInclusion μ g)
          (MeasureTheory.HaarL2.compactSupportInclusion μ f) x =
          inner ℂ (MeasureTheory.HaarL2.compactSupportInclusion μ f)
            (r x (MeasureTheory.HaarL2.compactSupportInclusion μ g)) :=
        representationCoefficient_apply r (MeasureTheory.HaarL2.compactSupportInclusion μ g)
          (MeasureTheory.HaarL2.compactSupportInclusion μ f) x
      _ = ∫ s, inner ℂ (MeasureTheory.HaarL2.compactSupportInclusion μ f s)
          (regularCoefficient μ α x (MeasureTheory.HaarL2.compactSupportInclusion μ g) s) ∂μ := by
        exact L2.inner_def (MeasureTheory.HaarL2.compactSupportInclusion μ f)
          (regularCoefficient μ α x (MeasureTheory.HaarL2.compactSupportInclusion μ g))
      _ = ∫ s, inner ℂ (f s) ((α s⁻¹ x : H →L[ℂ] H) (g s)) ∂μ := by
        apply integral_congr_ae
        filter_upwards [MeasureTheory.HaarL2.compactSupportInclusion_ae_eq μ f,
          regularCoefficient_ae_eq μ α x (MeasureTheory.HaarL2.compactSupportInclusion μ g),
          MeasureTheory.HaarL2.compactSupportInclusion_ae_eq μ g] with s hf hx hg
        rw [hf, hx, hg]
  have hEq : (I : StrongDual ℂ M) =
      representationCoefficient r (MeasureTheory.HaarL2.compactSupportInclusion μ g)
        (MeasureTheory.HaarL2.compactSupportInclusion μ f) := by
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
    intro x
    exact (hI x).trans (hrep x).symm
  rw [← hEq]
  exact I.property

/-- Every actual regular coefficient vector pullback lies in the original complete normal-functional space. -/
theorem regularCoefficient_vectorFunctional_mem_normalFunctionalSpace [μ.IsHaarMeasure]
    (α : NormalAction G M) (ξ η : Lp H 2 μ) :
    representationCoefficient (regularCoefficientHom μ α) η ξ ∈ normalFunctionalSpace M := by
  let r := regularCoefficientHom μ α
  let jr : M →L[ℂ] (Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) := ⟨r.toLinearMap, map_continuous r⟩
  let Evr : Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] (Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ :=
    ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℂ (Lp H 2 μ)
  let Jr : Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] M →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ := (Evr.flip.comp jr).flip
  let Vr : Lp H 2 μ →L⋆[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] StrongDual ℂ M :=
    ContinuousLinearMap.bilinearComp (ContinuousLinearMap.compL ℂ M (Lp H 2 μ) ℂ) (innerSL ℂ) Jr
  have hjr (x : M) : jr x = r x := rfl
  have hEvr (a : Lp H 2 μ) (T : Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) : Evr a T = T a :=
    ContinuousLinearMap.apply_apply a T
  have hJr (a : Lp H 2 μ) (x : M) : Jr a x = (jr x) a := by
    dsimp only [Jr]
    rw [ContinuousLinearMap.flip_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.flip_apply]
    exact hEvr a (jr x)
  have hEvalr (a b : Lp H 2 μ) (x : M) : Vr a b x = inner ℂ a ((r x) b) := by
    calc
      Vr a b x = innerSL ℂ a (Jr b x) := by
        simp only [Vr, ContinuousLinearMap.bilinearComp_apply,
          ContinuousLinearMap.compL_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply]
      _ = inner ℂ a ((jr x) b) := by rw [hJr, innerSL_apply_apply]
      _ = inner ℂ a ((r x) b) := by rw [hjr]
  have hVr (a b : Lp H 2 μ) : Vr a b = representationCoefficient r b a := by
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
    intro x
    exact (hEvalr a b x).trans (representationCoefficient_apply r b a x).symm
  have hcompact (f g : C_c(G, H)) :
      Vr (MeasureTheory.HaarL2.compactSupportInclusion μ f)
        (MeasureTheory.HaarL2.compactSupportInclusion μ g) ∈ normalFunctionalSpace M := by
    rw [hVr]
    exact regularCoefficient_compactVectorFunctional_mem_normalFunctionalSpace μ α f g
  have hall (a b : Lp H 2 μ) : Vr a b ∈ normalFunctionalSpace M := by
    refine (MeasureTheory.HaarL2.denseRange_compactSupportInclusion (H := H) μ).induction_on a
      ((normalFunctionalSpace_isClosed M).preimage (Vr.flip b).continuous) ?_
    intro f
    refine (MeasureTheory.HaarL2.denseRange_compactSupportInclusion (H := H) μ).induction_on b
      ((normalFunctionalSpace_isClosed M).preimage
        (Vr (MeasureTheory.HaarL2.compactSupportInclusion μ f)).continuous) ?_
    intro g
    exact hcompact f g
  rw [← hVr]
  exact hall ξ η

/-- The original Lp coefficient representation is an actual normal star homomorphism into all operators. -/
def regularCoefficientNormalHom [μ.IsHaarMeasure] (α : NormalAction G M) :
    NormalStarAlgHom M (⊤ : VonNeumannAlgebra (Lp H 2 μ)) := by
  let r := regularCoefficientHom μ α
  let f : M →⋆ₐ[ℂ] (⊤ : VonNeumannAlgebra (Lp H 2 μ)) :=
    { toFun x := ⟨r x, by
        change r x ∈ (⊤ : StarSubalgebra ℂ (Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ))
        trivial⟩
      map_one' := by apply Subtype.ext; exact map_one r
      map_mul' x y := by apply Subtype.ext; exact map_mul r x y
      map_zero' := by apply Subtype.ext; exact map_zero r
      map_add' x y := by apply Subtype.ext; exact map_add r x y
      commutes' c := by apply Subtype.ext; exact r.commutes c
      map_star' x := by apply Subtype.ext; exact map_star r x }
  refine NormalStarAlgHom.ofVectorFunctionalPullbacks f ?_
  intro ξ η
  have hEq : (vectorFunctional (⊤ : VonNeumannAlgebra (Lp H 2 μ)) ξ η).comp
      (⟨LinearMap.ofClass f, map_continuous f⟩ : M →L[ℂ] (⊤ : VonNeumannAlgebra (Lp H 2 μ))) =
      representationCoefficient r η ξ := by
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
    intro x
    rw [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, vectorFunctional_apply, representationCoefficient_apply]
    rfl
  rw [hEq]
  exact regularCoefficient_vectorFunctional_mem_normalFunctionalSpace μ α ξ η

/-- The same original H-first spatial subtype coefficient map carries its proved normality. -/
def regularCoefficientSpatialNormalHom [μ.IsHaarMeasure] (α : NormalAction G M) :
    NormalStarAlgHom M (spatialTensorProduct M (⊤ : VonNeumannAlgebra (Lp ℂ 2 μ))) := by
  let E := L2.tensorToLpRight (𝕜 := ℂ) (H := H) μ
  let f := regularCoefficientSpatialHom μ α
  let r := regularCoefficientHom μ α
  let t := regularCoefficientTensorHom μ α
  have hE (x : M) (z : UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ))) :
      E (t x z) = r x (E z) := by
    change E (E.symm (regularCoefficient μ α x (E z))) = _
    exact E.apply_symm_apply _
  have hfvalue (x : M) :
      (f x : UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) →L[ℂ]
        UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ))) = t x := by
    change regularCoefficientTensor μ α x = regularCoefficientTensorHom μ α x
    exact (regularCoefficientTensorHom_apply μ α x).symm
  refine NormalStarAlgHom.ofVectorFunctionalPullbacks f ?_
  intro ξ η
  have hEq : (vectorFunctional
        (spatialTensorProduct M (⊤ : VonNeumannAlgebra (Lp ℂ 2 μ))) ξ η).comp
      (⟨LinearMap.ofClass f, map_continuous f⟩ :
        M →L[ℂ] spatialTensorProduct M (⊤ : VonNeumannAlgebra (Lp ℂ 2 μ))) =
      representationCoefficient t η ξ := by
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
    intro x
    calc
      _ = vectorFunctional
          (spatialTensorProduct M (⊤ : VonNeumannAlgebra (Lp ℂ 2 μ))) ξ η (f x) := rfl
      _ = inner ℂ ξ ((f x : UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) →L[ℂ]
          UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ))) η) :=
        vectorFunctional_apply (spatialTensorProduct M (⊤ : VonNeumannAlgebra (Lp ℂ 2 μ))) ξ η (f x)
      _ = inner ℂ ξ ((t x) η) :=
        congrArg (fun C : UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) →L[ℂ]
          UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) => inner ℂ ξ (C η)) (hfvalue x)
      _ = representationCoefficient t η ξ x := (representationCoefficient_apply t η ξ x).symm
  have htransport := representationCoefficient_unitaryIntertwiner t r E hE η ξ
  rw [hEq, ← htransport]
  exact regularCoefficient_vectorFunctional_mem_normalFunctionalSpace μ α (E ξ) (E η)

end

end VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalAction

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalAction
public import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Operator.Bilinear
public import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Group.Continuity
public import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Adjoint
public import Mathlib.Analysis.Real.Sqrt

/-!
# The continuous vector action of an actual normal predual action

Norm continuity of each original inverse predual orbit gives continuity of
every normal scalar functional on the primal orbit. The actual vector
functionals and the adjoint squared-norm identity then give norm continuity
of every vector orbit. The constant automorphism norm bound gives the mixed
group/vector continuity needed by the regular Haar coefficient operator.

The group need only be a topological group and the Hilbert space is arbitrary.
The full locally compact Connes/Takesaki continuity equivalence is separate.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open Filter
open scoped Topology InnerProductSpace CStarAlgebra

namespace VonNeumannAlgebra
namespace NormalAction

universe uG uH

variable {G : Type uG} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
variable {H : Type uH} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
variable {M : VonNeumannAlgebra H}

/-- Every actual normal functional is continuous on the original forward algebra orbit. -/
theorem continuous_normalFunctional_apply (α : NormalAction G M)
    (φ : normalFunctionalSpace M) (x : M) :
    Continuous fun g : G => (φ : StrongDual ℂ M) (α g x) := by
  have h := (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℂ ℂ x).continuous.comp
    (continuous_subtype_val.comp ((α.predualAction_continuous φ).comp continuous_inv))
  have heq :
      (fun g : G => (α.predualAction g⁻¹ φ : StrongDual ℂ M) x) =
        (fun g : G => (φ : StrongDual ℂ M) (α g x)) := by
    funext g
    rw [predualAction_apply, map_inv]
    change (φ : StrongDual ℂ M) ((α g).symm.symm x) = (φ : StrongDual ℂ M) (α g x)
    rw [NormalStarAlgEquiv.symm_symm]
  change Continuous (fun g : G => (α.predualAction g⁻¹ φ : StrongDual ℂ M) x) at h
  rw [heq] at h
  exact h

/-- Every original algebra element acts norm continuously on each fixed Hilbert vector. -/
theorem continuous_vector_apply (α : NormalAction G M) (x : M) (ξ : H) :
    Continuous fun g : G => (α g x : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ := by
  let F : G → H := fun g => (α g x : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ
  change Continuous F
  rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
  intro g₀
  change Tendsto F (𝓝 g₀) (𝓝 (F g₀))
  apply tendsto_iff_norm_sub_tendsto_zero.mpr
  let w : H := F g₀
  let φ₁ : normalFunctionalSpace M :=
    ⟨vectorFunctional M ξ ξ, vectorFunctional_mem_normalFunctionalSpace M ξ ξ⟩
  let φ₂ : normalFunctionalSpace M :=
    ⟨vectorFunctional M w ξ, vectorFunctional_mem_normalFunctionalSpace M w ξ⟩
  have hdiag (g : G) :
      ((φ₁ : StrongDual ℂ M) (α g (star x * x))).re = ‖F g‖ ^ 2 := by
    change (vectorFunctional M ξ ξ (α g (star x * x))).re = ‖F g‖ ^ 2
    rw [map_mul, map_star, vectorFunctional_apply]
    change (⟪ξ, ((ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (α g x : H →L[ℂ] H)) ∘L
        (α g x : H →L[ℂ] H)) ξ⟫_ℂ).re = ‖(α g x : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ‖ ^ 2
    exact (ContinuousLinearMap.apply_norm_sq_eq_inner_adjoint_right
      (α g x : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ).symm
  have hcross (g : G) :
      ((φ₂ : StrongDual ℂ M) (α g x)).re = (⟪F g, w⟫_ℂ).re := by
    change (vectorFunctional M w ξ (α g x)).re = (⟪F g, w⟫_ℂ).re
    rw [vectorFunctional_apply]
    exact inner_re_symm (𝕜 := ℂ) w (F g)
  have heq :
      (fun g : G => ‖F g - w‖ ^ 2) =
        (fun g : G => ((φ₁ : StrongDual ℂ M) (α g (star x * x))).re -
          2 * ((φ₂ : StrongDual ℂ M) (α g x)).re + ‖w‖ ^ 2) := by
    funext g
    rw [norm_sub_sq (𝕜 := ℂ), RCLike.re_eq_complex_re, hdiag g, hcross g]
  have hsquare : Continuous fun g : G => ‖F g - w‖ ^ 2 := by
    rw [heq]
    exact ((Complex.continuous_re.comp
        (continuous_normalFunctional_apply α φ₁ (star x * x))).sub
      (continuous_const.mul (Complex.continuous_re.comp
        (continuous_normalFunctional_apply α φ₂ x)))).add continuous_const
  have hnorm : Continuous fun g : G => ‖F g - w‖ := by
    have hroot : (fun g : G => Real.sqrt (‖F g - w‖ ^ 2)) =
        (fun g : G => ‖F g - w‖) := by
      funext g
      exact Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg (F g - w))
    rw [← hroot]
    exact Real.continuous_sqrt.comp hsquare
  simpa only [w, sub_self, norm_zero] using hnorm.tendsto g₀

/-- The original algebra element acts jointly continuously in the group and vector variables. -/
theorem continuous_vector_action (α : NormalAction G M) (x : M) :
    Continuous fun p : G × H => (α p.1 x : H →L[ℂ] H) p.2 := by
  let F : G → H →L[ℂ] H := fun g => (α g x : H →L[ℂ] H)
  have hnorm (g : G) : ‖F g‖ = ‖x‖ := by
    change ‖α g x‖ = ‖x‖
    exact StarAlgEquiv.norm_map (α g).toStarAlgEquiv x
  change Continuous fun p : G × H => F p.1 p.2
  rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
  rintro ⟨g₀, ξ₀⟩
  change Tendsto (fun p : G × H => F p.1 p.2) (𝓝 (g₀, ξ₀)) (𝓝 (F g₀ ξ₀))
  apply tendsto_iff_norm_sub_tendsto_zero.mpr
  have hfirst : Tendsto (fun p : G × H => ‖x‖ * ‖p.2 - ξ₀‖)
      (𝓝 (g₀, ξ₀)) (𝓝 0) := by
    have hc : Continuous (fun p : G × H => ‖x‖ * ‖p.2 - ξ₀‖) :=
      (continuous_const : Continuous (fun _ : G × H => ‖x‖)).mul
        (((continuous_snd : Continuous (fun p : G × H => p.2)).sub
          (continuous_const : Continuous (fun _ : G × H => ξ₀))).norm)
    simpa only [sub_self, norm_zero, mul_zero] using
      hc.tendsto (g₀, ξ₀)
  have hsecond : Tendsto (fun p : G × H => ‖F p.1 ξ₀ - F g₀ ξ₀‖)
      (𝓝 (g₀, ξ₀)) (𝓝 0) := by
    have hv : Continuous (fun p : G × H => F p.1 ξ₀) :=
      (continuous_vector_apply α x ξ₀).comp
        (continuous_fst : Continuous (fun p : G × H => p.1))
    have hc : Continuous (fun p : G × H => ‖F p.1 ξ₀ - F g₀ ξ₀‖) :=
      (hv.sub (continuous_const : Continuous (fun _ : G × H => F g₀ ξ₀))).norm
    simpa only [sub_self, norm_zero] using
      hc.tendsto (g₀, ξ₀)
  have hbound (p : G × H) :
      ‖F p.1 p.2 - F g₀ ξ₀‖ ≤ ‖x‖ * ‖p.2 - ξ₀‖ + ‖F p.1 ξ₀ - F g₀ ξ₀‖ := by
    calc
      ‖F p.1 p.2 - F g₀ ξ₀‖ = ‖F p.1 (p.2 - ξ₀) + (F p.1 ξ₀ - F g₀ ξ₀)‖ := by
        rw [map_sub, sub_add_sub_cancel]
      _ ≤ ‖F p.1 (p.2 - ξ₀)‖ + ‖F p.1 ξ₀ - F g₀ ξ₀‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ ‖F p.1‖ * ‖p.2 - ξ₀‖ + ‖F p.1 ξ₀ - F g₀ ξ₀‖ :=
        add_le_add ((F p.1).le_opNorm (p.2 - ξ₀)) le_rfl
      _ = ‖x‖ * ‖p.2 - ξ₀‖ + ‖F p.1 ξ₀ - F g₀ ξ₀‖ := by rw [hnorm]
  exact squeeze_zero (fun p => norm_nonneg (F p.1 p.2 - F g₀ ξ₀)) hbound
    (by simpa only [zero_add] using hfirst.add hsecond)

end NormalAction
end VonNeumannAlgebra

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalAction.RegularCoefficientAlgebra
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.Generated
public import Mathlib.Algebra.Star.Subalgebra

/-!
# The actual generated regular crossed-product model on Haar Lp

The original regular coefficient operators and Haar left unitaries generate
the least concrete von Neumann algebra on the same Lp H 2 measure carrier.
The coefficient and group maps retain their original values in that subtype,
with the original covariance equation and weakly closed generated carrier.

This is the verified Lp/C_c regular model. A normal source embedding and the
original Connes tensor ambient transport remain separate strict prerequisites;
neither is assumed or represented by a different carrier here.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open MeasureTheory
open scoped Topology CStarAlgebra

namespace VonNeumannAlgebra
namespace NormalAction

noncomputable section

universe uG uH

variable {G : Type uG} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
  [LocallyCompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
variable {H : Type uH} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
variable {M : VonNeumannAlgebra H}
variable (μ : Measure G) [μ.IsHaarMeasure] [μ.Regular]

/-- The literal original regular coefficient and Haar left generator set. -/
def crossedProductGenerators (α : NormalAction G M) : Set (Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) :=
  Set.range (regularCoefficient μ α) ∪
    Set.range (fun g : G => (StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.haarLeftRegular G μ H g :
      Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ))

/-- The least weakly closed von Neumann algebra containing the original regular pair on actual Lp. -/
def crossedProductLp (α : NormalAction G M) : VonNeumannAlgebra (Lp H 2 μ) :=
  VonNeumannAlgebra.generatedBy (crossedProductGenerators μ α)

/-- Every original regular coefficient belongs to this same generated carrier. -/
theorem regularCoefficient_mem_crossedProductLp (α : NormalAction G M) (x : M) :
    regularCoefficient μ α x ∈ crossedProductLp μ α :=
  VonNeumannAlgebra.subset_generatedBy _ (Or.inl (Set.mem_range_self x))

/-- Every original Haar left unitary belongs to this same generated carrier. -/
theorem haarLeftRegular_mem_crossedProductLp (α : NormalAction G M) (g : G) :
    (StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.haarLeftRegular G μ H g :
      Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) ∈ crossedProductLp μ α :=
  VonNeumannAlgebra.subset_generatedBy _ (Or.inr (Set.mem_range_self g))

/-- The actual canonical coefficient star homomorphism, restricted only by proved generator membership. -/
def crossedProductCoefficient (α : NormalAction G M) : M →⋆ₐ[ℂ] crossedProductLp μ α :=
  (regularCoefficientHom μ α).codRestrict (crossedProductLp μ α).toStarSubalgebra
    (regularCoefficient_mem_crossedProductLp μ α)

/-- The canonical coefficient map retains its original regular operator value. -/
@[simp]
theorem crossedProductCoefficient_apply (α : NormalAction G M) (x : M) :
    (crossedProductCoefficient μ α x : Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) = regularCoefficient μ α x :=
  rfl

/-- The actual Haar implementing unitary inside the original generated subtype. -/
def crossedProductGroupUnitary (α : NormalAction G M) (g : G) :
    unitary (crossedProductLp μ α) :=
  ⟨⟨StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.haarLeftRegular G μ H g,
      haarLeftRegular_mem_crossedProductLp μ α g⟩, by
    constructor
    · apply Subtype.ext
      exact (StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.haarLeftRegular G μ H g).property.1
    · apply Subtype.ext
      exact (StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.haarLeftRegular G μ H g).property.2⟩

/-- The implementing unitary is the original Haar left operator at every group element. -/
@[simp]
theorem crossedProductGroupUnitary_coe (α : NormalAction G M) (g : G) :
    ((crossedProductGroupUnitary μ α g : crossedProductLp μ α) :
      Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) =
      (StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.haarLeftRegular G μ H g :
        Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) :=
  rfl

/-- The original Haar group operators form the actual unitary homomorphism into the generated carrier. -/
def crossedProductGroupUnitaryHom (α : NormalAction G M) : G →* unitary (crossedProductLp μ α) where
  toFun := crossedProductGroupUnitary μ α
  map_one' := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact congrArg (fun U : unitary (Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) => U.val)
      (StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.haarLeftRegular G μ H).toMonoidHom.map_one
  map_mul' g h := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact congrArg (fun U : unitary (Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) => U.val)
      ((StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.haarLeftRegular G μ H).toMonoidHom.map_mul g h)

/-- The actual canonical maps in the generated carrier retain the original normal-action covariance. -/
theorem crossedProduct_covariance (α : NormalAction G M) (g : G) (x : M) :
    (crossedProductGroupUnitary μ α g : crossedProductLp μ α) * crossedProductCoefficient μ α x *
      star (crossedProductGroupUnitary μ α g : crossedProductLp μ α) =
        crossedProductCoefficient μ α (α g x) := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact regularCoefficient_covariance μ α g x

/-- A concrete von Neumann algebra contains this model exactly when it contains both original generator families. -/
theorem crossedProductLp_le_iff (α : NormalAction G M) (N : VonNeumannAlgebra (Lp H 2 μ)) :
    crossedProductLp μ α ≤ N ↔
      (∀ x : M, regularCoefficient μ α x ∈ N) ∧
        ∀ g : G, (StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.haarLeftRegular G μ H g :
          Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) ∈ N := by
  rw [crossedProductLp, VonNeumannAlgebra.generatedBy_le_iff]
  simp only [crossedProductGenerators, Set.union_subset_iff, Set.range_subset_iff]
  exact Iff.rfl

/-- The same generated regular carrier is closed in the actual weak operator topology. -/
theorem crossedProductLp_isClosedWOT (α : NormalAction G M) :
    IsClosed {T : Lp H 2 μ →WOT[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ | T.toCLM ∈ crossedProductLp μ α} :=
  VonNeumannAlgebra.generatedBy_isClosedWOT (crossedProductGenerators μ α)

end

end NormalAction
end VonNeumannAlgebra

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalAction.SpatialCoefficient
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Group.HaarRegularTensorCoordinates

/-!
# The original generated crossed product on the H-first tensor

The original tensor coefficients and actual id_H tensor scalar-Haar unitaries
generate a concrete von Neumann algebra on the literal completed H-first
Hilbert tensor. Both families belong to the original spatial ambient, so the
generated algebra is its actual von Neumann subalgebra. Canonical plain
coefficient and group maps keep the original bounded operator values.

The verified tensor/L2 coordinates transport the original Haar covariance.
The normal coefficient embedding waits for its actual normality constructor.
The stronger Connes M tensor LInfinity coefficient clause and full terminal
source equivalence proofs remain separate unfinished source obligations.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open MeasureTheory
open scoped TensorProduct Topology CStarAlgebra

namespace VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalAction

noncomputable section

universe uG uH

variable {G : Type uG} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
  [LocallyCompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
variable {H : Type uH} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
variable {M : VonNeumannAlgebra H}
variable (μ : Measure G) [μ.IsHaarMeasure] [μ.Regular]

/-- The literal source tensor coefficient and identity-H tensor Haar generator families. -/
def crossedProductTensorGenerators (α : NormalAction G M) :
    Set (UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) →L[ℂ]
      UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ))) :=
  Set.range (regularCoefficientTensor μ α) ∪
    Set.range (fun g : G => (StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.haarLeftRegularTensor G μ H g :
      UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) →L[ℂ]
        UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ))))

/-- The actual original source crossed product generated on the completed H-first tensor. -/
def crossedProductTensor (α : NormalAction G M) :
    VonNeumannAlgebra (UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ))) :=
  generatedBy (crossedProductTensorGenerators μ α)

/-- Every original tensor coefficient belongs to this same source generated algebra. -/
theorem regularCoefficientTensor_mem_crossedProductTensor (α : NormalAction G M) (x : M) :
    regularCoefficientTensor μ α x ∈ crossedProductTensor μ α :=
  subset_generatedBy _ (Or.inl (Set.mem_range_self x))

/-- Every actual identity-H tensor Haar unitary belongs to this same source generated algebra. -/
theorem haarLeftRegularTensor_mem_crossedProductTensor (α : NormalAction G M) (g : G) :
    (StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.haarLeftRegularTensor G μ H g :
      UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) →L[ℂ]
        UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ))) ∈ crossedProductTensor μ α :=
  subset_generatedBy _ (Or.inr (Set.mem_range_self g))

/-- The original generated crossed product is contained in its actual source spatial ambient. -/
theorem crossedProductTensor_le_spatialTensorProduct (α : NormalAction G M) :
    crossedProductTensor μ α ≤ spatialTensorProduct M (⊤ : VonNeumannAlgebra (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) := by
  apply generatedBy_le
  intro T hT
  rcases hT with (⟨x, rfl⟩ | ⟨g, rfl⟩)
  · exact regularCoefficientTensor_mem_spatialTensorProduct μ α x
  · change (StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.haarLeftRegularTensor G μ H g :
      UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) →L[ℂ]
        UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ))) ∈
          spatialTensorProduct M (⊤ : VonNeumannAlgebra (Lp ℂ 2 μ))
    rw [StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.haarLeftRegularTensor_apply]
    exact tensorOperator_mem_spatialTensorProduct M (⊤ : VonNeumannAlgebra (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) (1 : M)
      ⟨(StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.haarLeftRegular G μ ℂ g :
        Lp ℂ 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ), by trivial⟩

/-- The actual original plain coefficient star homomorphism into the same source generated subtype. -/
def crossedProductTensorCoefficient (α : NormalAction G M) : M →⋆ₐ[ℂ] crossedProductTensor μ α :=
  (regularCoefficientTensorHom μ α).codRestrict (crossedProductTensor μ α).toStarSubalgebra
    (regularCoefficientTensor_mem_crossedProductTensor μ α)

/-- The canonical source coefficient map is the same original tensor operator. -/
@[simp]
theorem crossedProductTensorCoefficient_apply (α : NormalAction G M) (x : M) :
    (crossedProductTensorCoefficient μ α x :
      UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) →L[ℂ]
        UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ))) = regularCoefficientTensor μ α x :=
  rfl

/-- The actual source identity-H tensor Haar implementer inside the original generated algebra. -/
def crossedProductTensorGroupUnitary (α : NormalAction G M) (g : G) :
    unitary (crossedProductTensor μ α) :=
  ⟨⟨StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.haarLeftRegularTensor G μ H g,
      haarLeftRegularTensor_mem_crossedProductTensor μ α g⟩, by
    constructor
    · apply Subtype.ext
      exact (StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.haarLeftRegularTensor G μ H g).property.1
    · apply Subtype.ext
      exact (StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.haarLeftRegularTensor G μ H g).property.2⟩

/-- The canonical group implementer retains the actual original tensor Haar operator value. -/
@[simp]
theorem crossedProductTensorGroupUnitary_coe (α : NormalAction G M) (g : G) :
    ((crossedProductTensorGroupUnitary μ α g : crossedProductTensor μ α) :
      UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) →L[ℂ]
        UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ))) =
      (StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.haarLeftRegularTensor G μ H g :
        UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) →L[ℂ]
          UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ))) :=
  rfl

/-- The literal source tensor Haar operators form their actual group map in the generated subtype. -/
def crossedProductTensorGroupUnitaryHom (α : NormalAction G M) :
    G →* unitary (crossedProductTensor μ α) where
  toFun := crossedProductTensorGroupUnitary μ α
  map_one' := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact congrArg (fun U : unitary (UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) →L[ℂ]
      UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ))) => U.val)
        (StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.haarLeftRegularTensor G μ H).toMonoidHom.map_one
  map_mul' g h := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact congrArg (fun U : unitary (UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) →L[ℂ]
      UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ))) => U.val)
        ((StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.haarLeftRegularTensor G μ H).toMonoidHom.map_mul g h)

/-- Original tensor coefficients and identity-H tensor Haar implementers satisfy the source covariance. -/
theorem regularCoefficientTensor_covariance (α : NormalAction G M) (g : G) (x : M) :
    (StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.haarLeftRegularTensor G μ H g :
        UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) →L[ℂ]
          UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ))) * regularCoefficientTensor μ α x *
      star (StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.haarLeftRegularTensor G μ H g :
        UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) →L[ℂ]
          UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ))) =
      regularCoefficientTensor μ α (α g x) := by
  let Φ := L2.tensorToLpRight (𝕜 := ℂ) (H := H) μ
  let e := Φ.conjStarAlgEquiv
  let L := (StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.haarLeftRegularTensor G μ H g :
    UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) →L[ℂ]
      UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)))
  let P := regularCoefficientTensor μ α x
  have hL : e L = (StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.haarLeftRegular G μ H g :
      Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) :=
    StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.haarLeftRegularTensor_conjStarAlgEquiv G μ H g
  have hP (y : M) : e (regularCoefficientTensor μ α y) = regularCoefficient μ α y := by
    have hTensor : regularCoefficientTensor μ α y = e.symm (regularCoefficient μ α y) := rfl
    rw [hTensor]
    exact e.apply_symm_apply _
  apply e.injective
  calc
    e (L * P * star L) = e (L * P) * e (star L) := map_mul e _ _
    _ = (e L * e P) * star (e L) :=
      congrArg₂ (fun A B : Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ => A * B) (map_mul e L P) (map_star e L)
    _ = (StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.haarLeftRegular G μ H g :
        Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) * regularCoefficient μ α x *
      star (StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.haarLeftRegular G μ H g :
        Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) := by rw [hL, hP x]
    _ = regularCoefficient μ α (α g x) := regularCoefficient_covariance μ α g x
    _ = e (regularCoefficientTensor μ α (α g x)) := (hP (α g x)).symm

/-- The actual source coefficient and group maps retain covariance inside the same generated algebra. -/
theorem crossedProductTensor_covariance (α : NormalAction G M) (g : G) (x : M) :
    (crossedProductTensorGroupUnitary μ α g : crossedProductTensor μ α) *
      crossedProductTensorCoefficient μ α x *
      star (crossedProductTensorGroupUnitary μ α g : crossedProductTensor μ α) =
        crossedProductTensorCoefficient μ α (α g x) := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact regularCoefficientTensor_covariance μ α g x

/-- Containment of the original source crossed product is exactly containment of its actual generators. -/
theorem crossedProductTensor_le_iff (α : NormalAction G M)
    (N : VonNeumannAlgebra (UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)))) :
    crossedProductTensor μ α ≤ N ↔
      (∀ x : M, regularCoefficientTensor μ α x ∈ N) ∧
        ∀ g : G, (StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.haarLeftRegularTensor G μ H g :
          UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) →L[ℂ]
            UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ))) ∈ N := by
  rw [crossedProductTensor, generatedBy_le_iff]
  simp only [crossedProductTensorGenerators, Set.union_subset_iff, Set.range_subset_iff]
  exact Iff.rfl

/-- The actual original H-first source generated algebra is weak-operator closed. -/
theorem crossedProductTensor_isClosedWOT (α : NormalAction G M) :
    IsClosed {T : UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) →WOT[ℂ]
        UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) | T.toCLM ∈ crossedProductTensor μ α} :=
  generatedBy_isClosedWOT (crossedProductTensorGenerators μ α)

end

/-!
# The original tensor crossed-product normal faithful coefficient map

The canonical coefficient map retains its original tensor operator value.
Its vector-functional pullback is the same literal functional as the one
through the already proved spatial normal coefficient map. Actual predual
pullback and the vector-functional criterion give normality in the generated
source subtype. Original tensor coefficient injectivity gives faithfulness.

This supplies the normal source embedding needed by the original H-first
crossed-product definition, with no supplied normality, model or isometry.
The stronger Connes coefficient M tensor LInfinity clause remains separate.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open MeasureTheory
open scoped TensorProduct InnerProductSpace CStarAlgebra

namespace VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalAction

noncomputable section

universe uG uH

variable {G : Type uG} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
  [LocallyCompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
variable {H : Type uH} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
variable {M : VonNeumannAlgebra H}
variable (μ : Measure G) [μ.IsHaarMeasure] [μ.Regular]

/-- The canonical source tensor coefficient map with its actual proved normality. -/
def crossedProductTensorCoefficientNormalHom (α : NormalAction G M) :
    NormalStarAlgHom M (crossedProductTensor μ α) := by
  let S := crossedProductTensor μ α
  let N := spatialTensorProduct M (⊤ : VonNeumannAlgebra (Lp ℂ 2 μ))
  let f := crossedProductTensorCoefficient μ α
  let F : M →L[ℂ] S := ⟨LinearMap.ofClass f, map_continuous f⟩
  let n := regularCoefficientSpatialNormalHom μ α
  have hn (x : M) :
      (n x : UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) →L[ℂ]
        UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ))) = regularCoefficientTensor μ α x :=
    rfl
  refine NormalStarAlgHom.ofVectorFunctionalPullbacks f ?_
  intro ξ η
  let φ : normalFunctionalSpace N :=
    ⟨vectorFunctional N ξ η, vectorFunctional_mem_normalFunctionalSpace N ξ η⟩
  have hmem := n.predualPullback_mem φ
  have hEq : (vectorFunctional S ξ η).comp F =
      (vectorFunctional N ξ η).comp n.toContinuousLinearMap := by
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
    intro x
    calc
      _ = vectorFunctional S ξ η (f x) := rfl
      _ = inner ℂ ξ ((f x : UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) →L[ℂ]
          UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ))) η) :=
        vectorFunctional_apply S ξ η (f x)
      _ = inner ℂ ξ (regularCoefficientTensor μ α x η) :=
        congrArg (fun A : UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) →L[ℂ]
          UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) => inner ℂ ξ (A η))
            (crossedProductTensorCoefficient_apply μ α x)
      _ = inner ℂ ξ ((n x : UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) →L[ℂ]
          UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ))) η) :=
        congrArg (fun A : UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) →L[ℂ]
          UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) => inner ℂ ξ (A η)) (hn x).symm
      _ = vectorFunctional N ξ η (n x) := (vectorFunctional_apply N ξ η (n x)).symm
      _ = ((vectorFunctional N ξ η).comp n.toContinuousLinearMap) x := rfl
  change (vectorFunctional S ξ η).comp F ∈ normalFunctionalSpace M
  rw [hEq]
  exact hmem

/-- The normal source coefficient map is the original canonical coefficient in the generated algebra. -/
@[simp]
theorem crossedProductTensorCoefficientNormalHom_apply (α : NormalAction G M) (x : M) :
    crossedProductTensorCoefficientNormalHom μ α x = crossedProductTensorCoefficient μ α x :=
  rfl

/-- Its underlying operator is the exact original H-first tensor coefficient. -/
@[simp]
theorem crossedProductTensorCoefficientNormalHom_coe (α : NormalAction G M) (x : M) :
    (crossedProductTensorCoefficientNormalHom μ α x :
      UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) →L[ℂ]
        UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ))) = regularCoefficientTensor μ α x :=
  rfl

/-- The same actual normal coefficient embedding into the source crossed product is faithful. -/
theorem crossedProductTensorCoefficientNormalHom_injective (α : NormalAction G M) :
    Function.Injective (crossedProductTensorCoefficientNormalHom μ α) := by
  intro x y hxy
  apply regularCoefficientTensor_injective μ α
  exact congrArg (fun z : crossedProductTensor μ α =>
    (z : UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) →L[ℂ]
      UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)))) hxy

end

end VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalAction

/-!
# Actual coordinate coefficients on the original Hilbert-valued Radon square

Pullback of the original normal action along the first projection gives
the literal first-coordinate regular coefficient. For an abelian group,
pullback along `(s,t) ↦ s*t⁻¹` gives the literal difference-coordinate
coefficient. Both are the existing actual regular pointwise operators on
the full `Lp H 2 (radonProd μ μ)` and retain their original a.e. values.

The original normal coefficient API supplies actual normal homomorphisms
into the full bounded-operator algebra on this same Borel Radon carrier.
No normal range, Fourier transform, shear or spatial identification is
selected from an open statement.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open MeasureTheory
open scoped CStarAlgebra

namespace VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalAction

noncomputable section

universe uG uH

variable {G : Type uG} [CommGroup G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
  [T2Space G] [LocallyCompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
variable (μ : Measure G) [μ.IsHaarMeasure] [μ.Regular]
variable {H : Type uH} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
variable {M : VonNeumannAlgebra H}

/-- The actual Borel measurable space of the original topological product. -/
local instance instRadonCoefficientProductMeasurableSpace : MeasurableSpace (G × G) :=
  borel (G × G)
local instance instRadonCoefficientProductBorelSpace : BorelSpace (G × G) := ⟨rfl⟩

/-- The literal continuous group homomorphism given by the original coordinate difference. -/
def differenceCoordinateHom : (G × G) →ₜ* G :=
  ContinuousMonoidHom.fst G G * (ContinuousMonoidHom.snd G G)⁻¹

omit [T2Space G] [LocallyCompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G] in
/-- The difference homomorphism has its original multiplicative coordinate values. -/
@[simp]
theorem differenceCoordinateHom_apply (z : G × G) :
    differenceCoordinateHom z = z.1 * z.2⁻¹ :=
  rfl

/-- The original first-coordinate coefficient is the actual regular operator of the pulled-back action. -/
def firstRadonCoefficient (α : NormalAction G M) (x : M) :
    Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ μ) →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ μ) :=
  regularCoefficient (Measure.radonProd μ μ) (comp α (ContinuousMonoidHom.fst G G)) x

omit [μ.Regular] in
/-- Every full Radon product-L2 vector has the original first-coordinate coefficient formula a.e. -/
theorem firstRadonCoefficient_ae_eq (α : NormalAction G M) (x : M)
    (ξ : Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ μ)) :
    firstRadonCoefficient μ α x ξ =ᵐ[Measure.radonProd μ μ]
      fun z : G × G => (α z.1⁻¹ x : H →L[ℂ] H) (ξ z) :=
  regularCoefficient_ae_eq (Measure.radonProd μ μ) (comp α (ContinuousMonoidHom.fst G G)) x ξ

/-- The original first-coordinate coefficient carries the existing proved normality. -/
def firstRadonCoefficientNormalHom (α : NormalAction G M) :
    NormalStarAlgHom M (⊤ : VonNeumannAlgebra (Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ μ))) :=
  regularCoefficientNormalHom (Measure.radonProd μ μ) (comp α (ContinuousMonoidHom.fst G G))

/-- The normal first-coordinate map has the exact original bounded-operator value. -/
@[simp]
theorem firstRadonCoefficientNormalHom_coe (α : NormalAction G M) (x : M) :
    (firstRadonCoefficientNormalHom μ α x :
      Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ μ) →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ μ)) =
        firstRadonCoefficient μ α x :=
  rfl

/-- The original recovered coefficient is the actual regular operator of the difference pullback. -/
def recoveredRadonCoefficient (α : NormalAction G M) (x : M) :
    Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ μ) →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ μ) :=
  regularCoefficient (Measure.radonProd μ μ) (comp α differenceCoordinateHom) x

omit [μ.Regular] in
/-- Every full Radon product-L2 vector has the exact original inverse-difference coefficient a.e. -/
theorem recoveredRadonCoefficient_ae_eq (α : NormalAction G M) (x : M)
    (ξ : Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ μ)) :
    recoveredRadonCoefficient μ α x ξ =ᵐ[Measure.radonProd μ μ]
      fun z : G × G => (α (z.1 * z.2⁻¹)⁻¹ x : H →L[ℂ] H) (ξ z) := by
  have h := regularCoefficient_ae_eq (Measure.radonProd μ μ)
    (comp α differenceCoordinateHom) x ξ
  filter_upwards [h] with z hz
  change regularCoefficient (Measure.radonProd μ μ) (comp α differenceCoordinateHom) x ξ z = _
  rw [hz]
  change (α (differenceCoordinateHom z⁻¹) x : H →L[ℂ] H) (ξ z) = _
  rw [map_inv, differenceCoordinateHom_apply]

/-- The recovered-coordinate coefficient carries the existing proved normality on the original carrier. -/
def recoveredRadonCoefficientNormalHom (α : NormalAction G M) :
    NormalStarAlgHom M (⊤ : VonNeumannAlgebra (Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ μ))) :=
  regularCoefficientNormalHom (Measure.radonProd μ μ) (comp α differenceCoordinateHom)

/-- The normal recovered-coordinate map is the same original bounded pointwise operator. -/
@[simp]
theorem recoveredRadonCoefficientNormalHom_coe (α : NormalAction G M) (x : M) :
    (recoveredRadonCoefficientNormalHom μ α x :
      Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ μ) →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ μ)) =
        recoveredRadonCoefficient μ α x :=
  rfl

end

    (doubleCrossedProductTensor μ ν α)

/-- The spatial normal map keeps the exact original conjugated bounded operator. -/
theorem doubleRadonSpatialNormalHom_coe (α : NormalAction G M)
    (x : doubleCrossedProductTensor μ ν α) :
    (doubleRadonSpatialNormalHom μ ν α x :
      Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν) →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν)) =
      (HaarL2.radonProductHFirstTensorUnitary (H := H) μ ν).conjStarAlgEquiv
        (x : Completion (Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν)) →L[ℂ]
          Completion (Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν))) := rfl

/-- The original first crossed product embeds normally into the actual product-L2 operator algebra. -/
def doubleRadonFirstCoefficientNormalHom (α : NormalAction G M) :
    NormalStarAlgHom (crossedProductTensor μ α)
      (⊤ : VonNeumannAlgebra (Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν))) :=
  (doubleRadonSpatialNormalHom μ ν α).comp
    (crossedProductTensorCoefficientNormalHom ν (tensorCharacterNormalAction μ α))

/-- Every original first-algebra element retains its literal H-first conjugated coefficient operator. -/
theorem doubleRadonFirstCoefficientNormalHom_coe (α : NormalAction G M)
    (x : crossedProductTensor μ α) :
    (doubleRadonFirstCoefficientNormalHom μ ν α x :
      Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν) →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν)) =
      (HaarL2.radonProductHFirstTensorUnitary (H := H) μ ν).conjStarAlgEquiv
        (regularCoefficientTensor ν (tensorCharacterNormalAction μ α) x) := by
  let z : doubleCrossedProductTensor μ ν α :=
    crossedProductTensorCoefficientNormalHom ν (tensorCharacterNormalAction μ α) x
  have hx : (z : Completion (Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 ν) →L[ℂ]
      Completion (Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 ν)) =
        regularCoefficientTensor ν (tensorCharacterNormalAction μ α) x :=
    crossedProductTensorCoefficientNormalHom_coe ν (tensorCharacterNormalAction μ α) x
  calc
    _ = (doubleRadonSpatialNormalHom μ ν α z :
        Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν) →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν)) := rfl
    _ = (HaarL2.radonProductHFirstTensorUnitary (H := H) μ ν).conjStarAlgEquiv
        (z : Completion (Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 ν) →L[ℂ]
          Completion (Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 ν)) :=
      doubleRadonSpatialNormalHom_coe μ ν α z
    _ = _ := by
      apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
      intro ξ
      simp only [LinearIsometryEquiv.conjStarAlgEquiv_apply_apply]
      exact congrArg
        (fun η : Completion (Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 ν) =>
          HaarL2.radonProductHFirstTensorUnitary (H := H) μ ν η)
        (congrArg
          (fun T : Completion (Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 ν) →L[ℂ]
            Completion (Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 ν) =>
              T ((HaarL2.radonProductHFirstTensorUnitary (H := H) μ ν).symm ξ)) hx)

/-- The original first coefficient uses the actual inverse and forward H-first maps on every vector. -/
theorem doubleRadonFirstCoefficientNormalHom_apply (α : NormalAction G M)
    (x : crossedProductTensor μ α) (ξ : Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν)) :
    (doubleRadonFirstCoefficientNormalHom μ ν α x :
      Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν) →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν)) ξ =
      HaarL2.radonProductHFirstTensorUnitary (H := H) μ ν
        (regularCoefficientTensor ν (tensorCharacterNormalAction μ α) x
          ((HaarL2.radonProductHFirstTensorUnitary (H := H) μ ν).symm ξ)) := by
  calc
    _ = ((HaarL2.radonProductHFirstTensorUnitary (H := H) μ ν).conjStarAlgEquiv
        (regularCoefficientTensor ν (tensorCharacterNormalAction μ α) x)) ξ :=
      congrArg
        (fun T : Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν) →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν) => T ξ)
        (doubleRadonFirstCoefficientNormalHom_coe μ ν α x)
    _ = _ := rfl

/-- The two original canonical tensor coefficient maps form the actual double coefficient. -/
def doubleTensorCoefficientNormalHom (α : NormalAction G M) :
    NormalStarAlgHom M (doubleCrossedProductTensor μ ν α) :=
  (crossedProductTensorCoefficientNormalHom ν (tensorCharacterNormalAction μ α)).comp
    (crossedProductTensorCoefficientNormalHom μ α)

/-- The original coefficient algebra maps normally to the full actual Borel product-L2 operators. -/
def doubleRadonCoefficientNormalHom (α : NormalAction G M) :
    NormalStarAlgHom M (⊤ : VonNeumannAlgebra (Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν))) :=
  (doubleRadonSpatialNormalHom μ ν α).comp (doubleTensorCoefficientNormalHom μ ν α)

omit [T2Space G] in
/-- The nested double coefficient is the unchanged original second tensor coefficient operator. -/
theorem doubleTensorCoefficientNormalHom_coe (α : NormalAction G M) (x : M) :
    (doubleTensorCoefficientNormalHom μ ν α x :
      Completion (Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν)) →L[ℂ]
        Completion (Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν))) =
      regularCoefficientTensor ν (tensorCharacterNormalAction μ α)
        (crossedProductTensorCoefficient μ α x) := rfl

omit [T2Space G] in
private theorem doubleTensorCoefficientNormalHom_apply_operator (α : NormalAction G M) (x : M)
    (η : Completion (Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν))) :
    (doubleTensorCoefficientNormalHom μ ν α x :
      Completion (Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν)) →L[ℂ]
        Completion (Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν))) η =
      regularCoefficientTensor ν (tensorCharacterNormalAction μ α)
        (crossedProductTensorCoefficient μ α x) η :=
  congrArg
    (fun T : Completion (Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν)) →L[ℂ]
      Completion (Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν)) => T η)
    (doubleTensorCoefficientNormalHom_coe μ ν α x)

private theorem doubleRadonCoefficientNormalHom_factorization (α : NormalAction G M) (x : M) :
    (doubleRadonCoefficientNormalHom μ ν α x :
      Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν) →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν)) =
      (doubleRadonSpatialNormalHom μ ν α (doubleTensorCoefficientNormalHom μ ν α x) :
        Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν) →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν)) := rfl

/-- The actual normal product coefficient is literal H-first conjugation of the original tensor coefficient. -/
theorem doubleRadonCoefficientNormalHom_coe (α : NormalAction G M) (x : M) :
    (doubleRadonCoefficientNormalHom μ ν α x :
      Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν) →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν)) =
      (HaarL2.radonProductHFirstTensorUnitary (H := H) μ ν).conjStarAlgEquiv
        (regularCoefficientTensor ν (tensorCharacterNormalAction μ α)
          (crossedProductTensorCoefficient μ α x)) := by
  calc
    _ = (doubleRadonSpatialNormalHom μ ν α (doubleTensorCoefficientNormalHom μ ν α x) :
        Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν) →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν)) :=
      doubleRadonCoefficientNormalHom_factorization μ ν α x
    _ = (HaarL2.radonProductHFirstTensorUnitary (H := H) μ ν).conjStarAlgEquiv
        (doubleTensorCoefficientNormalHom μ ν α x :
          Completion (Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν)) →L[ℂ]
            Completion (Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν))) :=
      doubleRadonSpatialNormalHom_coe μ ν α (doubleTensorCoefficientNormalHom μ ν α x)
    _ = _ := by
      apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
      intro ξ
      simp only [LinearIsometryEquiv.conjStarAlgEquiv_apply_apply]
      exact congrArg
        (fun η : Completion (Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 ν)) =>
          HaarL2.radonProductHFirstTensorUnitary (H := H) μ ν η)
        (doubleTensorCoefficientNormalHom_apply_operator μ ν α x
          ((HaarL2.radonProductHFirstTensorUnitary (H := H) μ ν).symm ξ))

/-- The actual normal coefficient uses the original inverse and forward coordinate-model maps on vectors. -/
theorem doubleRadonCoefficientNormalHom_apply (α : NormalAction G M) (x : M)
    (ξ : Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν)) :
    (doubleRadonCoefficientNormalHom μ ν α x :
      Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν) →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν)) ξ =
      HaarL2.radonProductHFirstTensorUnitary (H := H) μ ν
        (regularCoefficientTensor ν (tensorCharacterNormalAction μ α)
          (crossedProductTensorCoefficient μ α x)
          ((HaarL2.radonProductHFirstTensorUnitary (H := H) μ ν).symm ξ)) := by
  rw [doubleRadonCoefficientNormalHom_coe]
  exact LinearIsometryEquiv.conjStarAlgEquiv_apply_apply _ _ _

/-- The original first Haar unitary retains its actual normal double-coefficient operator image. -/
def doubleRadonFirstGroupUnitary (α : NormalAction G M) (g : G) :
    unitary (⊤ : VonNeumannAlgebra (Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν))) :=
  Unitary.map
    { toMonoidHom := (doubleRadonFirstCoefficientNormalHom μ ν α).toStarAlgHom.toMonoidHom
      map_star' := map_star (doubleRadonFirstCoefficientNormalHom μ ν α).toStarAlgHom }
    (crossedProductTensorGroupUnitary μ α g)

/-- The mapped first Haar unitary is the exact normal image of the original first source unitary. -/
@[simp]
theorem doubleRadonFirstGroupUnitary_coe (α : NormalAction G M) (g : G) :
    ((doubleRadonFirstGroupUnitary μ ν α g :
      (⊤ : VonNeumannAlgebra (Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν)))) :
        Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν) →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν)) =
      (doubleRadonFirstCoefficientNormalHom μ ν α
        (crossedProductTensorGroupUnitary μ α g : crossedProductTensor μ α) :
          Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν) →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν)) := rfl

/-- The first mapped unitary acts through the original H-first coordinates and second coefficient. -/
theorem doubleRadonFirstGroupUnitary_apply (α : NormalAction G M) (g : G)
    (ξ : Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν)) :
    ((doubleRadonFirstGroupUnitary μ ν α g :
      (⊤ : VonNeumannAlgebra (Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν)))) :
        Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν) →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν)) ξ =
      HaarL2.radonProductHFirstTensorUnitary (H := H) μ ν
        (regularCoefficientTensor ν (tensorCharacterNormalAction μ α)
          (crossedProductTensorGroupUnitary μ α g : crossedProductTensor μ α)
          ((HaarL2.radonProductHFirstTensorUnitary (H := H) μ ν).symm ξ)) := by
  let E := HaarL2.radonProductHFirstTensorUnitary (H := H) μ ν
  let u : crossedProductTensor μ α := (crossedProductTensorGroupUnitary μ α g).val
  let z : doubleCrossedProductTensor μ ν α :=
    crossedProductTensorCoefficientNormalHom ν (tensorCharacterNormalAction μ α) u
  let A : Completion (Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 ν) →L[ℂ]
      Completion (Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 ν) :=
    regularCoefficientTensor ν (tensorCharacterNormalAction μ α) u
  have hz : (z : Completion (Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 ν) →L[ℂ]
      Completion (Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 ν)) = A :=
    crossedProductTensorCoefficientNormalHom_coe ν (tensorCharacterNormalAction μ α) u
  have hm : (doubleRadonFirstCoefficientNormalHom μ ν α u :
      Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν) →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν)) =
      (doubleRadonSpatialNormalHom μ ν α z :
        Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν) →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν)) := rfl
  have hmap :
      ((doubleRadonFirstGroupUnitary μ ν α g :
        (⊤ : VonNeumannAlgebra (Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν)))) :
          Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν) →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν)) ξ =
      (doubleRadonSpatialNormalHom μ ν α z :
        Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν) →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν)) ξ :=
    (congrArg
      (fun T : Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν) →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν) => T ξ)
      (doubleRadonFirstGroupUnitary_coe μ ν α g)).trans
        (congrArg
          (fun T : Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν) →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν) => T ξ) hm)
  have hbase :
      (doubleRadonSpatialNormalHom μ ν α z :
        Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν) →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν)) ξ =
      E ((z : Completion (Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 ν) →L[ℂ]
        Completion (Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 ν)) (E.symm ξ)) :=
    by
      calc
        _ = ((HaarL2.radonProductHFirstTensorUnitary (H := H) μ ν).conjStarAlgEquiv
            (z : Completion (Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 ν) →L[ℂ]
              Completion (Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 ν))) ξ :=
          congrArg
            (fun T : Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν) →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν) => T ξ)
            (doubleRadonSpatialNormalHom_coe μ ν α z)
        _ = _ := rfl
  exact hmap.trans (hbase.trans
    (congrArg
      (fun v : Completion (Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 ν) => E v)
      (congrArg
        (fun T : Completion (Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 ν) →L[ℂ]
          Completion (Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 ν) => T (E.symm ξ)) hz)))

/-- The original dual-group Haar unitary retains its actual spatial coordinate-model image. -/
def doubleRadonSecondGroupUnitary (α : NormalAction G M) (χ : PontryaginDual G) :
    unitary (⊤ : VonNeumannAlgebra (Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν))) :=
  Unitary.map
    { toMonoidHom := (doubleRadonSpatialNormalHom μ ν α).toStarAlgHom.toMonoidHom
      map_star' := map_star (doubleRadonSpatialNormalHom μ ν α).toStarAlgHom }
    (crossedProductTensorGroupUnitary ν (tensorCharacterNormalAction μ α) χ)

/-- The mapped dual-Haar unitary is the exact spatial image of the original second source unitary. -/
@[simp]
theorem doubleRadonSecondGroupUnitary_coe (α : NormalAction G M) (χ : PontryaginDual G) :
    ((doubleRadonSecondGroupUnitary μ ν α χ :
      (⊤ : VonNeumannAlgebra (Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν)))) :
        Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν) →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν)) =
      (doubleRadonSpatialNormalHom μ ν α
        ((crossedProductTensorGroupUnitary ν (tensorCharacterNormalAction μ α) χ).val :
          doubleCrossedProductTensor μ ν α) :
            Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν) →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν)) := rfl

/-- The second mapped unitary retains the original Haar translation in the completed dual factor. -/
theorem doubleRadonSecondGroupUnitary_apply (α : NormalAction G M) (χ : PontryaginDual G)
    (ξ : Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν)) :
    ((doubleRadonSecondGroupUnitary μ ν α χ :
      (⊤ : VonNeumannAlgebra (Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν)))) :
        Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν) →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν)) ξ =
      HaarL2.radonProductHFirstTensorUnitary (H := H) μ ν
        ((StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.haarLeftRegularTensor
          (PontryaginDual G) ν (Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ)) χ :
            Completion (Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 ν) →L[ℂ]
              Completion (Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 ν))
            ((HaarL2.radonProductHFirstTensorUnitary (H := H) μ ν).symm ξ)) := by
  let E := HaarL2.radonProductHFirstTensorUnitary (H := H) μ ν
  let z : doubleCrossedProductTensor μ ν α :=
    (crossedProductTensorGroupUnitary ν (tensorCharacterNormalAction μ α) χ).val
  let A : Completion (Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 ν) →L[ℂ]
      Completion (Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 ν) :=
    (StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.haarLeftRegularTensor
      (PontryaginDual G) ν (Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ)) χ :
        Completion (Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 ν) →L[ℂ]
          Completion (Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 ν))
  have hz : (z : Completion (Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 ν) →L[ℂ]
      Completion (Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 ν)) = A :=
    crossedProductTensorGroupUnitary_coe ν (tensorCharacterNormalAction μ α) χ
  have hmap :
      ((doubleRadonSecondGroupUnitary μ ν α χ :
        (⊤ : VonNeumannAlgebra (Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν)))) :
          Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν) →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν)) ξ =
      (doubleRadonSpatialNormalHom μ ν α z :
        Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν) →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν)) ξ :=
    congrArg
      (fun T : Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν) →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν) => T ξ)
      (doubleRadonSecondGroupUnitary_coe μ ν α χ)
  have hbase :
      (doubleRadonSpatialNormalHom μ ν α z :
        Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν) →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν)) ξ =
      E ((z : Completion (Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 ν) →L[ℂ]
        Completion (Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 ν)) (E.symm ξ)) :=
    by
      calc
        _ = ((HaarL2.radonProductHFirstTensorUnitary (H := H) μ ν).conjStarAlgEquiv
            (z : Completion (Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 ν) →L[ℂ]
              Completion (Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 ν))) ξ :=
          congrArg
            (fun T : Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν) →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν) => T ξ)
            (doubleRadonSpatialNormalHom_coe μ ν α z)
        _ = _ := rfl
  exact hmap.trans (hbase.trans
    (congrArg
      (fun v : Completion (Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 ν) => E v)
      (congrArg
        (fun T : Completion (Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 ν) →L[ℂ]
          Completion (Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ) ⊗[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 ν) => T (E.symm ξ)) hz)))

/-- The full first-coefficient and second-group images are the actual transported two generator families. -/
def doubleRadonGenerators (α : NormalAction G M) :
    Set (Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν) →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν)) :=
  Set.range (fun x : crossedProductTensor μ α =>
    (doubleRadonFirstCoefficientNormalHom μ ν α x :
      Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν) →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν))) ∪
    Set.range (fun χ : PontryaginDual G => (doubleRadonSecondGroupUnitary μ ν α χ :
      Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν) →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν)))

/-- The actual original operator images generate the Borel product-L2 double model. -/
def doubleRadonAlgebra (α : NormalAction G M) : VonNeumannAlgebra (Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν)) :=
  generatedBy (doubleRadonGenerators μ ν α)

/-- Every original first-product coefficient image belongs to this same actual generated model. -/
theorem doubleRadonFirstCoefficient_mem (α : NormalAction G M) (x : crossedProductTensor μ α) :
    (doubleRadonFirstCoefficientNormalHom μ ν α x :
      Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν) →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν)) ∈
        doubleRadonAlgebra μ ν α :=
  subset_generatedBy _ (Or.inl (Set.mem_range_self x))

/-- The mapped original first Haar unitary belongs directly to the actual generated Radon algebra. -/
theorem doubleRadonFirstGroup_mem (α : NormalAction G M) (g : G) :
    ((doubleRadonFirstGroupUnitary μ ν α g :
      (⊤ : VonNeumannAlgebra (Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν)))) :
        Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν) →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν)) ∈
      doubleRadonAlgebra μ ν α := by
  rw [doubleRadonFirstGroupUnitary_coe]
  exact doubleRadonFirstCoefficient_mem μ ν α
    (crossedProductTensorGroupUnitary μ α g : crossedProductTensor μ α)

/-- Every actual second Haar unitary image belongs to the same generated product model. -/
theorem doubleRadonSecondGroup_mem (α : NormalAction G M) (χ : PontryaginDual G) :
    (doubleRadonSecondGroupUnitary μ ν α χ :
      Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν) →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν)) ∈ doubleRadonAlgebra μ ν α :=
  subset_generatedBy _ (Or.inr (Set.mem_range_self χ))

/-- The original generated coordinate-model carrier is closed in the actual weak operator topology. -/
theorem doubleRadonAlgebra_isClosedWOT (α : NormalAction G M) :
    IsClosed {T : Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν) →WOT[ℂ] Lp H 2 (Measure.radonProd μ ν) |
      T.toCLM ∈ doubleRadonAlgebra μ ν α} :=
  generatedBy_isClosedWOT (doubleRadonGenerators μ ν α)

end

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalAction
public import Mathlib.Topology.Algebra.Group.CompactOpen

/-!
# Pullback of actual normal actions

A continuous group homomorphism pulls back the same original normal star
automorphisms and inverse predual orbits. Their norm continuity is composed
with the actual source homomorphism. No normal map or equivalence is chosen.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

namespace VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalAction

noncomputable section

universe uG uD uH

variable {G : Type uG} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G]
variable {D : Type uD} [Group D] [TopologicalSpace D]
variable {H : Type uH} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
variable {M : VonNeumannAlgebra H}

/-- Pull back the same actual normal action along a continuous group homomorphism. -/
def comp (β : NormalAction D M) (f : G →ₜ* D) : NormalAction G M where
  toMonoidHom := β.toMonoidHom.comp f.toMonoidHom
  continuous_predual_orbit φ := (β.continuous_predual_orbit φ).comp f.continuous

/-- Pullback keeps the exact original normal automorphism at every source group element. -/
@[simp]
theorem comp_apply (β : NormalAction D M) (f : G →ₜ* D) (g : G) :
    comp β f g = β (f g) :=
  rfl

end

end VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalAction
