module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalAction.Continuity
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Group.HaarL2.PointwiseOperator
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Group.HaarRegularRepresentation
public import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Operator.Basic

/-!
# The actual regular coefficient operator of a normal action

The original compact-support formula is alpha(s inverse)(x) applied to the
original vector at s. The existing normal-action vector continuity and
automorphism norm bound supply the shared bounded pointwise L2 construction.
These original regular-coefficient names are wrappers around that construction
on the actual source seminorm, its separation quotient and ordinary completion,
and the original Lp H 2 Haar carrier.

The shared operator retains the literal formula almost everywhere on every
Lp vector. The source action is normal with continuous predual orbits, rather
than a different norm-continuous C-star action. Connes's tensor transport is
separate.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open MeasureTheory MeasureTheory.HaarL2 Filter
open scoped ENNReal Topology CompactlySupported InnerProductSpace CStarAlgebra

namespace VonNeumannAlgebra
namespace NormalAction

noncomputable section

universe uG uH

variable {G : Type uG} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
  [LocallyCompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
variable {H : Type uH} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
variable {M : VonNeumannAlgebra H}

omit [LocallyCompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G] in
/-- The inverse-coordinate coefficient field has jointly continuous vector action. -/
theorem continuous_regularCoefficientField (α : NormalAction G M) (x : M) :
    Continuous fun p : G × H => (α p.1⁻¹ x : H →L[ℂ] H) p.2 :=
  (continuous_vector_action α x).comp
    ((continuous_inv.comp continuous_fst).prodMk continuous_snd)

omit [IsTopologicalGroup G] [LocallyCompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G] in
/-- The original algebra norm bounds every inverse-coordinate coefficient operator. -/
theorem regularCoefficientField_norm_le (α : NormalAction G M) (x : M) (s : G) :
    ‖(α s⁻¹ x : H →L[ℂ] H)‖ ≤ ‖x‖ := by
  change ‖α s⁻¹ x‖ ≤ ‖x‖
  exact (StarAlgEquiv.norm_map (α s⁻¹).toStarAlgEquiv x).le

omit [LocallyCompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G] in
/-- The original regular coefficient action on continuous compact-support vectors. -/
def regularCoefficientCompactSupport (α : NormalAction G M) (x : M) :
    C_c(G, H) →ₗ[ℂ] C_c(G, H) :=
  pointwiseCompactSupport (fun s => (α s⁻¹ x : H →L[ℂ] H))
    (continuous_regularCoefficientField α x)

omit [LocallyCompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G] in
/-- The compact-support action keeps the original inverse group-coordinate formula. -/
@[simp]
theorem regularCoefficientCompactSupport_apply (α : NormalAction G M) (x : M)
    (f : C_c(G, H)) (s : G) :
    regularCoefficientCompactSupport α x f s = (α s⁻¹ x : H →L[ℂ] H) (f s) :=
  rfl

variable (μ : Measure G) [μ.Regular]

omit [LocallyCompactSpace G] in
/-- The original operator norm bounds the actual compact-support L2 images. -/
theorem regularCoefficientCompactSupport_l2Bound (α : NormalAction G M) (x : M)
    (f : C_c(G, H)) :
    ‖compactSupportInclusion μ (regularCoefficientCompactSupport α x f)‖ ≤
      ‖x‖ * ‖compactSupportInclusion μ f‖ :=
  pointwiseCompactSupport_l2Bound (fun s => (α s⁻¹ x : H →L[ℂ] H))
    (continuous_regularCoefficientField α x) μ ‖x‖ (regularCoefficientField_norm_le α x) f

omit [LocallyCompactSpace G] in
/-- The bounded compact-support coefficient map descends and extends through the genuine source completion. -/
def regularCoefficientSourceMap (α : NormalAction G M) (x : M) :
    CompletionCore (H := H) μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ :=
  pointwiseSourceMap (fun s => (α s⁻¹ x : H →L[ℂ] H))
    (continuous_regularCoefficientField α x) μ ‖x‖ (regularCoefficientField_norm_le α x)

omit [LocallyCompactSpace G] in
/-- The extended source map retains each original compact-support coefficient image. -/
theorem regularCoefficientSourceMap_apply (α : NormalAction G M) (x : M) (f : C_c(G, H)) :
    regularCoefficientSourceMap μ α x (toCompletion μ f) =
      compactSupportInclusion μ (regularCoefficientCompactSupport α x f) :=
  pointwiseSourceMap_apply (fun s => (α s⁻¹ x : H →L[ℂ] H))
    (continuous_regularCoefficientField α x) μ ‖x‖ (regularCoefficientField_norm_le α x) f

/-- The actual regular coefficient operator on the same original Haar Lp H 2 carrier. -/
def regularCoefficient (α : NormalAction G M) (x : M) : Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ :=
  pointwiseOperator (fun s => (α s⁻¹ x : H →L[ℂ] H))
    (continuous_regularCoefficientField α x) μ ‖x‖ (regularCoefficientField_norm_le α x)

/-- The actual Lp operator retains the exact compact-support inverse-action formula. -/
theorem regularCoefficient_apply_compactSupport (α : NormalAction G M) (x : M)
    (f : C_c(G, H)) :
    regularCoefficient μ α x (compactSupportInclusion μ f) =
      compactSupportInclusion μ (regularCoefficientCompactSupport α x f) :=
  pointwiseOperator_apply_compactSupport (fun s => (α s⁻¹ x : H →L[ℂ] H))
    (continuous_regularCoefficientField α x) μ ‖x‖ (regularCoefficientField_norm_le α x) f

/-- Every actual Lp vector has the literal original regular coefficient representative almost everywhere. -/
theorem regularCoefficient_ae_eq (α : NormalAction G M) (x : M) (ξ : Lp H 2 μ) :
    regularCoefficient μ α x ξ =ᵐ[μ] fun s : G => (α s⁻¹ x : H →L[ℂ] H) (ξ s) :=
  pointwiseOperator_ae_eq (fun s => (α s⁻¹ x : H →L[ℂ] H))
    (continuous_regularCoefficientField α x) μ ‖x‖ (regularCoefficientField_norm_le α x) ξ

/-- The actual original algebra norm bounds every Haar L2 vector image. -/
theorem regularCoefficient_norm_apply_le (α : NormalAction G M) (x : M) (ξ : Lp H 2 μ) :
    ‖regularCoefficient μ α x ξ‖ ≤ ‖x‖ * ‖ξ‖ :=
  pointwiseOperator_norm_apply_le (fun s => (α s⁻¹ x : H →L[ℂ] H))
    (continuous_regularCoefficientField α x) μ ‖x‖ (regularCoefficientField_norm_le α x) ξ

/-- The same actual coefficient operator on the original separated C_c completion. -/
def regularCoefficientOriginal (α : NormalAction G M) (x : M) :
    CompletionCore (H := H) μ →L[ℂ] CompletionCore (H := H) μ :=
  (completionToLp (H := H) μ).symm.toLinearIsometry.toContinuousLinearMap.comp
    ((regularCoefficient μ α x).comp
      (completionToLp (H := H) μ).toLinearIsometry.toContinuousLinearMap)

/-- The original source-completion operator has the original compact-support coordinate formula. -/
theorem regularCoefficientOriginal_apply (α : NormalAction G M) (x : M) (f : C_c(G, H)) :
    regularCoefficientOriginal μ α x (toCompletion μ f) =
      toCompletion μ (regularCoefficientCompactSupport α x f) := by
  change (completionToLp (H := H) μ).symm
      (regularCoefficient μ α x ((completionToLp (H := H) μ) (toCompletion μ f))) = _
  rw [completionToLp_apply, regularCoefficient_apply_compactSupport,
    ← completionToLp_apply μ (regularCoefficientCompactSupport α x f),
    LinearIsometryEquiv.symm_apply_apply]

end

end NormalAction
end VonNeumannAlgebra

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalAction.RegularCoefficient
public import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.ContinuousLinearMap

/-!
# The actual regular coefficient star homomorphism and Haar covariance

All algebra laws come from the original pointwise normal automorphism on
the same Haar L2 representatives. The original Hilbert adjoint identity
gives star preservation. Haar left translation supplies the genuine
covariance equation for this normal action, without a point-norm action
assumption or a selected normal/faithful representation theorem.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open MeasureTheory MeasureTheory.HaarL2 Filter
open scoped ENNReal Topology CompactlySupported InnerProductSpace CStarAlgebra

namespace VonNeumannAlgebra
namespace NormalAction

noncomputable section

universe uG uH

variable {G : Type uG} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
  [LocallyCompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
variable {H : Type uH} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
variable {M : VonNeumannAlgebra H}
variable (μ : Measure G) [μ.Regular]

/-- The original coefficient action preserves actual algebra sums. -/
theorem regularCoefficient_add (α : NormalAction G M) (x y : M) :
    regularCoefficient μ α (x + y) = regularCoefficient μ α x + regularCoefficient μ α y := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro ξ
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [regularCoefficient_ae_eq μ α (x + y) ξ,
    regularCoefficient_ae_eq μ α x ξ, regularCoefficient_ae_eq μ α y ξ,
    Lp.coeFn_add (regularCoefficient μ α x ξ) (regularCoefficient μ α y ξ)] with s h₁ h₂ h₃ h₄
  change regularCoefficient μ α (x + y) ξ s =
    (regularCoefficient μ α x ξ + regularCoefficient μ α y ξ) s
  rw [h₁, h₄]
  change (α s⁻¹ (x + y) : H →L[ℂ] H) (ξ s) =
    regularCoefficient μ α x ξ s + regularCoefficient μ α y ξ s
  rw [h₂, h₃, map_add]
  rfl

/-- The actual coefficient action preserves the original complex scalars. -/
theorem regularCoefficient_smul (α : NormalAction G M) (c : ℂ) (x : M) :
    regularCoefficient μ α (c • x) = c • regularCoefficient μ α x := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro ξ
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [regularCoefficient_ae_eq μ α (c • x) ξ,
    regularCoefficient_ae_eq μ α x ξ,
    Lp.coeFn_smul c (regularCoefficient μ α x ξ)] with s h₁ h₂ h₃
  change regularCoefficient μ α (c • x) ξ s = (c • regularCoefficient μ α x ξ) s
  rw [h₁, h₃]
  change (α s⁻¹ (c • x) : H →L[ℂ] H) (ξ s) = c • regularCoefficient μ α x ξ s
  rw [h₂, map_smul]
  rfl

/-- The original coefficient action preserves algebra products on the same L2 vectors. -/
theorem regularCoefficient_mul (α : NormalAction G M) (x y : M) :
    regularCoefficient μ α (x * y) = regularCoefficient μ α x * regularCoefficient μ α y := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro ξ
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [regularCoefficient_ae_eq μ α (x * y) ξ,
    regularCoefficient_ae_eq μ α x (regularCoefficient μ α y ξ),
    regularCoefficient_ae_eq μ α y ξ] with s h₁ h₂ h₃
  change regularCoefficient μ α (x * y) ξ s =
    regularCoefficient μ α x (regularCoefficient μ α y ξ) s
  rw [h₁, h₂, h₃, map_mul]
  rfl

/-- The original algebra unit acts as the identity on the actual Haar L2 carrier. -/
theorem regularCoefficient_one (α : NormalAction G M) :
    regularCoefficient μ α (1 : M) = 1 := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro ξ
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [regularCoefficient_ae_eq μ α (1 : M) ξ] with s hs
  change regularCoefficient μ α (1 : M) ξ s = ξ s
  rw [hs, map_one]
  rfl

/-- The original coefficient involution becomes the actual Hilbert operator adjoint. -/
theorem regularCoefficient_star (α : NormalAction G M) (x : M) :
    regularCoefficient μ α (star x) = star (regularCoefficient μ α x) := by
  rw [ContinuousLinearMap.star_eq_adjoint]
  apply (ContinuousLinearMap.eq_adjoint_iff
    (regularCoefficient μ α (star x)) (regularCoefficient μ α x)).mpr
  intro ξ η
  rw [L2.inner_def, L2.inner_def]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [regularCoefficient_ae_eq μ α (star x) ξ,
    regularCoefficient_ae_eq μ α x η] with s h₁ h₂
  rw [h₁, h₂, map_star]
  change ⟪star (α s⁻¹ x : H →L[ℂ] H) (ξ s), η s⟫_ℂ =
    ⟪ξ s, (α s⁻¹ x : H →L[ℂ] H) (η s)⟫_ℂ
  rw [ContinuousLinearMap.star_eq_adjoint]
  exact ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_left (α s⁻¹ x : H →L[ℂ] H) (η s) (ξ s)

/-- The source compact-support vectors retain the original coefficient adjoint pairing. -/
theorem regularCoefficient_inner_compactSupport (α : NormalAction G M) (x : M)
    (f g : C_c(G, H)) :
    ⟪regularCoefficient μ α x (compactSupportInclusion μ f), compactSupportInclusion μ g⟫_ℂ =
      ⟪compactSupportInclusion μ f,
        regularCoefficient μ α (star x) (compactSupportInclusion μ g)⟫_ℂ := by
  rw [regularCoefficient_star, ContinuousLinearMap.star_eq_adjoint]
  exact (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_right (regularCoefficient μ α x)
    (compactSupportInclusion μ f) (compactSupportInclusion μ g)).symm

/-- The genuine original regular coefficient representation as a unital complex star homomorphism. -/
def regularCoefficientHom (α : NormalAction G M) : M →⋆ₐ[ℂ] (Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) where
  toFun := regularCoefficient μ α
  map_one' := regularCoefficient_one μ α
  map_mul' := regularCoefficient_mul μ α
  map_zero' := by
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
    intro ξ
    apply Lp.ext
    filter_upwards [regularCoefficient_ae_eq μ α (0 : M) ξ,
      Lp.coeFn_zero H 2 μ] with s h₁ h₂
    change regularCoefficient μ α (0 : M) ξ s = (0 : Lp H 2 μ) s
    rw [h₁, h₂, map_zero]
    rfl
  map_add' := regularCoefficient_add μ α
  commutes' c := by
    simp only [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one,
      regularCoefficient_smul, regularCoefficient_one]
  map_star' := regularCoefficient_star μ α

variable [μ.IsHaarMeasure]

/-- The actual Haar left unitaries and original coefficient homomorphism satisfy normal-action covariance. -/
theorem regularCoefficient_covariance (α : NormalAction G M) (g : G) (x : M) :
    (StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.haarLeftRegular G μ H g :
        Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) * regularCoefficient μ α x *
      star (StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.haarLeftRegular G μ H g :
        Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) = regularCoefficient μ α (α g x) := by
  rw [StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.star_haarLeftRegular]
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro ξ
  apply Lp.ext
  let L (h : G) : Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ :=
    StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.haarLeftRegular G μ H h
  let η := L g⁻¹ ξ
  have houter := StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.haarLeftRegular_ae_eq G μ H g
    (regularCoefficient μ α x η)
  have hcoefficient := regularCoefficient_ae_eq μ α x η
  have hinner := StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.haarLeftRegular_ae_eq G μ H g⁻¹ ξ
  have hpres : MeasurePreserving (fun s : G => g⁻¹ * s) μ μ := measurePreserving_smul g⁻¹ μ
  have hquasi : QuasiMeasurePreserving (fun s : G => g⁻¹ * s) μ μ :=
    ⟨hpres.measurable, by rw [hpres.map_eq]⟩
  have hcoefficient' := hquasi.ae_eq_comp hcoefficient
  have hinner' := hquasi.ae_eq_comp hinner
  filter_upwards [houter, hcoefficient', hinner', regularCoefficient_ae_eq μ α (α g x) ξ]
    with s h₁ h₂ h₃ h₄
  change L g (regularCoefficient μ α x (L g⁻¹ ξ)) s = regularCoefficient μ α (α g x) ξ s
  simp only [Function.comp_apply] at h₂ h₃
  rw [h₁, h₂, h₃, h₄]
  simp only [mul_inv_rev, inv_inv, mul_inv_cancel_left]
  rw [map_mul, NormalStarAlgEquiv.mul_apply]

end

end NormalAction
end VonNeumannAlgebra

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.TensorCommutant
public import MathlibExt.MeasureTheory.Function.L2Space.TensorMap
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalAction.TensorCoefficient

/-!
# The original coefficient's actual spatial ambient range

The original tensor coefficient commutes with every constant operator from
the original source commutant. The full-right commutant extraction and the
actual bicommutant identity put it in M tensor B(L2). Its subtype star map
retains the same operator values. The stronger Connes M tensor LInfinity
coefficient target is a separate unfinished source clause.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open MeasureTheory Filter
open scoped TensorProduct ENNReal Topology

namespace VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalAction

noncomputable section

universe uG uH

variable {G : Type uG} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
  [LocallyCompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
variable {H : Type uH} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
variable {M : VonNeumannAlgebra H}
variable (μ : Measure G) [μ.Regular]

/-- The original tensor coefficient belongs to the actual source spatial ambient algebra. -/
theorem regularCoefficientTensor_mem_spatialTensorProduct
    (α : NormalAction G M) (x : M) :
    regularCoefficientTensor μ α x ∈ spatialTensorProduct M (⊤ : VonNeumannAlgebra (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) := by
  let E := L2.tensorToLpRight (𝕜 := ℂ) (H := H) μ
  have hpi (z : UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ))) :
      E (regularCoefficientTensor μ α x z) = regularCoefficient μ α x (E z) := by
    change E (E.symm (regularCoefficient μ α x (E z))) = _
    exact E.apply_symm_apply _
  have hconstant (B : H →L[ℂ] H) (z : UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ))) :
      E (TensorProduct.mapLCompletion B (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) z) =
        B.compLpL 2 μ (E z) :=
    L2.tensorToLpRight_mapLCompletion μ B z
  have hcomm (B : H →L[ℂ] H) (hB : B ∈ M.commutant) :
      TensorProduct.mapLCompletion B (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) *
          regularCoefficientTensor μ α x =
        regularCoefficientTensor μ α x *
          TensorProduct.mapLCompletion B (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) := by
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
    intro z
    apply E.injective
    change E (TensorProduct.mapLCompletion B (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ (Lp ℂ 2 μ))
        (regularCoefficientTensor μ α x z)) =
      E (regularCoefficientTensor μ α x
        (TensorProduct.mapLCompletion B (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) z))
    rw [hconstant, hpi, hpi, hconstant]
    apply Lp.ext
    filter_upwards [B.coeFn_compLpL (regularCoefficient μ α x (E z)),
      regularCoefficient_ae_eq μ α x (E z),
      regularCoefficient_ae_eq μ α x (B.compLpL 2 μ (E z)), B.coeFn_compLpL (E z)]
      with s hleft hcoefficient hright hvector
    rw [hleft, hcoefficient, hright, hvector]
    have he := mem_commutant_iff.mp hB (α s⁻¹ x : H →L[ℂ] H) (α s⁻¹ x).property
    exact (congrArg (fun C : H →L[ℂ] H => C (E z s)) he).symm
  rw [← (spatialTensorProduct M (⊤ : VonNeumannAlgebra (Lp ℂ 2 μ))).commutant_commutant]
  apply mem_commutant_iff.mpr
  intro A hA
  obtain ⟨B, hB, hAB⟩ := exists_mapLCompletion_id_of_mem_commutant_spatialTensorProduct_top M A hA
  rw [hAB]
  exact hcomm B hB

/-- The original coefficient star homomorphism restricted to its proved spatial codomain. -/
def regularCoefficientSpatialHom (α : NormalAction G M) :
    M →⋆ₐ[ℂ] spatialTensorProduct M (⊤ : VonNeumannAlgebra (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) where
  toFun x := ⟨regularCoefficientTensor μ α x, regularCoefficientTensor_mem_spatialTensorProduct μ α x⟩
  map_one' := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact map_one (regularCoefficientTensorHom μ α)
  map_mul' x y := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact map_mul (regularCoefficientTensorHom μ α) x y
  map_zero' := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact map_zero (regularCoefficientTensorHom μ α)
  map_add' x y := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact map_add (regularCoefficientTensorHom μ α) x y
  commutes' c := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact (regularCoefficientTensorHom μ α).commutes c
  map_star' x := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact map_star (regularCoefficientTensorHom μ α) x

end

end VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalAction

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalAction.CrossedProductTensor
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalAction.CharacterCovariance
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Group.HaarL2.TensorCharacterMultiplier
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.UnitaryAction

/-!
# The original normal dual character action on the H-first tensor crossed product

The actual id_H tensor scalar character unitary fixes the original tensor
coefficients and scales the original id_H tensor Haar operators. Those
literal generator formulas preserve the same source generated algebra.
The verified generic normalizing unitary constructor provides its normal
actual dual action and all norm-continuous inverse predual orbits.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open MeasureTheory MeasureTheory.HaarL2
open scoped TensorProduct CStarAlgebra

namespace VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalAction

noncomputable section

universe uG uH

variable {G : Type uG} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
  [LocallyCompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
variable {H : Type uH} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
variable {M : VonNeumannAlgebra H}
variable (μ : Measure G) [μ.IsHaarMeasure] [μ.Regular]

omit [μ.IsHaarMeasure] in
/-- The actual right-tensor character unitary fixes every original tensor coefficient operator. -/
theorem characterMultiplierTensor_fix_regularCoefficientTensor (α : NormalAction G M)
    (χ : PontryaginDual G) (x : M) :
    (characterMultiplierTensorRepresentation (H := H) μ χ :
        UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) →L[ℂ]
          UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ))) * regularCoefficientTensor μ α x *
      star (characterMultiplierTensorRepresentation (H := H) μ χ :
        UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) →L[ℂ]
          UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ))) = regularCoefficientTensor μ α x := by
  let E := L2.tensorToLpRight (𝕜 := ℂ) (H := H) μ
  let e := E.conjStarAlgEquiv
  let U := (characterMultiplierTensorRepresentation (H := H) μ χ :
    UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) →L[ℂ]
      UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)))
  let P := regularCoefficientTensor μ α x
  have hU : e U = (characterMultiplierUnitary (H := H) μ χ : Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) :=
    characterMultiplierTensor_conjStarAlgEquiv μ χ
  have hP : e P = regularCoefficient μ α x := by
    have he : P = e.symm (regularCoefficient μ α x) := rfl
    rw [he]
    exact e.apply_symm_apply _
  apply e.injective
  calc
    e (U * P * star U) = e (U * P) * e (star U) := map_mul e _ _
    _ = (e U * e P) * star (e U) :=
      congrArg₂ (fun A B : Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ => A * B) (map_mul e U P) (map_star e U)
    _ = (characterMultiplierUnitary (H := H) μ χ : Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) *
        regularCoefficient μ α x * star (characterMultiplierUnitary (H := H) μ χ :
          Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) := by rw [hU, hP]
    _ = regularCoefficient μ α x := characterMultiplier_fix_regularCoefficient μ α χ x
    _ = e P := hP.symm

/-- The actual right-tensor character unitary scales the original tensor Haar implementer by χ(g). -/
theorem characterMultiplierTensor_scale_haarLeftRegularTensor (χ : PontryaginDual G) (g : G) :
    (characterMultiplierTensorRepresentation (H := H) μ χ :
        UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) →L[ℂ]
          UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ))) *
      (StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.haarLeftRegularTensor G μ H g :
        UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) →L[ℂ]
          UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ))) *
      star (characterMultiplierTensorRepresentation (H := H) μ χ :
        UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) →L[ℂ]
          UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ))) =
        ((χ g : Circle) : ℂ) • (StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.haarLeftRegularTensor G μ H g :
          UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) →L[ℂ]
            UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ))) := by
  let E := L2.tensorToLpRight (𝕜 := ℂ) (H := H) μ
  let e := E.conjStarAlgEquiv
  let U := (characterMultiplierTensorRepresentation (H := H) μ χ :
    UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) →L[ℂ]
      UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)))
  let L := (StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.haarLeftRegularTensor G μ H g :
    UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) →L[ℂ]
      UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)))
  have hU : e U = (characterMultiplierUnitary (H := H) μ χ : Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) :=
    characterMultiplierTensor_conjStarAlgEquiv μ χ
  have hL : e L = (StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.haarLeftRegular G μ H g :
      Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) :=
    StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.haarLeftRegularTensor_conjStarAlgEquiv G μ H g
  apply e.injective
  calc
    e (U * L * star U) = e (U * L) * e (star U) := map_mul e _ _
    _ = (e U * e L) * star (e U) :=
      congrArg₂ (fun A B : Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ => A * B) (map_mul e U L) (map_star e U)
    _ = (characterMultiplierUnitary (H := H) μ χ : Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) *
        (StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.haarLeftRegular G μ H g :
          Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) * star (characterMultiplierUnitary (H := H) μ χ :
            Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) := by rw [hU, hL]
    _ = ((χ g : Circle) : ℂ) • (StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation.haarLeftRegular G μ H g :
        Lp H 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp H 2 μ) := characterMultiplier_scale_haarLeftRegular μ χ g
    _ = ((χ g : Circle) : ℂ) • e L := by rw [hL]
    _ = e (((χ g : Circle) : ℂ) • L) := (map_smul e ((χ g : Circle) : ℂ) L).symm

/-- The original right-tensor character conjugation preserves the actual generated tensor carrier. -/
theorem tensorCharacterConjugation_mem_crossedProductTensor (α : NormalAction G M) (χ : PontryaginDual G)
    (T : UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) →L[ℂ]
      UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ))) (hT : T ∈ crossedProductTensor μ α) :
    (characterMultiplierTensorRepresentation (H := H) μ χ :
        UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) →L[ℂ]
          UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ))) * T *
      star (characterMultiplierTensorRepresentation (H := H) μ χ :
        UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) →L[ℂ]
          UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ))) ∈ crossedProductTensor μ α := by
  apply unitaryConjugation_generatedBy_mem (crossedProductTensorGenerators μ α)
    (characterMultiplierTensorRepresentation (H := H) μ χ) ?_ T hT
  intro A hA
  rcases hA with (⟨x, rfl⟩ | ⟨g, rfl⟩)
  · rw [characterMultiplierTensor_fix_regularCoefficientTensor μ α χ x]
    exact StarAlgebra.subset_adjoin ℂ _ (Or.inl (Set.mem_range_self x))
  · rw [characterMultiplierTensor_scale_haarLeftRegularTensor μ χ g]
    exact (StarAlgebra.adjoin ℂ (crossedProductTensorGenerators μ α)).smul_mem
      (StarAlgebra.subset_adjoin ℂ _ (Or.inr (Set.mem_range_self g))) _

/-- The original right-tensor character unitary has the exact source normalization equality. -/
theorem tensorCharacterConjugation_normalizes (α : NormalAction G M) (χ : PontryaginDual G) :
    (fun T : UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) →L[ℂ]
        UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) =>
      (characterMultiplierTensorRepresentation (H := H) μ χ :
          UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) →L[ℂ]
            UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ))) * T *
        star (characterMultiplierTensorRepresentation (H := H) μ χ :
          UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) →L[ℂ]
            UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)))) ''
      (crossedProductTensor μ α : Set (UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) →L[ℂ]
        UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)))) =
      (crossedProductTensor μ α : Set (UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) →L[ℂ]
        UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)))) := by
  apply unitaryConjugationStarAlgEquiv_image (crossedProductTensor μ α)
    (characterMultiplierTensorRepresentation (H := H) μ χ)
    (tensorCharacterConjugation_mem_crossedProductTensor μ α χ)
  intro T hT
  have hstar : characterMultiplierTensorRepresentation (H := H) μ χ⁻¹ =
      star (characterMultiplierTensorRepresentation (H := H) μ χ) :=
    (characterMultiplierTensorRepresentation (H := H) μ).toMonoidHom.map_inv χ
  have hinv := tensorCharacterConjugation_mem_crossedProductTensor μ α χ⁻¹ T hT
  simpa only [hstar, Unitary.coe_star, star_star] using hinv

/-- The original tensor crossed product has its actual normal dual character action. -/
def tensorCharacterNormalAction (α : NormalAction G M) :
    NormalAction (PontryaginDual G) (crossedProductTensor μ α) :=
  unitaryConjugationNormalAction (crossedProductTensor μ α)
    (characterMultiplierTensorRepresentation (H := H) μ) (tensorCharacterConjugation_normalizes μ α)

/-- The original tensor dual action fixes the canonical original source coefficient. -/
theorem tensorCharacterNormalAction_fix_coefficient (α : NormalAction G M) (χ : PontryaginDual G) (x : M) :
    tensorCharacterNormalAction μ α χ (crossedProductTensorCoefficient μ α x) =
      crossedProductTensorCoefficient μ α x := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change (unitaryConjugationNormalHom (crossedProductTensor μ α)
    (characterMultiplierTensorRepresentation (H := H) μ) (tensorCharacterConjugation_normalizes μ α)
      χ (crossedProductTensorCoefficient μ α x) :
        UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) →L[ℂ]
          UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ))) = _
  rw [unitaryConjugationNormalHom_apply, crossedProductTensorCoefficient_apply]
  exact characterMultiplierTensor_fix_regularCoefficientTensor μ α χ x

/-- The original tensor dual action has Connes's positive χ(g) scaling of the original Haar generator. -/
theorem tensorCharacterNormalAction_scale_group (α : NormalAction G M) (χ : PontryaginDual G) (g : G) :
    tensorCharacterNormalAction μ α χ (crossedProductTensorGroupUnitary μ α g : crossedProductTensor μ α) =
      ((χ g : Circle) : ℂ) • (crossedProductTensorGroupUnitary μ α g : crossedProductTensor μ α) := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change (unitaryConjugationNormalHom (crossedProductTensor μ α)
    (characterMultiplierTensorRepresentation (H := H) μ) (tensorCharacterConjugation_normalizes μ α)
      χ (crossedProductTensorGroupUnitary μ α g : crossedProductTensor μ α) :
        UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) →L[ℂ]
          UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ))) = _
  rw [unitaryConjugationNormalHom_apply, crossedProductTensorGroupUnitary_coe]
  exact characterMultiplierTensor_scale_haarLeftRegularTensor μ χ g

end

end VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalAction

Author: @toskua

module

public import MathlibExt.MeasureTheory.Function.L2Space.RightTensorProduct
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalAction.RegularCoefficientAlgebra

/-!
# The original coefficient action on the H-first Hilbert tensor

The source normal action acts through the actual coefficient operator and
computed tensor/L2 coordinates. The source tensor order, coefficient norm
bound, pointwise values and star-algebra laws are retained. These are the
plain bounded tensor coefficients needed by the spatial-range constructor.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open MeasureTheory MeasureTheory.HaarL2 Filter
open scoped TensorProduct ENNReal Topology CompactlySupported InnerProductSpace CStarAlgebra

namespace VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalAction

noncomputable section

universe uG uH

variable {G : Type uG} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
  [LocallyCompactSpace G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
variable {H : Type uH} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
variable {M : VonNeumannAlgebra H}
variable (μ : Measure G) [μ.Regular]

/-- The original bounded coefficient operator on the actual H-first completed Hilbert tensor. -/
def regularCoefficientTensor (α : NormalAction G M) (x : M) :
    UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) →L[ℂ]
      UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) :=
  (L2.tensorToLpRight (𝕜 := ℂ) (H := H) μ).symm.conjStarAlgEquiv (regularCoefficient μ α x)

/-- The original tensor coefficient action with its actual unital complex star-algebra laws. -/
def regularCoefficientTensorHom (α : NormalAction G M) :
    M →⋆ₐ[ℂ] (UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) →L[ℂ]
      UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ))) :=
  (L2.tensorToLpRight (𝕜 := ℂ) (H := H) μ).symm.conjStarAlgEquiv.toStarAlgHom.comp
    (regularCoefficientHom μ α)

/-- The tensor coefficient homomorphism has the same original bounded operator value. -/
@[simp]
theorem regularCoefficientTensorHom_apply (α : NormalAction G M) (x : M) :
    regularCoefficientTensorHom μ α x = regularCoefficientTensor μ α x :=
  rfl

/-- The actual source algebra norm bounds the original tensor coefficient operator. -/
theorem norm_regularCoefficientTensor_le (α : NormalAction G M) (x : M) :
    ‖regularCoefficientTensor μ α x‖ ≤ ‖x‖ := by
  let E := L2.tensorToLpRight (𝕜 := ℂ) (H := H) μ
  apply (regularCoefficientTensor μ α x).opNorm_le_bound (norm_nonneg x)
  intro z
  change ‖E.symm (regularCoefficient μ α x (E z))‖ ≤ ‖x‖ * ‖z‖
  rw [E.symm.norm_map]
  simpa only [E.norm_map] using regularCoefficient_norm_apply_le μ α x (E z)

/-- In actual L2 coordinates, every tensor coefficient has the original pointwise representative. -/
theorem regularCoefficientTensor_ae_eq (α : NormalAction G M) (x : M)
    (z : UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ))) :
    L2.tensorToLpRight μ (regularCoefficientTensor μ α x z) =ᵐ[μ]
      fun s => (α s⁻¹ x : H →L[ℂ] H) (L2.tensorToLpRight μ z s) := by
  let E := L2.tensorToLpRight (𝕜 := ℂ) (H := H) μ
  change E (E.symm (regularCoefficient μ α x (E z))) =ᵐ[μ] _
  rw [E.apply_symm_apply]
  exact regularCoefficient_ae_eq μ α x (E z)

/-- The original pure compact-support scalar tensor has the exact source coefficient formula. -/
theorem regularCoefficientTensor_apply_compactSupport_tmul_ae (α : NormalAction G M) (x : M)
    (f : C_c(G, ℂ)) (ξ : H) :
    L2.tensorToLpRight μ
        (regularCoefficientTensor μ α x
          ((ξ ⊗ₜ[ℂ] compactSupportInclusion (H := ℂ) μ f : H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) :
            UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)))) =ᵐ[μ]
      fun s => (α s⁻¹ x : H →L[ℂ] H) (f s • ξ) := by
  have hpure := L2.tensorToLpRight_tmul_ae (𝕜 := ℂ) μ ξ (compactSupportInclusion (H := ℂ) μ f)
  have hscalar := compactSupportInclusion_ae_eq (H := ℂ) μ f
  filter_upwards [regularCoefficientTensor_ae_eq μ α x
    ((ξ ⊗ₜ[ℂ] compactSupportInclusion (H := ℂ) μ f : H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) :
      UniformSpace.Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] (Lp ℂ 2 μ))), hpure, hscalar] with s hcoeff hvector hscalar
  rw [hcoeff, hvector, hscalar]

end

end VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalAction

Author: @toskua
-/
module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalHom
public import Mathlib.Topology.Algebra.Module.Equiv.Basic

/-!
# Compositional normal equivalences and actual predual automorphisms

Normal equivalences retain both original star maps and their ultraweak
continuity. Their identity, inverse and composition form the actual normal
automorphism group. Functional pullback gives the continuous linear predual
equivalence, and inverse pullback gives its covariant automorphism action.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

namespace VonNeumannAlgebra

noncomputable section

universe u v w

variable {H : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
variable {K : Type v} [NormedAddCommGroup K] [InnerProductSpace ℂ K] [CompleteSpace K]

/-- An actual complex star algebra equivalence that is ultraweak continuous in both directions. -/
structure NormalStarAlgEquiv (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (N : VonNeumannAlgebra K) where
  /-- The original complex star algebra equivalence of the concrete carriers. -/
  toStarAlgEquiv : M ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] N
  /-- Ultraweak continuity of the same original forward map. -/
  continuous_ultraweak :
    Continuous fun x : Ultraweak M =>
      (ultraweakLinearEquiv N).symm (toStarAlgEquiv (ultraweakLinearEquiv M x))
  /-- Ultraweak continuity of the same original inverse map. -/
  continuous_ultraweak_symm :
    Continuous fun x : Ultraweak N =>
      (ultraweakLinearEquiv M).symm (toStarAlgEquiv.symm (ultraweakLinearEquiv N x))

namespace NormalStarAlgEquiv

variable {M : VonNeumannAlgebra H} {N : VonNeumannAlgebra K}

/-- The original star equivalence determines both maps of a normal equivalence. -/
@[ext]
theorem ext {f g : NormalStarAlgEquiv M N}
    (h : f.toStarAlgEquiv = g.toStarAlgEquiv) : f = g := by
  cases f
  cases g
  cases h
  rfl

instance : EquivLike (NormalStarAlgEquiv M N) M N where
  coe f := f.toStarAlgEquiv
  inv f := f.toStarAlgEquiv.symm
  left_inv f := f.toStarAlgEquiv.left_inv
  right_inv f := f.toStarAlgEquiv.right_inv
  coe_injective' f g h _ := by
    have hmap : f.toStarAlgEquiv = g.toStarAlgEquiv :=
      DFunLike.ext _ _ fun x => congrFun h x
    exact ext hmap

instance : Coe (NormalStarAlgEquiv M N) (M ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] N) := ⟨toStarAlgEquiv⟩

instance : AlgEquivClass (NormalStarAlgEquiv M N) ℂ M N where
  map_mul f := map_mul f.toStarAlgEquiv
  map_add f := map_add f.toStarAlgEquiv
  commutes f := AlgHomClass.commutes f.toStarAlgEquiv

instance : StarHomClass (NormalStarAlgEquiv M N) M N where
  map_star f := map_star f.toStarAlgEquiv

/-- The forgetful star equivalence uses the same original value. -/
@[simp]
theorem toStarAlgEquiv_apply (f : NormalStarAlgEquiv M N) (x : M) :
    f.toStarAlgEquiv x = f x :=
  rfl

/-- Forget the inverse map while retaining the actual normal homomorphism. -/
def toNormalStarAlgHom (f : NormalStarAlgEquiv M N) : NormalStarAlgHom M N where
  toStarAlgHom := f.toStarAlgEquiv.toStarAlgHom
  continuous_ultraweak := f.continuous_ultraweak

/-- The normal homomorphism conversion preserves original values. -/
@[simp]
theorem toNormalStarAlgHom_apply (f : NormalStarAlgEquiv M N) (x : M) :
    f.toNormalStarAlgHom x = f x :=
  rfl

/-- The identity normal equivalence on the original algebra. -/
def refl (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) : NormalStarAlgEquiv M M where
  toStarAlgEquiv := StarAlgEquiv.refl ℂ M
  continuous_ultraweak := by
    have hfun :
        (fun x : Ultraweak M => (ultraweakLinearEquiv M).symm
          (StarAlgEquiv.refl ℂ M (ultraweakLinearEquiv M x))) =
        (_root_.id : Ultraweak M → Ultraweak M) := by
      funext x
      change (ultraweakLinearEquiv M).symm (ultraweakLinearEquiv M x) = x
      exact (ultraweakLinearEquiv M).symm_apply_apply x
    rw [hfun]
    exact continuous_id
  continuous_ultraweak_symm := by
    have hfun :
        (fun x : Ultraweak M => (ultraweakLinearEquiv M).symm
          ((StarAlgEquiv.refl ℂ M).symm (ultraweakLinearEquiv M x))) =
        (_root_.id : Ultraweak M → Ultraweak M) := by
      funext x
      change (ultraweakLinearEquiv M).symm (ultraweakLinearEquiv M x) = x
      exact (ultraweakLinearEquiv M).symm_apply_apply x
    rw [hfun]
    exact continuous_id

/-- Identity acts by the original algebra element. -/
@[simp]
theorem refl_apply (x : M) : refl M x = x :=
  rfl

/-- Invert a normal equivalence using the same original inverse map. -/
def symm (f : NormalStarAlgEquiv M N) : NormalStarAlgEquiv N M where
  toStarAlgEquiv := f.toStarAlgEquiv.symm
  continuous_ultraweak := f.continuous_ultraweak_symm
  continuous_ultraweak_symm := by
    have hfun :
        (fun x : Ultraweak M => (ultraweakLinearEquiv N).symm
          (f.toStarAlgEquiv.symm.symm (ultraweakLinearEquiv M x))) =
        (fun x : Ultraweak M => (ultraweakLinearEquiv N).symm
          (f.toStarAlgEquiv (ultraweakLinearEquiv M x))) := by
      funext x
      exact congrArg (fun e : M ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] N =>
        (ultraweakLinearEquiv N).symm (e (ultraweakLinearEquiv M x)))
        f.toStarAlgEquiv.symm_symm
    rw [hfun]
    exact f.continuous_ultraweak

/-- The normal inverse and original inverse have the same values. -/
theorem symm_apply (f : NormalStarAlgEquiv M N) (x : N) :
    f.symm x = f.toStarAlgEquiv.symm x :=
  rfl

/-- The original inverse recovers the source element. -/
@[simp]
theorem symm_apply_apply (f : NormalStarAlgEquiv M N) (x : M) : f.symm (f x) = x :=
  f.toStarAlgEquiv.symm_apply_apply x

/-- The original forward map recovers the target element. -/
@[simp]
theorem apply_symm_apply (f : NormalStarAlgEquiv M N) (x : N) : f (f.symm x) = x :=
  f.toStarAlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply x

/-- Inversion twice retains the same normal equivalence. -/
@[simp]
theorem symm_symm (f : NormalStarAlgEquiv M N) : f.symm.symm = f := by
  apply ext
  exact f.toStarAlgEquiv.symm_symm

variable {L : Type w} [NormedAddCommGroup L] [InnerProductSpace ℂ L] [CompleteSpace L]
variable {P : VonNeumannAlgebra L}

/-- Compose normal equivalences by the same original forward and inverse maps. -/
def trans (f : NormalStarAlgEquiv M N) (g : NormalStarAlgEquiv N P) :
    NormalStarAlgEquiv M P where
  toStarAlgEquiv := f.toStarAlgEquiv.trans g.toStarAlgEquiv
  continuous_ultraweak := by
    have hfun :
        (fun x : Ultraweak M => (ultraweakLinearEquiv P).symm
          ((f.toStarAlgEquiv.trans g.toStarAlgEquiv) (ultraweakLinearEquiv M x))) =
        ((fun y : Ultraweak N => (ultraweakLinearEquiv P).symm
          (g.toStarAlgEquiv (ultraweakLinearEquiv N y))) ∘
          fun x : Ultraweak M => (ultraweakLinearEquiv N).symm
            (f.toStarAlgEquiv (ultraweakLinearEquiv M x))) := by
      funext x
      change (ultraweakLinearEquiv P).symm
          (g.toStarAlgEquiv (f.toStarAlgEquiv (ultraweakLinearEquiv M x))) =
        (ultraweakLinearEquiv P).symm (g.toStarAlgEquiv (ultraweakLinearEquiv N
          ((ultraweakLinearEquiv N).symm (f.toStarAlgEquiv (ultraweakLinearEquiv M x)))))
      exact congrArg (fun y : N => (ultraweakLinearEquiv P).symm (g.toStarAlgEquiv y))
        ((ultraweakLinearEquiv N).apply_symm_apply
          (f.toStarAlgEquiv (ultraweakLinearEquiv M x))).symm
    rw [hfun]
    exact g.continuous_ultraweak.comp f.continuous_ultraweak
  continuous_ultraweak_symm := by
    have hfun :
        (fun x : Ultraweak P => (ultraweakLinearEquiv M).symm
          ((f.toStarAlgEquiv.trans g.toStarAlgEquiv).symm (ultraweakLinearEquiv P x))) =
        ((fun y : Ultraweak N => (ultraweakLinearEquiv M).symm
          (f.toStarAlgEquiv.symm (ultraweakLinearEquiv N y))) ∘
          fun x : Ultraweak P => (ultraweakLinearEquiv N).symm
            (g.toStarAlgEquiv.symm (ultraweakLinearEquiv P x))) := by
      funext x
      change (ultraweakLinearEquiv M).symm
          (f.toStarAlgEquiv.symm (g.toStarAlgEquiv.symm (ultraweakLinearEquiv P x))) =
        (ultraweakLinearEquiv M).symm (f.toStarAlgEquiv.symm (ultraweakLinearEquiv N
          ((ultraweakLinearEquiv N).symm (g.toStarAlgEquiv.symm (ultraweakLinearEquiv P x)))))
      exact congrArg (fun y : N => (ultraweakLinearEquiv M).symm (f.toStarAlgEquiv.symm y))
        ((ultraweakLinearEquiv N).apply_symm_apply
          (g.toStarAlgEquiv.symm (ultraweakLinearEquiv P x))).symm
    rw [hfun]
    exact f.continuous_ultraweak_symm.comp g.continuous_ultraweak_symm

/-- Forward composition uses the original algebra values in order. -/
@[simp]
theorem trans_apply (f : NormalStarAlgEquiv M N) (g : NormalStarAlgEquiv N P) (x : M) :
    f.trans g x = g (f x) :=
  rfl

/-- Normal automorphisms form a group under the original function composition. -/
instance automorphismGroup : Group (NormalStarAlgEquiv M M) where
  one := refl M
  mul f g := g.trans f
  inv f := f.symm
  mul_assoc f g h := by
    apply NormalStarAlgEquiv.ext
    apply StarAlgEquiv.ext
    intro x
    rfl
  one_mul f := by
    apply NormalStarAlgEquiv.ext
    apply StarAlgEquiv.ext
    intro x
    rfl
  mul_one f := by
    apply NormalStarAlgEquiv.ext
    apply StarAlgEquiv.ext
    intro x
    rfl
  inv_mul_cancel f := by
    apply NormalStarAlgEquiv.ext
    apply StarAlgEquiv.ext
    intro x
    exact f.toStarAlgEquiv.symm_apply_apply x

/-- The normal automorphism identity has the original identity value. -/
@[simp]
theorem one_apply (x : M) : (1 : NormalStarAlgEquiv M M) x = x :=
  rfl

/-- Normal automorphism multiplication is original function composition. -/
@[simp]
theorem mul_apply (f g : NormalStarAlgEquiv M M) (x : M) : (f * g) x = f (g x) :=
  rfl

/-- The normal automorphism inverse is its original normal inverse. -/
@[simp]
theorem inv_apply (f : NormalStarAlgEquiv M M) (x : M) : f⁻¹ x = f.symm x :=
  rfl

/-- Forget normality as a group homomorphism on the same original automorphisms. -/
def toStarAlgAutHom (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) :
    NormalStarAlgEquiv M M →* (M ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] M) where
  toFun := toStarAlgEquiv
  map_one' := rfl
  map_mul' _ _ := rfl

/-- Functional pullback is the actual continuous linear equivalence of predual spaces. -/
def predualEquiv (f : NormalStarAlgEquiv M N) :
    normalFunctionalSpace N ≃L[ℂ] normalFunctionalSpace M where
  toLinearEquiv :=
    { toFun := f.toNormalStarAlgHom.predualPullback
      invFun := f.symm.toNormalStarAlgHom.predualPullback
      left_inv := by
        intro φ
        apply Subtype.ext
        apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
        intro x
        simp only [NormalStarAlgHom.predualPullback_apply, toNormalStarAlgHom_apply,
          apply_symm_apply]
      right_inv := by
        intro φ
        apply Subtype.ext
        apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
        intro x
        simp only [NormalStarAlgHom.predualPullback_apply, toNormalStarAlgHom_apply,
          symm_apply_apply]
      map_add' := map_add f.toNormalStarAlgHom.predualPullback
      map_smul' := map_smul f.toNormalStarAlgHom.predualPullback }
  continuous_toFun := f.toNormalStarAlgHom.predualPullback.continuous
  continuous_invFun := f.symm.toNormalStarAlgHom.predualPullback.continuous

/-- The predual equivalence evaluates by the same original functional pullback. -/
@[simp]
theorem predualEquiv_apply (f : NormalStarAlgEquiv M N) (φ : normalFunctionalSpace N) (x : M) :
    (f.predualEquiv φ : StrongDual ℂ M) x = (φ : StrongDual ℂ N) (f x) :=
  f.toNormalStarAlgHom.predualPullback_apply φ x

/-- Inverse pullback gives the covariant action of actual normal automorphisms on the predual. -/
def predualActionHom (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) :
    NormalStarAlgEquiv M M →*
      (normalFunctionalSpace M ≃L[ℂ] normalFunctionalSpace M) where
  toFun f := f.symm.predualEquiv
  map_one' := by
    apply ContinuousLinearEquiv.ext
    funext φ
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
    intro x
    change (((1 : NormalStarAlgEquiv M M).symm).predualEquiv φ : StrongDual ℂ M) x =
      (φ : StrongDual ℂ M) x
    rw [predualEquiv_apply]
    rfl
  map_mul' f g := by
    apply ContinuousLinearEquiv.ext
    funext φ
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
    intro x
    change ((f * g).symm.predualEquiv φ : StrongDual ℂ M) x =
      (f.symm.predualEquiv (g.symm.predualEquiv φ) : StrongDual ℂ M) x
    rw [predualEquiv_apply, predualEquiv_apply, predualEquiv_apply]
    change (φ : StrongDual ℂ M) ((g.toStarAlgEquiv.trans f.toStarAlgEquiv).symm x) =
      (φ : StrongDual ℂ M) (g.toStarAlgEquiv.symm (f.toStarAlgEquiv.symm x))
    rw [StarAlgEquiv.symm_trans_apply]

/-- The covariant predual action uses the original inverse automorphism in evaluation. -/
@[simp]
theorem predualActionHom_apply (f : NormalStarAlgEquiv M M)
    (φ : normalFunctionalSpace M) (x : M) :
    (predualActionHom M f φ : StrongDual ℂ M) x = (φ : StrongDual ℂ M) (f.symm x) :=
  f.symm.predualEquiv_apply φ x

end NormalStarAlgEquiv

end

end VonNeumannAlgebra

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.Basic
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.RepresentationCoefficient
public import Mathlib.Topology.Algebra.Module.Basic

/-!
# The actual closed space of normal functionals

For a concrete von Neumann algebra on an arbitrary complete complex Hilbert
space, take the norm-closed complex linear span of its actual vector
functionals in the original continuous dual. Evaluation, norm and linear
operations are inherited from that dual. Completeness follows from the
closed-subspace construction.

This supplies the explicit normal-functional carrier for the predual
convention in Connes V Appendix A and Takesaki Definition 3.1.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open scoped InnerProductSpace CStarAlgebra

namespace VonNeumannAlgebra

open MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra

universe u

variable {H : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

/-- The original operator norm bounds each actual vector coefficient. -/
theorem vectorFunctional_bound (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (ξ η : H) (x : M) :
    ‖⟪ξ, (x : H →L[ℂ] H) η⟫_ℂ‖ ≤ (‖ξ‖ * ‖η‖) * ‖x‖ := by
  let φ : StrongDual ℂ M := representationCoefficient (A := M) M.toStarSubalgebra.subtype η ξ
  have hnorm : ‖φ‖ ≤ ‖ξ‖ * ‖η‖ := by
    simpa only [φ, mul_comm] using
      norm_representationCoefficient_le (A := M) M.toStarSubalgebra.subtype η ξ
  calc
    ‖⟪ξ, (x : H →L[ℂ] H) η⟫_ℂ‖ = ‖φ x‖ := by
      dsimp only [φ]
      rw [representationCoefficient_apply (A := M) M.toStarSubalgebra.subtype η ξ x]
      rfl
    _ ≤ ‖φ‖ * ‖x‖ := φ.le_opNorm x
    _ ≤ (‖ξ‖ * ‖η‖) * ‖x‖ :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hnorm (norm_nonneg x)

/-- The concrete-algebra specialization of representation coefficients,
with the original vector order and literal subtype representation. -/
noncomputable def vectorFunctional (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (ξ η : H) : StrongDual ℂ M :=
  representationCoefficient (A := M) M.toStarSubalgebra.subtype η ξ

/-- Evaluation of a vector functional is the original Hilbert coefficient. -/
@[simp]
theorem vectorFunctional_apply (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (ξ η : H) (x : M) :
    vectorFunctional M ξ η x = ⟪ξ, (x : H →L[ℂ] H) η⟫_ℂ := by
  change representationCoefficient (A := M) M.toStarSubalgebra.subtype η ξ x =
    ⟪ξ, (x : H →L[ℂ] H) η⟫_ℂ
  rw [representationCoefficient_apply (A := M) M.toStarSubalgebra.subtype η ξ x]
  rfl

/-- The dual norm of an actual vector functional is bounded by the two vector norms. -/
theorem norm_vectorFunctional_le (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (ξ η : H) :
    ‖vectorFunctional M ξ η‖ ≤ ‖ξ‖ * ‖η‖ := by
  simpa only [vectorFunctional, mul_comm] using
    norm_representationCoefficient_le (A := M) M.toStarSubalgebra.subtype η ξ

/-- The norm-closed complex span of the actual vector functionals in the original dual. -/
noncomputable def normalFunctionalSpace (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) :
    Submodule ℂ (StrongDual ℂ M) :=
  (Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range fun p : H × H => vectorFunctional M p.1 p.2)).topologicalClosure

/-- Every actual vector functional lies in the canonical closed span. -/
theorem vectorFunctional_mem_normalFunctionalSpace (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (ξ η : H) :
    vectorFunctional M ξ η ∈ normalFunctionalSpace M :=
  (Submodule.le_topologicalClosure _)
    (Submodule.subset_span (Set.mem_range_self (ξ, η)))

/-- The canonical normal functional space is closed for the original continuous-dual norm. -/
theorem normalFunctionalSpace_isClosed (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) :
    IsClosed (normalFunctionalSpace M : Set (StrongDual ℂ M)) :=
  Submodule.isClosed_topologicalClosure _

/-- The original dual norm makes the actual closed normal-functional carrier a Banach space. -/
instance normalFunctionalSpace_completeSpace (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) :
    CompleteSpace (normalFunctionalSpace M) :=
  (normalFunctionalSpace_isClosed M).isComplete.completeSpace_coe

/-- Any closed complex subspace containing every vector functional contains their actual closed span. -/
theorem normalFunctionalSpace_le (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H)
    {P : Submodule ℂ (StrongDual ℂ M)} (hP : IsClosed (P : Set (StrongDual ℂ M)))
    (hvec : ∀ ξ η : H, vectorFunctional M ξ η ∈ P) : normalFunctionalSpace M ≤ P := by
  apply Submodule.topologicalClosure_minimal
  · apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
    rintro _ ⟨⟨ξ, η⟩, rfl⟩
    exact hvec ξ η
  · exact hP

end VonNeumannAlgebra

Author: @toskua
-/
module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.UltraweakDual
public import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Spectrum
public import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Operator.Bilinear
public import Mathlib.Topology.Algebra.Module.ContinuousLinearMap.Restrict

/-!
# Compositional normal homomorphisms and actual predual pullback

Normal homomorphisms retain the original unital complex star maps and their
ultraweak continuity. Their literal functional pullback is certified by the
weak representation theorem and restricted to the actual predual spaces.
Identity and composition act on the original algebra and functional values.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open scoped CStarAlgebra

namespace VonNeumannAlgebra

noncomputable section

universe u v w z

variable {H : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
variable {K : Type v} [NormedAddCommGroup K] [InnerProductSpace ℂ K] [CompleteSpace K]

/-- An actual unital complex star algebra homomorphism that is ultraweak continuous. -/
structure NormalStarAlgHom (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (N : VonNeumannAlgebra K) where
  /-- The original unital complex star algebra homomorphism on the concrete carriers. -/
  toStarAlgHom : M →⋆ₐ[ℂ] N
  /-- Continuity of the same map for the actual evaluation-induced ultraweak topologies. -/
  continuous_ultraweak :
    Continuous fun x : Ultraweak M =>
      (ultraweakLinearEquiv N).symm (toStarAlgHom (ultraweakLinearEquiv M x))

namespace NormalStarAlgHom

variable {M : VonNeumannAlgebra H} {N : VonNeumannAlgebra K}

/-- The original algebra map determines a normal homomorphism. -/
@[ext]
theorem ext {f g : NormalStarAlgHom M N} (h : f.toStarAlgHom = g.toStarAlgHom) : f = g := by
  cases f
  cases g
  cases h
  rfl

@[macro_inline]
instance : FunLike (NormalStarAlgHom M N) M N where
  coe f := f.toStarAlgHom
  coe_injective f g h := by
    have hmap : f.toStarAlgHom = g.toStarAlgHom :=
      DFunLike.ext _ _ fun x => congrFun h x
    exact ext hmap

instance : Coe (NormalStarAlgHom M N) (M →⋆ₐ[ℂ] N) := ⟨toStarAlgHom⟩

instance : AlgHomClass (NormalStarAlgHom M N) ℂ M N where
  map_one f := map_one f.toStarAlgHom
  map_mul f := map_mul f.toStarAlgHom
  map_zero f := map_zero f.toStarAlgHom
  map_add f := map_add f.toStarAlgHom
  commutes f := AlgHomClass.commutes f.toStarAlgHom

instance : StarHomClass (NormalStarAlgHom M N) M N where
  map_star f := map_star f.toStarAlgHom

/-- The forgetful algebra map evaluates at the same original element. -/
@[simp]
theorem toStarAlgHom_apply (f : NormalStarAlgHom M N) (x : M) : f.toStarAlgHom x = f x :=
  rfl

/-- The underlying complex star map is bounded for the original C-star norms. -/
def toContinuousLinearMap (f : NormalStarAlgHom M N) : M →L[ℂ] N :=
  ⟨LinearMap.ofClass f.toStarAlgHom, map_continuous f.toStarAlgHom⟩

/-- The original bounded map keeps the original normal-homomorphism values. -/
@[simp]
theorem toContinuousLinearMap_apply (f : NormalStarAlgHom M N) (x : M) :
    f.toContinuousLinearMap x = f x :=
  rfl

/-- The same original map, continuously bundled between the actual ultraweak views. -/
def ultraweakMap (f : NormalStarAlgHom M N) : Ultraweak M →L[ℂ] Ultraweak N where
  toLinearMap := (ultraweakLinearEquiv N).symm.toLinearMap.comp
    ((LinearMap.ofClass f.toStarAlgHom).comp (ultraweakLinearEquiv M).toLinearMap)
  cont := f.continuous_ultraweak

/-- The ultraweak map retains both original value identifications. -/
@[simp]
theorem ultraweakMap_apply (f : NormalStarAlgHom M N) (x : Ultraweak M) :
    f.ultraweakMap x = (ultraweakLinearEquiv N).symm (f (ultraweakLinearEquiv M x)) :=
  rfl

/-- The identity normal homomorphism uses the identity original algebra map. -/
def id (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) : NormalStarAlgHom M M where
  toStarAlgHom := StarAlgHom.id ℂ M
  continuous_ultraweak := by
    have hfun :
        (fun x : Ultraweak M => (ultraweakLinearEquiv M).symm
          (StarAlgHom.id ℂ M (ultraweakLinearEquiv M x))) =
        (_root_.id : Ultraweak M → Ultraweak M) := by
      funext x
      change (ultraweakLinearEquiv M).symm (ultraweakLinearEquiv M x) = x
      exact (ultraweakLinearEquiv M).symm_apply_apply x
    rw [hfun]
    exact continuous_id

/-- Identity acts by the same original element. -/
@[simp]
theorem id_apply (x : M) : id M x = x :=
  rfl

variable {L : Type w} [NormedAddCommGroup L] [InnerProductSpace ℂ L] [CompleteSpace L]
variable {P : VonNeumannAlgebra L}

/-- Compose normal homomorphisms by the original star-algebra composition. -/
def comp (g : NormalStarAlgHom N P) (f : NormalStarAlgHom M N) : NormalStarAlgHom M P where
  toStarAlgHom := g.toStarAlgHom.comp f.toStarAlgHom
  continuous_ultraweak := by
    have hfun :
        (fun x : Ultraweak M => (ultraweakLinearEquiv P).symm
          ((g.toStarAlgHom.comp f.toStarAlgHom) (ultraweakLinearEquiv M x))) =
        ((fun y : Ultraweak N => (ultraweakLinearEquiv P).symm
          (g.toStarAlgHom (ultraweakLinearEquiv N y))) ∘
          fun x : Ultraweak M => (ultraweakLinearEquiv N).symm
            (f.toStarAlgHom (ultraweakLinearEquiv M x))) := by
      funext x
      change (ultraweakLinearEquiv P).symm
          (g.toStarAlgHom (f.toStarAlgHom (ultraweakLinearEquiv M x))) =
        (ultraweakLinearEquiv P).symm (g.toStarAlgHom (ultraweakLinearEquiv N
          ((ultraweakLinearEquiv N).symm (f.toStarAlgHom (ultraweakLinearEquiv M x)))))
      exact congrArg (fun y : N => (ultraweakLinearEquiv P).symm (g.toStarAlgHom y))
        ((ultraweakLinearEquiv N).apply_symm_apply
          (f.toStarAlgHom (ultraweakLinearEquiv M x))).symm
    rw [hfun]
    exact g.continuous_ultraweak.comp f.continuous_ultraweak

/-- Composition applies the original maps in forward order. -/
@[simp]
theorem comp_apply (g : NormalStarAlgHom N P) (f : NormalStarAlgHom M N) (x : M) :
    g.comp f x = g (f x) :=
  rfl

/-- The target identity preserves a normal homomorphism. -/
@[simp]
theorem id_comp (f : NormalStarAlgHom M N) : (id N).comp f = f := by
  apply ext
  ext x
  rfl

/-- The source identity preserves a normal homomorphism. -/
@[simp]
theorem comp_id (f : NormalStarAlgHom M N) : f.comp (id M) = f := by
  apply ext
  ext x
  rfl

variable {QH : Type z} [NormedAddCommGroup QH] [InnerProductSpace ℂ QH] [CompleteSpace QH]
variable {Q : VonNeumannAlgebra QH}

/-- Normal-map composition is associative on the original algebra maps. -/
theorem comp_assoc (h : NormalStarAlgHom P Q) (g : NormalStarAlgHom N P)
    (f : NormalStarAlgHom M N) : (h.comp g).comp f = h.comp (g.comp f) := by
  apply ext
  ext x
  rfl

/-- Actual pullback preserves the original closed normal-functional subtype. -/
theorem predualPullback_mem (f : NormalStarAlgHom M N) (φ : normalFunctionalSpace N) :
    (φ : StrongDual ℂ N).comp f.toContinuousLinearMap ∈ normalFunctionalSpace M := by
  apply mem_normalFunctionalSpace_of_ultraweak_continuous
  have hfun :
      (fun x : Ultraweak M => ((φ : StrongDual ℂ N).comp f.toContinuousLinearMap)
        (ultraweakLinearEquiv M x)) =
      ((fun y : Ultraweak N => (φ : StrongDual ℂ N) (ultraweakLinearEquiv N y)) ∘
        fun x : Ultraweak M => (ultraweakLinearEquiv N).symm
          (f.toStarAlgHom (ultraweakLinearEquiv M x))) := by
    funext x
    change (φ : StrongDual ℂ N) (f.toStarAlgHom (ultraweakLinearEquiv M x)) =
      (φ : StrongDual ℂ N) (ultraweakLinearEquiv N
        ((ultraweakLinearEquiv N).symm (f.toStarAlgHom (ultraweakLinearEquiv M x))))
    exact congrArg (fun y : N => (φ : StrongDual ℂ N) y)
      ((ultraweakLinearEquiv N).apply_symm_apply
        (f.toStarAlgHom (ultraweakLinearEquiv M x))).symm
  rw [hfun]
  exact (ultraweak_eval_continuous N φ).comp f.continuous_ultraweak

/-- The literal bounded functional pullback restricted to the actual normal-functional spaces. -/
def predualPullback (f : NormalStarAlgHom M N) :
    normalFunctionalSpace N →L[ℂ] normalFunctionalSpace M :=
  let B := (ContinuousLinearMap.compL ℂ M N ℂ).flip f.toContinuousLinearMap
  let T := B.comp (normalFunctionalSpace N).subtypeL
  T.codRestrict (normalFunctionalSpace M) fun φ => f.predualPullback_mem φ

/-- The actual predual pullback is ordinary functional precomposition on original elements. -/
@[simp]
theorem predualPullback_apply (f : NormalStarAlgHom M N) (φ : normalFunctionalSpace N) (x : M) :
    (f.predualPullback φ : StrongDual ℂ M) x = (φ : StrongDual ℂ N) (f x) :=
  rfl

/-- Identity induces identity on the actual predual. -/
@[simp]
theorem predualPullback_id : (id M).predualPullback = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ _ := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro φ
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro x
  rfl

/-- Functional pullback reverses the original normal-map composition. -/
theorem predualPullback_comp (g : NormalStarAlgHom N P) (f : NormalStarAlgHom M N) :
    (g.comp f).predualPullback = f.predualPullback.comp g.predualPullback := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro φ
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro x
  simp only [predualPullback_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, comp_apply]

end NormalStarAlgHom

end

end VonNeumannAlgebra

Author: @toskua

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalHom.RangeAnnihilator

/-!
# The actual faithful normal operator range is ultraweak closed

The proved original range-annihilator characterization identifies the
actual ultraweak map range with the intersection of zero sets of original
normal-functional evaluations annihilating its predual kernel. Every such
evaluation is actually ultraweak continuous. Their intersection is closed.
No range-closedness, predual quotient or inverse/model certificate is input.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

namespace VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalStarAlgHom

noncomputable section

universe u v

variable {H : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
variable {K : Type v} [NormedAddCommGroup K] [InnerProductSpace ℂ K] [CompleteSpace K]
variable {M : VonNeumannAlgebra H} {N : VonNeumannAlgebra K}

/-- The actual original faithful normal-map range is closed in the original target ultraweak topology. -/
theorem ultraweak_range_isClosed (f : NormalStarAlgHom M N) (hf : Function.Injective f) :
    IsClosed (Set.range f.ultraweakMap) := by
  have hrange : Set.range f.ultraweakMap =
      ⋂ φ : normalFunctionalSpace N, ⋂ _hφ : f.predualPullback φ = 0,
        {y : Ultraweak N | (φ : StrongDual ℂ N) (ultraweakLinearEquiv N y) = 0} := by
    ext y
    simp only [Set.mem_iInter, Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨x, rfl⟩ φ hφ
      rw [f.ultraweakMap_apply, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
      rw [← f.predualPullback_apply φ (ultraweakLinearEquiv M x), hφ]
      rfl
    · intro hy
      have hmem : ultraweakLinearEquiv N y ∈ Set.range f :=
        (f.mem_range_iff_predual_kernel hf (ultraweakLinearEquiv N y)).mpr hy
      obtain ⟨x, hxy⟩ := hmem
      refine ⟨(ultraweakLinearEquiv M).symm x, ?_⟩
      apply (ultraweakLinearEquiv N).injective
      rw [f.ultraweakMap_apply, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply,
        LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, hxy]
  rw [hrange]
  apply isClosed_iInter
  intro φ
  apply isClosed_iInter
  intro _hφ
  exact isClosed_eq (ultraweak_eval_continuous N φ) continuous_const

end

end VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalStarAlgHom

Author: @toskua

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalHom
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.UltraweakOrder

/-!
# Original normal homomorphisms have compact images of ultraweak norm balls

The source's actual original norm ball is compact in its ultraweak view.
The given actual normal homomorphism is continuous between those views,
so its literal image of that same ball is compact. No weakly closed range,
normal inverse, predual or representation model is an input. This supplies
the compact-ball prerequisite for the actual faithful normal range constructor.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

namespace VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalStarAlgHom

noncomputable section

universe u v

variable {H : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
variable {K : Type v} [NormedAddCommGroup K] [InnerProductSpace ℂ K] [CompleteSpace K]
variable {M : VonNeumannAlgebra H} {N : VonNeumannAlgebra K}

/-- The literal image of each original ultraweak norm ball under an actual normal map is compact. -/
theorem ultraweak_ball_image_isCompact (f : NormalStarAlgHom M N) (r : ℝ) :
    IsCompact ((fun x : Ultraweak M =>
      (ultraweakLinearEquiv N).symm (f (ultraweakLinearEquiv M x))) ''
        {x : Ultraweak M | ‖ultraweakLinearEquiv M x‖ ≤ r}) := by
  exact (ultraweakClosedBall_isCompact M r).image f.continuous_ultraweak

end

end VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalStarAlgHom

Author: @toskua
-/
module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalHom.CompactBallImage
public import Mathlib.Topology.Separation.Hausdorff

/-!
# A faithful normal homomorphism embeds each original ultraweak norm ball

The original source norm ball is actually ultraweak compact. Restricting
the original normal map to that ball gives a continuous injection into
the original Hausdorff target ultraweak space, hence a closed embedding.
This proves inverse continuity on each actual bounded image without a
supplied weakly closed range, normal inverse or predual/model certificate.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

namespace VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalStarAlgHom

noncomputable section

universe u v

variable {H : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
variable {K : Type v} [NormedAddCommGroup K] [InnerProductSpace ℂ K] [CompleteSpace K]
variable {M : VonNeumannAlgebra H} {N : VonNeumannAlgebra K}

/-- Restriction of the original faithful normal map to each actual norm ball is a closed embedding. -/
theorem ultraweak_ball_isClosedEmbedding (f : NormalStarAlgHom M N)
    (hf : Function.Injective f) (r : ℝ) :
    Topology.IsClosedEmbedding (fun x : {x : Ultraweak M | ‖ultraweakLinearEquiv M x‖ ≤ r} =>
      f.ultraweakMap x.val) := by
  let B : Set (Ultraweak M) := {x | ‖ultraweakLinearEquiv M x‖ ≤ r}
  let : CompactSpace B := isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp
    (show IsCompact B from ultraweakClosedBall_isCompact M r)
  have hcontinuous : Continuous (fun x : B => f.ultraweakMap x.val) :=
    f.ultraweakMap.continuous.comp continuous_subtype_val
  apply hcontinuous.isClosedEmbedding
  intro x y hxy
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply (ultraweakLinearEquiv M).injective
  apply hf
  have hvalue := congrArg (ultraweakLinearEquiv N) hxy
  simpa only [f.ultraweakMap_apply, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] using hvalue

end

end VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalStarAlgHom

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalHom.CompactBallImage
public import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Hom

/-!
# Faithful normal homomorphisms identify actual norm balls in their operator range

Injectivity of the original star homomorphism gives its stock C-star
isometry. Its original ultraweak ball image is therefore exactly the
intersection of its actual range with the target original norm ball.
Compactness of the original ball image makes that actual intersection
compact. No range closedness, predual or normal inverse certificate is input.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

namespace VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalStarAlgHom

noncomputable section

universe u v

variable {H : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
variable {K : Type v} [NormedAddCommGroup K] [InnerProductSpace ℂ K] [CompleteSpace K]
variable {M : VonNeumannAlgebra H} {N : VonNeumannAlgebra K}

/-- The actual source ball image is exactly its original range intersected with the target norm ball. -/
theorem ultraweak_ball_image_eq_range_inter (f : NormalStarAlgHom M N)
    (hf : Function.Injective f) (r : ℝ) :
    f.ultraweakMap '' {x : Ultraweak M | ‖ultraweakLinearEquiv M x‖ ≤ r} =
      Set.range f.ultraweakMap ∩ {y : Ultraweak N | ‖ultraweakLinearEquiv N y‖ ≤ r} := by
  ext y
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨Set.mem_range_self x, ?_⟩
    change ‖ultraweakLinearEquiv N (f.ultraweakMap x)‖ ≤ r
    rw [f.ultraweakMap_apply, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    change ‖f.toStarAlgHom (ultraweakLinearEquiv M x)‖ ≤ r
    rw [NonUnitalStarAlgHom.norm_map f.toStarAlgHom hf]
    exact hx
  · rintro ⟨⟨x, rfl⟩, hx⟩
    refine ⟨x, ?_, rfl⟩
    change ‖ultraweakLinearEquiv M x‖ ≤ r
    have hnorm : ‖ultraweakLinearEquiv N (f.ultraweakMap x)‖ = ‖ultraweakLinearEquiv M x‖ := by
      rw [f.ultraweakMap_apply, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
      exact NonUnitalStarAlgHom.norm_map f.toStarAlgHom hf _
    rw [← hnorm]
    exact hx

/-- The original range's intersection with every original target norm ball is actually compact. -/
theorem ultraweak_range_inter_ball_isCompact (f : NormalStarAlgHom M N)
    (hf : Function.Injective f) (r : ℝ) :
    IsCompact (Set.range f.ultraweakMap ∩ {y : Ultraweak N | ‖ultraweakLinearEquiv N y‖ ≤ r}) := by
  rw [← f.ultraweak_ball_image_eq_range_inter hf r]
  exact f.ultraweak_ball_image_isCompact r

end

end VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalStarAlgHom

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalHom.FaithfulUnitBallBicommutant
public import Mathlib.Analysis.Complex.Norm

/-!
# The literal faithful normal operator range equals its double commutant

For every original double-commutant operator T, the nonzero scalar inverse
of ‖T‖ + 1 places T in the actual unit ball without a nonzero-operator or
nonzero-space assumption. Original scalar commutation preserves its
membership, the strict unit-ball image theorem supplies a source preimage,
and the original star map scales it back to T. This equality provides the
exact closure field for the actual von Neumann image carrier.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

namespace VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalStarAlgHom

noncomputable section

universe u v

variable {H : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
variable {K : Type v} [NormedAddCommGroup K] [InnerProductSpace ℂ K] [CompleteSpace K]
variable {M : VonNeumannAlgebra H} {N : VonNeumannAlgebra K}

/-- The original faithful normal operator image is exactly its original double centralizer. -/
theorem operatorRange_eq_bicommutant (f : NormalStarAlgHom M N) (hf : Function.Injective f) :
    Set.range (fun x : M => (f x : K →L[ℂ] K)) =
      Set.centralizer (Set.centralizer (Set.range fun x : M => (f x : K →L[ℂ] K))) := by
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm Set.subset_centralizer_centralizer
  intro T hT
  let R : ℝ := ‖T‖ + 1
  let c : ℂ := (R⁻¹ : ℝ)
  have hR : 0 < R := add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos (norm_nonneg T) zero_lt_one
  have hnormC : ‖c‖ = R⁻¹ := by
    change ‖((R⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ = R⁻¹
    rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hR.le)]
  have hc : c ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    have h := hnormC
    rw [hz, norm_zero] at h
    exact (inv_ne_zero hR.ne') h.symm
  have hscaled : c • T ∈
      Set.centralizer (Set.centralizer (Set.range fun x : M => (f x : K →L[ℂ] K))) := by
    apply Set.mem_centralizer_iff.mpr
    intro A hA
    have hcomm := (Set.mem_centralizer_iff.mp hT) A hA
    have h := congrArg (fun B : K →L[ℂ] K => c • B) hcomm
    simpa only [mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc] using h
  have hbound : ‖c • T‖ ≤ 1 := by
    rw [norm_smul, hnormC]
    have hnormR : ‖T‖ ≤ R := le_add_of_nonneg_right zero_le_one
    calc
      R⁻¹ * ‖T‖ ≤ R⁻¹ * R := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hnormR (inv_nonneg.mpr hR.le)
      _ = 1 := inv_mul_cancel₀ hR.ne'
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := f.unitBall_bicommutant_mem_operatorRange hf (c • T) hscaled hbound
  change (f x : K →L[ℂ] K) = c • T at hx
  refine ⟨c⁻¹ • x, ?_⟩
  change (f.toStarAlgHom (c⁻¹ • x) : K →L[ℂ] K) = T
  rw [map_smul]
  change c⁻¹ • (f x : K →L[ℂ] K) = T
  rw [hx, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hc, one_smul]

end

end VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalStarAlgHom

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalHom.FaithfulBallImage

/-!
# Faithfulness makes the actual bounded dual of predual pullback isometric

The existing evaluation equivalences identify every source predual-dual
functional with an original algebra element x. The actual dual pullback
sends it to evaluation at f(x), and the faithful original star map preserves
its C-star norm. Thus the literal bounded dual is isometric. No quotient,
surjectivity, image-closedness or inverse/model certificate is an input.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

namespace VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalStarAlgHom

noncomputable section

universe u v

variable {H : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
variable {K : Type v} [NormedAddCommGroup K] [InnerProductSpace ℂ K] [CompleteSpace K]
variable {M : VonNeumannAlgebra H} {N : VonNeumannAlgebra K}

/-- The literal dual of predual pullback preserves every original dual norm under faithfulness. -/
theorem predualPullback_dual_norm (f : NormalStarAlgHom M N) (hf : Function.Injective f)
    (F : StrongDual ℂ (normalFunctionalSpace M)) :
    ‖((ContinuousLinearMap.compL ℂ (normalFunctionalSpace N) (normalFunctionalSpace M) ℂ).flip
      f.predualPullback) F‖ = ‖F‖ := by
  let x : M := (normalFunctionalEvaluationEquiv M).symm F
  have hF : normalFunctionalEvaluationEquiv M x = F :=
    (normalFunctionalEvaluationEquiv M).apply_symm_apply F
  rw [← hF, f.predualPullback_dual_evaluation x]
  rw [(normalFunctionalEvaluationEquiv N).norm_map, (normalFunctionalEvaluationEquiv M).norm_map]
  exact NonUnitalStarAlgHom.norm_map f.toStarAlgHom hf x

/-- The same literal bounded dual map is isometric; no predual quotient property is assumed. -/
theorem predualPullback_dual_isometry (f : NormalStarAlgHom M N) (hf : Function.Injective f) :
    Isometry ((ContinuousLinearMap.compL ℂ (normalFunctionalSpace N) (normalFunctionalSpace M) ℂ).flip
      f.predualPullback) :=
  AddMonoidHomClass.isometry_of_norm _ (f.predualPullback_dual_norm hf)

end

end VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalStarAlgHom

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalHom.FaithfulPredualDual
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.Normed.Operator.DualSurjective

/-!
# The actual predual pullback of a faithful normal map is surjective and a quotient

The original faithful normal map makes the literal dual of its constructed
predual pullback isometric. The strict Banach preimage theorem applies to
that actual norm inequality and constructs genuine preimages. Thus the
original pullback is surjective; the stock Banach open mapping theorem
gives its quotient topology. No quotient, range-closure, surjectivity or
normal inverse/model certificate is an input.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

namespace VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalStarAlgHom

universe u v

variable {H : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

variable {M : VonNeumannAlgebra H} {N : VonNeumannAlgebra K}

/-- The original predual pullback has actual preimages under faithfulness, with no quotient certificate. -/
theorem predualPullback_surjective_of_injective (f : NormalStarAlgHom M N)
    (hf : Function.Injective f) : Function.Surjective f.predualPullback := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.surjective_of_dual_lower_bound
  intro G
  have hnorm := f.predualPullback_dual_norm hf G

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalHom.FaithfulWOTBall
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.BicommutantStrongClosureEquality
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.KaplanskyDensity

/-!
# Original double-commutant unit ball lies in the actual faithful normal image

The original operator image is a unital star algebra. Its double commutant
is its actual strong closure. The strict full-H Kaplansky theorem supplies
bounded approximants in that image. The original bounded image ball is
WOT closed, and the actual strong-to-WOT conversion is continuous, so the
original operator lies in the literal image. This unit-ball prerequisite
serves the exact von Neumann image carrier without a supplied image,
closure, inverse, approximation or representation certificate.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open Set Topology

namespace VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalStarAlgHom

noncomputable section

universe u v

variable {H : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
variable {K : Type v} [NormedAddCommGroup K] [InnerProductSpace ℂ K] [CompleteSpace K]
variable {M : VonNeumannAlgebra H} {N : VonNeumannAlgebra K}

/-- Original unit-ball double-commutant membership yields an element of the literal faithful normal image. -/
theorem unitBall_bicommutant_mem_operatorRange (f : NormalStarAlgHom M N)
    (hf : Function.Injective f) (T : K →L[ℂ] K)
    (hT : T ∈ Set.centralizer (Set.centralizer
      (Set.range fun x : M => (f x : K →L[ℂ] K)))) (hTnorm : ‖T‖ ≤ 1) :
    T ∈ Set.range (fun x : M => (f x : K →L[ℂ] K)) := by
  classical
  let g : M →⋆ₐ[ℂ] (K →L[ℂ] K) := N.toStarSubalgebra.subtype.comp f.toStarAlgHom
  let S := g.range
  have hRange : (S : Set (K →L[ℂ] K)) = Set.range (fun x : M => (f x : K →L[ℂ] K)) := by
    ext A
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
      change (f x : K →L[ℂ] K) = A at hx
      exact ⟨x, hx⟩
    · rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
      refine ⟨x, ?_⟩
      change (f x : K →L[ℂ] K) = A
      exact hx
  let P := ContinuousLinearMap.toUniformConvergenceCLM (RingHom.id ℂ) K {s : Set K | Finite s}
  let W : (K →Lₚₜ[ℂ] K) → (K →WOT[ℂ] K) := fun p => ContinuousLinearMapWOT.ofCLM (P.symm p)
  have hPvalue (p : K →Lₚₜ[ℂ] K) (ξ : K) : P.symm p ξ = p ξ :=
    ContinuousLinearMap.toUniformConvergenceCLM_symm_apply
  have hWvalue (p : K →Lₚₜ[ℂ] K) : (W p).toCLM = P.symm p :=
    ContinuousLinearMapWOT.toCLM_ofCLM _
  have hW : Continuous W := by
    apply ContinuousLinearMapWOT.continuous_of_dual_apply_continuous
    intro ξ φ
    have h := φ.continuous.comp
      (continuous_eval_const ξ : Continuous (fun p : K →Lₚₜ[ℂ] K => p ξ))
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, W, ContinuousLinearMapWOT.ofCLM_apply, hPvalue] using h
  have hSource : Set.range (fun a : S => P (a : K →L[ℂ] K)) =
      {p : K →Lₚₜ[ℂ] K | P.symm p ∈ S} := by
    ext p
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨a, rfl⟩
      change P.symm (P (a : K →L[ℂ] K)) ∈ S
      rw [P.symm_apply_apply]
      exact a.property
    · intro hp
      change P.symm p ∈ S at hp
      refine ⟨⟨P.symm p, hp⟩, ?_⟩
      exact P.apply_symm_apply p
  have hTS : T ∈ Set.centralizer (Set.centralizer (S : Set (K →L[ℂ] K))) := by
    rw [hRange]
    exact hT
  have hStrong := MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.bicommutant_mem_strongClosure S T hTS
  rw [hSource] at hStrong
  let B : Set (K →Lₚₜ[ℂ] K) := {p | P.symm p ∈ S ∧ ‖P.symm p‖ ≤ 1}
  have hKaplansky : closure B =
      {p : K →Lₚₜ[ℂ] K | p ∈ closure {q : K →Lₚₜ[ℂ] K | P.symm q ∈ S} ∧ ‖P.symm p‖ ≤ 1} :=
    MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.KaplanskyDensityWanted.kaplansky_density_theorem S
  have hBall : P T ∈ closure B := by
    rw [hKaplansky]
    refine ⟨hStrong, ?_⟩
    rw [P.symm_apply_apply]
    exact hTnorm
  let C : Set (K →WOT[ℂ] K) := {q |
    q.toCLM ∈ Set.range (fun x : M => (f x : K →L[ℂ] K)) ∧ ‖q.toCLM‖ ≤ 1}
  have hMaps : Set.MapsTo W B C := by
    intro p hp
    change P.symm p ∈ S ∧ ‖P.symm p‖ ≤ 1 at hp
    change (W p).toCLM ∈ Set.range (fun x : M => (f x : K →L[ℂ] K)) ∧ ‖(W p).toCLM‖ ≤ 1
    rw [hWvalue]
    refine ⟨?_, hp.2⟩
    rw [← hRange]
    exact hp.1
  have hClosed : IsClosed C := f.isClosed_wot_range_inter_ball hf 1
  have hImage : W (P T) ∈ closure C := map_mem_closure hW hBall hMaps
  rw [hClosed.closure_eq] at hImage
  change (W (P T)).toCLM ∈ Set.range (fun x : M => (f x : K →L[ℂ] K)) ∧
    ‖(W (P T)).toCLM‖ ≤ 1 at hImage
  rw [hWvalue, P.symm_apply_apply] at hImage
  exact hImage.1

end

end VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalStarAlgHom
