module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalHom.FaithfulBallImage
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.UltraweakWOT

/-!
# Actual faithful normal operator-range balls are WOT compact and closed

The existing compact ultraweak range ball maps continuously to the original
weak operator carrier. Its image is exactly the original concrete operator
range intersected with the same norm ball. Thus that literal intersection
is WOT compact and closed, including arbitrary radii and zero Hilbert
spaces. No closed-range, weak topology or compactness certificate is input.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open Set Topology

namespace VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalStarAlgHom

noncomputable section

universe u v

variable {H : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
variable {K : Type v} [NormedAddCommGroup K] [InnerProductSpace ℂ K] [CompleteSpace K]
variable {M : VonNeumannAlgebra H} {N : VonNeumannAlgebra K}

/-- Each literal norm ball in the actual faithful normal operator range is WOT compact. -/
theorem wot_range_inter_ball_isCompact (f : NormalStarAlgHom M N)
    (hf : Function.Injective f) (r : ℝ) :
    IsCompact {q : K →WOT[ℂ] K |
      q.toCLM ∈ Set.range (fun x : M => (f x : K →L[ℂ] K)) ∧ ‖q.toCLM‖ ≤ r} := by
  let W : Ultraweak N → (K →WOT[ℂ] K) :=
    fun y => ContinuousLinearMapWOT.ofCLM (ultraweakLinearEquiv N y : K →L[ℂ] K)
  have hW : Continuous W := ultraweak_toWOT_continuous N
  have hWvalue (y : Ultraweak N) : (W y).toCLM = (ultraweakLinearEquiv N y : K →L[ℂ] K) :=
    ContinuousLinearMapWOT.toCLM_ofCLM _
  have hcompact := (f.ultraweak_range_inter_ball_isCompact hf r).image hW
  have hset : W '' (Set.range f.ultraweakMap ∩ {y : Ultraweak N | ‖ultraweakLinearEquiv N y‖ ≤ r}) =
      {q : K →WOT[ℂ] K |
        q.toCLM ∈ Set.range (fun x : M => (f x : K →L[ℂ] K)) ∧ ‖q.toCLM‖ ≤ r} := by
    ext q
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨y, ⟨⟨x, rfl⟩, hy⟩, rfl⟩
      have hvalue : ultraweakLinearEquiv N (f.ultraweakMap x) = f (ultraweakLinearEquiv M x) := by
        rw [f.ultraweakMap_apply, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
      refine ⟨⟨ultraweakLinearEquiv M x, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
      · rw [hWvalue, hvalue]
      · rw [hWvalue]
        exact hy
    · rintro ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, hn⟩
      change (f x : K →L[ℂ] K) = q.toCLM at hx
      refine ⟨(ultraweakLinearEquiv N).symm (f x),
        ⟨⟨(ultraweakLinearEquiv M).symm x, ?_⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
      · rw [f.ultraweakMap_apply, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
      · change ‖ultraweakLinearEquiv N ((ultraweakLinearEquiv N).symm (f x))‖ ≤ r
        rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
        change ‖(f x : K →L[ℂ] K)‖ ≤ r
        rw [hx]
        exact hn
      · apply ContinuousLinearMapWOT.toCLM_injective
        rw [hWvalue, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
        exact hx
  rw [← hset]
  exact hcompact

/-- The same literal faithful range norm ball is closed in the original WOT carrier. -/
theorem isClosed_wot_range_inter_ball (f : NormalStarAlgHom M N)
    (hf : Function.Injective f) (r : ℝ) :
    IsClosed {q : K →WOT[ℂ] K |
      q.toCLM ∈ Set.range (fun x : M => (f x : K →L[ℂ] K)) ∧ ‖q.toCLM‖ ≤ r} :=
  (f.wot_range_inter_ball_isCompact hf r).isClosed

end

end VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalStarAlgHom

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalHom.ImageHom
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalHom.RangeHomeomorph
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalEquiv

/-!
# The actual normal equivalence onto the literal VN image

The computed normal range map is internally proved bijective. Its actual
star equivalence uses that same forward map. The generic proved ultraweak
range homeomorphism, restricted along the literal identity into its full
range, proves continuity of the computed inverse. No inverse, surjectivity,
normality, image or source-existence certificate is supplied.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open scoped Topology

namespace VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalStarAlgHom

noncomputable section

universe u v

variable {H : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
variable {K : Type v} [NormedAddCommGroup K] [InnerProductSpace ℂ K] [CompleteSpace K]
variable {M : VonNeumannAlgebra H} {N : VonNeumannAlgebra K}

/-- The original faithful normal map is normally equivalent to its literal constructed VN image. -/
def imageEquiv (f : NormalStarAlgHom M N) (hf : Function.Injective f) :
    NormalStarAlgEquiv M (f.imageVonNeumannAlgebra hf) := by
  let P := f.imageVonNeumannAlgebra hf
  let q : NormalStarAlgHom M P := f.toImage hf
  have hqi : Function.Injective q := f.toImage_injective hf
  have hqs : Function.Surjective q := f.toImage_surjective hf
  let e : M ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] P := StarAlgEquiv.ofBijective q.toStarAlgHom ⟨hqi, hqs⟩
  have he (a : M) : e a = q a := rfl
  let invU : Ultraweak P → Ultraweak M := fun y =>
    (ultraweakLinearEquiv M).symm (e.symm (ultraweakLinearEquiv P y))
  have hinvValue (y : Ultraweak P) : q.ultraweakMap (invU y) = y := by
    rw [q.ultraweakMap_apply]
    dsimp only [invU]
    rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    change (ultraweakLinearEquiv P).symm (e (e.symm (ultraweakLinearEquiv P y))) = y
    rw [e.apply_symm_apply, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  have hqUL : Function.Injective q.ultraweakMap := by
    intro x y h
    apply (ultraweakLinearEquiv M).injective
    apply hqi
    have hvalue := congrArg (ultraweakLinearEquiv P) h
    simpa only [q.ultraweakMap_apply, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] using hvalue
  let rhome := q.ultraweakRangeHomeomorph hqi
  let j : Ultraweak P → Set.range q.ultraweakMap :=
    fun y => ⟨y, ⟨invU y, hinvValue y⟩⟩
  have hj : Continuous j := continuous_id.subtype_mk (fun y => ⟨invU y, hinvValue y⟩)
  have hinverse : Continuous invU := by
    have hcomp : Continuous (fun y : Ultraweak P => rhome.symm (j y)) := by
      simpa only [Function.comp_def] using rhome.symm.continuous.comp hj
    have hfun : (fun y : Ultraweak P => rhome.symm (j y)) = invU := by
      funext y
      apply hqUL
      have h := congrArg (fun z : Set.range q.ultraweakMap => z.val) (rhome.apply_symm_apply (j y))
      change (q.ultraweakRangeHomeomorph hqi (rhome.symm (j y))).val = y at h
      rw [q.ultraweakRangeHomeomorph_apply] at h
      calc
        q.ultraweakMap (rhome.symm (j y)) = y := h
        _ = q.ultraweakMap (invU y) := (hinvValue y).symm
    rw [hfun] at hcomp
    exact hcomp
  exact
    { toStarAlgEquiv := e
      continuous_ultraweak := by
        change Continuous (fun x : Ultraweak M =>
          (ultraweakLinearEquiv P).symm (q.toStarAlgHom (ultraweakLinearEquiv M x)))
        exact q.continuous_ultraweak
      continuous_ultraweak_symm := hinverse }

/-- The actual normal equivalence has exactly the original concrete forward operator value. -/
@[simp]
theorem imageEquiv_apply (f : NormalStarAlgHom M N) (hf : Function.Injective f) (a : M) :
    (f.imageEquiv hf a : K →L[ℂ] K) = (f a : K →L[ℂ] K) := by
  have hb : Function.Bijective (f.toImage hf).toStarAlgHom := by
    change Function.Bijective (f.toImage hf)
    exact ⟨f.toImage_injective hf, f.toImage_surjective hf⟩
  have h := StarAlgEquiv.ofBijective_apply (f := (f.toImage hf).toStarAlgHom) hb a
  change ((StarAlgEquiv.ofBijective (f.toImage hf).toStarAlgHom hb) a : K →L[ℂ] K) =
    (f a : K →L[ℂ] K)
  exact (congrArg (fun b : f.imageVonNeumannAlgebra hf => (b : K →L[ℂ] K)) h).trans
    (f.toImage_apply hf a)

/-- The actual inverse returns an original source element with precisely the given image operator. -/
theorem imageEquiv_symm_operator_value (f : NormalStarAlgHom M N) (hf : Function.Injective f)
    (b : f.imageVonNeumannAlgebra hf) :
    (f ((f.imageEquiv hf).toStarAlgEquiv.symm b) : K →L[ℂ] K) = (b : K →L[ℂ] K) := by
  have h := (f.imageEquiv hf).toStarAlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply b
  have hvalue := congrArg (fun p : f.imageVonNeumannAlgebra hf => (p : K →L[ℂ] K)) h
  simpa only [NormalStarAlgEquiv.toStarAlgEquiv_apply, imageEquiv_apply] using hvalue

end

end VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalStarAlgHom

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalHom.ImageVonNeumannAlgebra
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalHom.VectorFunctionalCriterion

/-!
# The computed normal map onto the literal von Neumann image

The original operator star map is restricted to its actual range carrier.
Its vector-functional pullbacks are the same original normal-map
pullbacks, so the computed map is normal. Original injectivity and literal
range membership prove it is bijective. No surjectivity, normality, image,
predual or inverse certificate is supplied.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open scoped CStarAlgebra InnerProductSpace

namespace VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalStarAlgHom

noncomputable section

universe u v

variable {H : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
variable {K : Type v} [NormedAddCommGroup K] [InnerProductSpace ℂ K] [CompleteSpace K]
variable {M : VonNeumannAlgebra H} {N : VonNeumannAlgebra K}

/-- Restrict the original normal operator map to its literal constructed VN range. -/
def toImage (f : NormalStarAlgHom M N) (hf : Function.Injective f) :
    NormalStarAlgHom M (f.imageVonNeumannAlgebra hf) := by
  let g : M →⋆ₐ[ℂ] (K →L[ℂ] K) := N.toStarSubalgebra.subtype.comp f.toStarAlgHom
  let F : M →⋆ₐ[ℂ] f.imageVonNeumannAlgebra hf := g.rangeRestrict
  refine ofVectorFunctionalPullbacks F ?_
  intro ξ η
  have heq : (vectorFunctional (f.imageVonNeumannAlgebra hf) ξ η).comp
      (⟨LinearMap.ofClass F, map_continuous F⟩ : M →L[ℂ] f.imageVonNeumannAlgebra hf) =
      (f.predualPullback (normalVectorFunctional N ξ η) : StrongDual ℂ M) := by
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
    intro a
    rw [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, vectorFunctional_apply, f.predualPullback_apply]
    change ⟪ξ, (f a : K →L[ℂ] K) η⟫_ℂ =
      (normalVectorFunctional N ξ η : StrongDual ℂ N) (f a)
    exact (vectorFunctional_apply N ξ η (f a)).symm
  rw [heq]
  exact (f.predualPullback (normalVectorFunctional N ξ η)).property

/-- The computed normal range restriction keeps every original operator value. -/
@[simp]
theorem toImage_apply (f : NormalStarAlgHom M N) (hf : Function.Injective f) (a : M) :
    (f.toImage hf a : K →L[ℂ] K) = (f a : K →L[ℂ] K) := rfl

/-- Original injectivity proves injectivity of the same computed image map. -/
theorem toImage_injective (f : NormalStarAlgHom M N) (hf : Function.Injective f) :
    Function.Injective (f.toImage hf) := by
  intro a b h
  apply hf
  apply Subtype.ext
  have hvalue := congrArg (fun p : f.imageVonNeumannAlgebra hf => (p : K →L[ℂ] K)) h
  simpa only [toImage_apply] using hvalue

/-- Every actual image carrier element has an original source preimage under the computed map. -/
theorem toImage_surjective (f : NormalStarAlgHom M N) (hf : Function.Injective f) :
    Function.Surjective (f.toImage hf) := by
  intro b
  have hb : (b : K →L[ℂ] K) ∈ Set.range (fun a : M => (f a : K →L[ℂ] K)) :=
    Eq.mp (congrArg (fun s : Set (K →L[ℂ] K) => (b : K →L[ℂ] K) ∈ s)
      (f.coe_imageVonNeumannAlgebra hf)) b.property
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hb
  change (f a : K →L[ℂ] K) = (b : K →L[ℂ] K) at ha
  refine ⟨a, ?_⟩
  apply Subtype.ext
  simpa only [toImage_apply] using ha

end

end VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalStarAlgHom

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalHom.FaithfulBicommutantRange

/-!
# The actual von Neumann image of a faithful normal homomorphism

The carrier is the literal original operator range star subalgebra. The
proved full double-commutant equality supplies exactly its required
von Neumann closure field. Every image element is an original map value;
no generated larger carrier, desired image or closure certificate is input.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

namespace VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalStarAlgHom

noncomputable section

universe u v

variable {H : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
variable {K : Type v} [NormedAddCommGroup K] [InnerProductSpace ℂ K] [CompleteSpace K]
variable {M : VonNeumannAlgebra H} {N : VonNeumannAlgebra K}

/-- The literal faithful normal operator image, with its proved von Neumann closure field. -/
def imageVonNeumannAlgebra (f : NormalStarAlgHom M N) (hf : Function.Injective f) : VonNeumannAlgebra K :=
  let g : M →⋆ₐ[ℂ] (K →L[ℂ] K) := N.toStarSubalgebra.subtype.comp f.toStarAlgHom
  { g.range with
    centralizer_centralizer' := by
      have hRange : (g.range : Set (K →L[ℂ] K)) =
          Set.range (fun x : M => (f x : K →L[ℂ] K)) := by
        ext T
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
          change (f x : K →L[ℂ] K) = T at hx
          exact ⟨x, hx⟩
        · rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
          refine ⟨x, ?_⟩
          change (f x : K →L[ℂ] K) = T
          exact hx
      change Set.centralizer (Set.centralizer (g.range : Set (K →L[ℂ] K))) =
        (g.range : Set (K →L[ℂ] K))
      rw [hRange]
      exact (f.operatorRange_eq_bicommutant hf).symm }

/-- The constructed von Neumann carrier is exactly the original concrete operator range. -/
theorem coe_imageVonNeumannAlgebra (f : NormalStarAlgHom M N) (hf : Function.Injective f) :
    (f.imageVonNeumannAlgebra hf : Set (K →L[ℂ] K)) =
      Set.range (fun x : M => (f x : K →L[ℂ] K)) := by
  change ((N.toStarSubalgebra.subtype.comp f.toStarAlgHom).range : Set (K →L[ℂ] K)) =
    Set.range (fun x : M => (f x : K →L[ℂ] K))
  ext T
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
    change (f x : K →L[ℂ] K) = T at hx
    exact ⟨x, hx⟩
  · rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
    refine ⟨x, ?_⟩
    change (f x : K →L[ℂ] K) = T
    exact hx

end

end VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalStarAlgHom

Continuous functional precomposition by the constructed predual pullback

isometries identify that dual map with the same original normal homomorphism.
Every value is literal evaluation at f(x). No predual quotient, dual

      f.predualPullback) (normalFunctionalEvaluationEquiv M x) =

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalHom.FaithfulPredualQuotient
public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Isomorphisms

/-!
# The actual faithful normal range is the annihilator of its predual kernel

An original target element defines actual evaluation on its normal predual.
If this evaluation vanishes on the literal predual-pullback kernel, the
proved surjective quotient descends it to a continuous functional on the
original source predual. The actual evaluation isometry gives a source
operator whose original map value is the target element. No predual,
quotient, range-closure or inverse/model certificate is supplied.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

namespace VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalStarAlgHom

noncomputable section

universe u v

variable {H : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
variable {K : Type v} [NormedAddCommGroup K] [InnerProductSpace ℂ K] [CompleteSpace K]
variable {M : VonNeumannAlgebra H} {N : VonNeumannAlgebra K}

/-- Literal annihilation of the actual predual kernel constructs an original operator preimage. -/
theorem exists_preimage_of_predual_kernel (f : NormalStarAlgHom M N)
    (hf : Function.Injective f) (y : N)
    (hy : ∀ φ : normalFunctionalSpace N, f.predualPullback φ = 0 → (φ : StrongDual ℂ N) y = 0) :
    ∃ x : M, f x = y := by
  let B := f.predualPullback
  let F : StrongDual ℂ (normalFunctionalSpace N) := normalFunctionalEvaluationEquiv N y
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective B := f.predualPullback_surjective_of_injective hf
  have hker : LinearMap.ker B.toLinearMap ≤ LinearMap.ker F.toLinearMap := by
    intro φ hφ
    change F φ = 0
    exact hy φ hφ
  let g : normalFunctionalSpace M →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ :=
    (B.toLinearMap.liftOfSurjective hsurj) ⟨F.toLinearMap, hker⟩
  have hvalue (φ : normalFunctionalSpace N) : g (B φ) = F φ :=
    LinearMap.equivOfSurjective_apply hsurj hker
  have hcontinuous : Continuous g := by
    apply (f.predualPullback_isQuotientMap_of_injective hf).continuous_iff.mpr
    have hfunction : ((g : normalFunctionalSpace M → ℂ) ∘ B) = F := funext hvalue
    rw [hfunction]
    exact F.continuous
  let G : StrongDual ℂ (normalFunctionalSpace M) := ⟨g, hcontinuous⟩
  let x : M := (normalFunctionalEvaluationEquiv M).symm G
  refine ⟨x, ?_⟩
  apply (normalFunctionalEvaluationEquiv N).injective
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro φ
  have hx : normalFunctionalEvaluationEquiv M x = G :=
    (normalFunctionalEvaluationEquiv M).apply_symm_apply G
  have hxeval := congrArg (fun L : StrongDual ℂ (normalFunctionalSpace M) => L (B φ)) hx
  calc
    normalFunctionalEvaluationEquiv N (f x) φ = (φ : StrongDual ℂ N) (f x) := rfl
    _ = (B φ : StrongDual ℂ M) x := (f.predualPullback_apply φ x).symm
    _ = G (B φ) := hxeval
    _ = F φ := hvalue φ
    _ = normalFunctionalEvaluationEquiv N y φ := rfl

/-- The original operator range is exactly the literal annihilator of the actual predual kernel. -/
theorem mem_range_iff_predual_kernel (f : NormalStarAlgHom M N)
    (hf : Function.Injective f) (y : N) :
    y ∈ Set.range f ↔ ∀ φ : normalFunctionalSpace N,
      f.predualPullback φ = 0 → (φ : StrongDual ℂ N) y = 0 := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, rfl⟩ φ hφ
    rw [← f.predualPullback_apply φ x, hφ]
    rfl
  · intro hy
    exact f.exists_preimage_of_predual_kernel hf y hy

end

end VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalStarAlgHom

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalHom.FaithfulPredualQuotient
public import Mathlib.Logic.Equiv.Set
public import Mathlib.Topology.Homeomorph.Defs

/-!
# A faithful normal map is a homeomorphism onto its actual ultraweak range

The original normal map is injective between the actual ultraweak views.
Its literal range equivalence is constructed by the stock injective-range
factory. Every original source normal evaluation has a genuine target
predual preimage under the constructed pullback. Those original target
evaluations prove continuity of the actual inverse. No range, quotient,
normal inverse or model certificate is supplied as an input.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

namespace VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalStarAlgHom

noncomputable section

universe u v

variable {H : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
variable {K : Type v} [NormedAddCommGroup K] [InnerProductSpace ℂ K] [CompleteSpace K]
variable {M : VonNeumannAlgebra H} {N : VonNeumannAlgebra K}

/-- Construct the original ultraweak homeomorphism onto the literal operator-map range. -/
def ultraweakRangeHomeomorph (f : NormalStarAlgHom M N) (hf : Function.Injective f) :
    Ultraweak M ≃ₜ Set.range f.ultraweakMap := by
  have hinjective : Function.Injective f.ultraweakMap := by
    intro x y hxy
    apply (ultraweakLinearEquiv M).injective
    apply hf
    have hvalue := congrArg (ultraweakLinearEquiv N) hxy
    simpa only [f.ultraweakMap_apply, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] using hvalue
  let e : Ultraweak M ≃ Set.range f.ultraweakMap := Equiv.ofInjective f.ultraweakMap hinjective
  have hforward : Continuous e := by
    change Continuous (fun x : Ultraweak M =>
      (⟨f.ultraweakMap x, Set.mem_range_self x⟩ : Set.range f.ultraweakMap))
    exact f.ultraweakMap.continuous.subtype_mk (fun x => Set.mem_range_self x)
  have hinverse : Continuous e.symm := by
    apply (ultraweak_continuous_iff M).mpr
    intro ψ
    obtain ⟨φ, hφ⟩ := f.predualPullback_surjective_of_injective hf ψ
    have hfunction :
        (fun y : Set.range f.ultraweakMap => (ψ : StrongDual ℂ M) (ultraweakLinearEquiv M (e.symm y))) =
        (fun y : Set.range f.ultraweakMap => (φ : StrongDual ℂ N) (ultraweakLinearEquiv N y.val)) := by
      funext y
      have hmap := Equiv.apply_ofInjective_symm hinjective y
      have hvalue := congrArg (ultraweakLinearEquiv N) hmap
      rw [f.ultraweakMap_apply, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] at hvalue
      calc
        (ψ : StrongDual ℂ M) (ultraweakLinearEquiv M (e.symm y)) =
            (f.predualPullback φ : StrongDual ℂ M) (ultraweakLinearEquiv M (e.symm y)) := by rw [hφ]
        _ = (φ : StrongDual ℂ N) (f (ultraweakLinearEquiv M (e.symm y))) :=
          f.predualPullback_apply φ _
        _ = (φ : StrongDual ℂ N) (ultraweakLinearEquiv N y.val) := congrArg (φ : StrongDual ℂ N) hvalue
    rw [hfunction]
    exact (ultraweak_eval_continuous N φ).comp continuous_subtype_val
  exact ⟨e, hforward, hinverse⟩

/-- The actual range homeomorphism retains exactly the original ultraweak-map value. -/
@[simp]
theorem ultraweakRangeHomeomorph_apply (f : NormalStarAlgHom M N) (hf : Function.Injective f)
    (x : Ultraweak M) : (f.ultraweakRangeHomeomorph hf x).val = f.ultraweakMap x :=
  rfl

end

end VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalStarAlgHom

/-!
# Normal homomorphisms from actual vector-functional pullbacks

Norm-continuous functional precomposition preserves the closed span once
it preserves every original vector functional. The evaluation-induced
ultraweak topology then gives the normality of the same algebra map.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open scoped CStarAlgebra

namespace VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalStarAlgHom

noncomputable section

universe uH uK

variable {H : Type uH} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
variable {K : Type uK} [NormedAddCommGroup K] [InnerProductSpace ℂ K] [CompleteSpace K]
variable {M : VonNeumannAlgebra H} {N : VonNeumannAlgebra K}

/-- The literal star map is normal when its computed vector pullbacks lie in the actual source predual. -/
def ofVectorFunctionalPullbacks (f : M →⋆ₐ[ℂ] N)
    (hvec : ∀ ξ η : K, (vectorFunctional N ξ η).comp
      (⟨LinearMap.ofClass f, map_continuous f⟩ : M →L[ℂ] N) ∈ normalFunctionalSpace M) :
    NormalStarAlgHom M N where
  toStarAlgHom := f
  continuous_ultraweak := by
    let F : M →L[ℂ] N := ⟨LinearMap.ofClass f, map_continuous f⟩
    let B : StrongDual ℂ N →L[ℂ] StrongDual ℂ M := (ContinuousLinearMap.compL ℂ M N ℂ).flip F
    let P : Submodule ℂ (StrongDual ℂ N) := (normalFunctionalSpace M).comap B.toLinearMap
    have hP : IsClosed (P : Set (StrongDual ℂ N)) :=
      (normalFunctionalSpace_isClosed M).preimage B.continuous
    have hNP : normalFunctionalSpace N ≤ P := by
      apply normalFunctionalSpace_le N hP
      intro ξ η
      exact hvec ξ η
    apply (ultraweak_continuous_iff N).2
    intro φ
    let ψ : normalFunctionalSpace M := ⟨B (φ : StrongDual ℂ N), hNP φ.property⟩
    have hfun :
        (fun x : Ultraweak M => (φ : StrongDual ℂ N)
          (ultraweakLinearEquiv N ((ultraweakLinearEquiv N).symm (f (ultraweakLinearEquiv M x))))) =
        (fun x : Ultraweak M => (ψ : StrongDual ℂ M) (ultraweakLinearEquiv M x)) := by
      funext x
      rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
      rfl
    rw [hfun]
    exact ultraweak_eval_continuous M ψ

end

end VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalStarAlgHom

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.PositiveCutoffProjection
public import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Projection

/-!
# The actual positive cutoff lies inside its original comparison projection

A positive threshold times the actual cutoff lies below the original
positive comparison operator. If that operator lies below a projection,
the stock projection multiplication law and scalar cancellation show the
same cutoff lies below that projection. A nonzero positive comparison
operator therefore gives a genuine nonzero cutoff inside the original
projection, with its exact threshold retained.

This supplies localization prerequisites for the actual positive
order-normal/predual construction, without a supplied cutoff, normal
functional or representation model.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open CStarAlgebra.ScalarWeight

namespace VonNeumannAlgebra

noncomputable section

universe u

variable {H : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

/-- A positive threshold cutoff is below the original projection bounding its positive operator. -/
theorem positiveCutoffProjection_le_projection (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H)
    (a : PositiveElement M) (e : M) (he : IsStarProjection e) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r)
    (hae : @LE.le M (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE (a : M) e) :
    @LE.le M (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE (positiveCutoffProjection M a r) e := by
  let : PartialOrder M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M
  let : LE M := (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE
  let : StarOrderedRing M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing M
  let p : M := positiveCutoffProjection M a r
  have hp : IsStarProjection p := positiveCutoffProjection_isStarProjection M a r
  have hp0 : 0 ≤ p := by
    simpa only [hp.isSelfAdjoint.star_eq, hp.isIdempotentElem.eq] using star_mul_self_nonneg p
  have hscaled : r • p ≤ e := (positiveCutoffProjection_threshold M a r).trans hae
  have hproduct := (he.mul_right_and_mul_left_of_nonneg_of_le (smul_nonneg hr.le hp0) hscaled).2
  rw [mul_smul_comm] at hproduct
  have hfix : e * p = p := by
    have h := congrArg (fun z : M => r⁻¹ • z) hproduct
    simpa only [smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hr.ne', one_smul] using h
  exact (hp.le_iff_mul_eq_right he).mpr hfix

/-- A nonzero positive comparison operator gives a nonzero actual cutoff inside its source projection. -/
theorem exists_positiveCutoffProjection_below_projection (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H)
    (a : PositiveElement M) (e : M) (he : IsStarProjection e)
    (hne : (a : M) ≠ 0)
    (hae : @LE.le M (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE (a : M) e) :
    ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ positiveCutoffProjection M a r ≠ 0 ∧
      @LE.le M (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE (positiveCutoffProjection M a r) e ∧
      @LE.le M (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE (r • positiveCutoffProjection M a r) (a : M) := by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hnonzero⟩ := exists_positiveCutoffProjection_nonzero M a hne
  exact ⟨r, hr, hnonzero, positiveCutoffProjection_le_projection M a e he r hr hae,
    positiveCutoffProjection_threshold M a r⟩

end

end VonNeumannAlgebra

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.PositiveRangeProjection
public import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.SpecialFunctions.PosPart
public import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.ContinuousFunctionalCalculus.Order

/-!
# The actual positive cutoff projection and its original threshold

The cutoff is the original support of the positive part of a minus a real
scalar identity. The actual support fixes that positive part and annihilates
its negative part. Their original decomposition gives the threshold bound
without a spectral-cutoff model. A genuine source threshold/nonzero positive
operator supplies nonzero cutoff projections.

These DATA and algebra facts are required for local vector domination in
an actual positive order-normal/predual construction. No cutoff, normal
functional or representation model is supplied; terminal source proofs,
true normal membership and GNS normality/range remain separate.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open CStarAlgebra.ScalarWeight
open scoped CStarAlgebra InnerProductSpace

namespace VonNeumannAlgebra

noncomputable section

universe u

variable {H : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

/-- The actual cutoff is the original support of the literal shifted positive part. -/
def positiveCutoffProjection (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (a : PositiveElement M) (r : ℝ) : M :=
  letI : PartialOrder M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M
  letI : LE M := (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE
  letI : StarOrderedRing M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing M
  positiveRangeProjection M ⟨((a : M) - algebraMap ℝ M r)⁺, CFC.posPart_nonneg _⟩

/-- The same original shifted-positive-part support is a genuine star projection. -/
theorem positiveCutoffProjection_isStarProjection (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H)
    (a : PositiveElement M) (r : ℝ) : IsStarProjection (positiveCutoffProjection M a r) := by
  let : PartialOrder M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M
  let : LE M := (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE
  let : StarOrderedRing M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing M
  have h := positiveRangeProjection_isStarProjection M
    ⟨((a : M) - algebraMap ℝ M r)⁺, CFC.posPart_nonneg _⟩
  constructor
  · apply Subtype.val_injective
    exact h.isIdempotentElem.eq
  · apply Subtype.val_injective
    exact h.isSelfAdjoint.star_eq

/-- The actual original cutoff projection satisfies its original scalar threshold bound. -/
theorem positiveCutoffProjection_threshold (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H)
    (a : PositiveElement M) (r : ℝ) :
    @LE.le M (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE (r • positiveCutoffProjection M a r) (a : M) := by
  let : PartialOrder M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M
  let : LE M := (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE
  let : StarOrderedRing M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing M
  let d : M := (a : M) - algebraMap ℝ M r
  let c : M := d⁺
  let n : M := d⁻
  let p : M := positiveCutoffProjection M a r
  let q : M := 1 - p
  have hd : IsSelfAdjoint d :=
    (IsSelfAdjoint.of_nonneg a.property).sub ((show IsSelfAdjoint r from rfl).algebraMap M)
  have hc : 0 ≤ c := CFC.posPart_nonneg d
  have hn : 0 ≤ n := CFC.negPart_nonneg d
  have hcstar : star c = c := IsSelfAdjoint.of_nonneg hc
  have hnstar : star n = n := IsSelfAdjoint.of_nonneg hn
  have hp : IsStarProjection p := positiveCutoffProjection_isStarProjection M a r
  have hpstar : star p = p := hp.isSelfAdjoint.star_eq
  have hpc : p * c = c := positiveRangeProjection_mul_self M ⟨c, hc⟩
  have hcp : c * p = c := by
    have h := congrArg (star : M → M) hpc
    simpa only [star_mul, hpstar, hcstar] using h
  have hnc : n * c = 0 := CFC.negPart_mul_posPart d
  have hnp : n * p = 0 := mul_positiveRangeProjection_eq_zero M ⟨c, hc⟩ n hnc
  have hpn : p * n = 0 := by
    have h := congrArg (star : M → M) hnp
    simpa only [star_mul, hpstar, hnstar, star_zero] using h
  have ha : (a : M) = c - n + algebraMap ℝ M r := by
    have h := CFC.posPart_sub_negPart d hd
    change c - n = (a : M) - algebraMap ℝ M r at h
    rw [h]
    abel
  have hpa : p * (a : M) = c + r • p := by
    rw [ha, mul_add, mul_sub, hpc, hpn, sub_zero, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one,
      mul_smul_comm, mul_one]
  have hap : (a : M) * p = c + r • p := by
    rw [ha, add_mul, sub_mul, hcp, hnp, sub_zero, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one,
      smul_mul_assoc, one_mul]
  have hpap : p * (a : M) * p = c + r • p := by
    rw [hpa, add_mul, hcp, smul_mul_assoc, hp.isIdempotentElem.eq]
  have hq : q * (a : M) * q = (a : M) - (c + r • p) - (c + r • p) + (c + r • p) := by
    calc
      q * (a : M) * q = (a : M) - (a : M) * p - p * (a : M) + p * (a : M) * p := by
        simp only [q, sub_mul, mul_sub, one_mul, mul_one]
        abel
      _ = _ := by rw [hpap, hpa, hap]
  have hdecomp : (a : M) - r • p = c + q * (a : M) * q := by
    rw [hq]
    abel
  apply sub_nonneg.mp
  rw [hdecomp]
  have hqpos : 0 ≤ q * (a : M) * q := by
    simpa only [q, star_sub, star_one, hpstar] using star_left_conjugate_nonneg a.property q
  exact add_nonneg hc hqpos

/-- A genuine original above-threshold positive value gives a nonzero actual cutoff projection. -/
theorem positiveCutoffProjection_ne_zero_of_not_le (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H)
    (a : PositiveElement M) (r : ℝ)
    (hnot : ¬ @LE.le M (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE (a : M) (algebraMap ℝ M r)) :
    positiveCutoffProjection M a r ≠ 0 := by
  let : PartialOrder M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M
  let : LE M := (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE
  let : StarOrderedRing M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing M
  let d : M := (a : M) - algebraMap ℝ M r
  let c : M := d⁺
  have hd : IsSelfAdjoint d :=
    (IsSelfAdjoint.of_nonneg a.property).sub ((show IsSelfAdjoint r from rfl).algebraMap M)
  intro hpzero
  have hpc : positiveCutoffProjection M a r * c = c :=
    positiveRangeProjection_mul_self M ⟨c, CFC.posPart_nonneg d⟩
  rw [hpzero, zero_mul] at hpc
  have hczero : d⁺ = 0 := hpc.symm
  have hnonpos : d ≤ 0 := (CFC.posPart_eq_zero_iff d hd).mp hczero
  exact hnot (sub_nonpos.mp hnonpos)

/-- Every nonzero original positive operator has a genuine positive threshold with nonzero cutoff. -/
theorem exists_positiveCutoffProjection_nonzero (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H)
    (a : PositiveElement M) (hne : (a : M) ≠ 0) :
    ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ positiveCutoffProjection M a r ≠ 0 := by
  let : PartialOrder M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M
  let : LE M := (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE
  let : StarOrderedRing M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing M
  have hnorm : 0 < ‖(a : M)‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hne
  refine ⟨‖(a : M)‖ / 2, by positivity, ?_⟩
  apply positiveCutoffProjection_ne_zero_of_not_le
  intro hle
  have h := (CStarAlgebra.norm_le_iff_le_algebraMap (a : M)
    (by positivity : 0 ≤ ‖(a : M)‖ / 2) a.property).mpr hle
  linarith

end

end VonNeumannAlgebra

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Weight
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalFunctional
public import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.GelfandNaimarkSegal
public import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.ContinuousFunctionalCalculus.Order
public import Mathlib.Topology.Algebra.Module.ContinuousLinearMap.Positive

/-!
# A literal local positive comparison bounds the localized functional

The original functional's comparison with an actual vector coefficient on
positive operators below a projection extends to every positive corner by
finite positive scaling. The stock Cauchy--Schwarz inequality then bounds
the original localized value on a*p by that operator's action on the same
vector. No vector-bound or normal-functional membership certificate is an
input.

The local positive comparison is a mathematical hypothesis to be produced
by the original order-normal comparison construction. It is not selected
from an open source theorem; this module does not construct a normal GNS
homomorphism or supply the missing global predual criterion.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open CStarAlgebra.ScalarWeight
open scoped InnerProductSpace

namespace VonNeumannAlgebra

noncomputable section

universe u

variable {H : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

/-- A local positive comparison gives the literal Gram-corner vector comparison by scaling. -/
theorem positiveCompression_re_le_of_local_vector_comparison (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H)
    (ψ : StrongDual ℂ M) (p : M) (hp : IsStarProjection p) (ξ : H)
    (hlocal : ∀ b : PositiveElement M,
      @LE.le M (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE (b : M) p →
      (ψ (b : M)).re ≤ (vectorFunctional M ξ ξ (b : M)).re) (a : M) :
    (ψ (star (a * p) * (a * p))).re ≤ ‖((a * p : M) : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ‖ ^ 2 := by
  let : PartialOrder M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M
  let : LE M := (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE
  let : StarOrderedRing M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing M
  let t : M := star (a * p) * (a * p)
  let c : ℝ := ‖star a * a‖ + 1
  have hc : 0 < c := by
    dsimp only [c]
    linarith [norm_nonneg (star a * a)]
  have hpstar : star p = p := hp.isSelfAdjoint.star_eq
  have hp0 : 0 ≤ p := by
    simpa only [hpstar, hp.isIdempotentElem.eq] using star_mul_self_nonneg p
  have ht0 : 0 ≤ t := star_mul_self_nonneg (a * p)
  have hbase : t ≤ ‖star a * a‖ • p := by
    have h := CStarAlgebra.star_left_conjugate_le_norm_smul p (star a * a)
      (IsSelfAdjoint.star_mul_self a)
    simpa only [t, star_mul, hpstar, mul_assoc, hp.isIdempotentElem.eq] using h
  have hbound : t ≤ c • p :=
    hbase.trans (smul_le_smul_of_nonneg_right (by dsimp only [c]; linarith) hp0)
  have hscaled : c⁻¹ • t ≤ p := by
    have h := smul_le_smul_of_nonneg_left hbound (inv_pos.mpr hc).le
    simpa only [smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hc.ne', one_smul] using h
  have hsmall0 : 0 ≤ c⁻¹ • t := smul_nonneg (inv_pos.mpr hc).le ht0
  have hcomparison := hlocal ⟨c⁻¹ • t, hsmall0⟩ hscaled
  have hψ : (ψ (c⁻¹ • t)).re = c⁻¹ * (ψ t).re := by
    change RCLike.re (ψ (c⁻¹ • t)) = c⁻¹ * RCLike.re (ψ t)
    rw [ψ.map_smul_of_tower, RCLike.smul_re]
  have hvector : (vectorFunctional M ξ ξ (c⁻¹ • t)).re =
      c⁻¹ * (vectorFunctional M ξ ξ t).re := by
    change RCLike.re (vectorFunctional M ξ ξ (c⁻¹ • t)) =
      c⁻¹ * RCLike.re (vectorFunctional M ξ ξ t)
    rw [(vectorFunctional M ξ ξ).map_smul_of_tower, RCLike.smul_re]
  change (ψ (c⁻¹ • t)).re ≤ (vectorFunctional M ξ ξ (c⁻¹ • t)).re at hcomparison
  rw [hψ, hvector] at hcomparison
  have hfull : (ψ t).re ≤ (vectorFunctional M ξ ξ t).re := by
    have hcinv : 0 < c⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr hc
    nlinarith
  have hvalue : (vectorFunctional M ξ ξ t).re = ‖((a * p : M) : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ‖ ^ 2 := by
    rw [vectorFunctional_apply]
    let A : H →L[ℂ] H := ((a * p : M) : H →L[ℂ] H)
    change RCLike.re ⟪ξ, (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint A ∘L A) ξ⟫_ℂ = ‖A ξ‖ ^ 2
    exact (ContinuousLinearMap.apply_norm_sq_eq_inner_adjoint_right A ξ).symm
  rw [← hvalue]
  exact hfull

/-- Positivity and the original local comparison give the localized functional's actual vector bound. -/
theorem localizedPositiveFunctional_norm_sq_le_vector (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) :
    letI : PartialOrder M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M
    letI : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ
    ∀ (ψ : PositiveContinuousLinearMap ℂ M ℂ) (p : M) (_hp : IsStarProjection p) (ξ : H),
      (∀ b : PositiveElement M,
        @LE.le M (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE (b : M) p →
        (ψ.toContinuousLinearMap (b : M)).re ≤ (vectorFunctional M ξ ξ (b : M)).re) →
      ∀ a : M, ‖ψ.toContinuousLinearMap (a * p)‖ ^ 2 ≤
        ‖ψ.toContinuousLinearMap 1‖ * ‖((a * p : M) : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ‖ ^ 2 := by
  let : PartialOrder M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M
  let : LE M := (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE
  let : StarOrderedRing M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing M
  let : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ
  intro ψ p hp ξ hlocal a
  let φ : StrongDual ℂ M := ψ.toContinuousLinearMap
  have horders (z w : ℂ) : @LE.le ℂ (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ).toLE z w ↔
      @LE.le ℂ Complex.partialOrder.toLE z w := by
    have hspectral : @LE.le ℂ (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ).toLE z w ↔
        ∃ d, d ∈ AddSubmonoid.closure (Set.range fun s : ℂ => star s * s) ∧ w = z + d := by
      let : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ
      let : LE ℂ := (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ).toLE
      let : StarOrderedRing ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing ℂ
      exact StarOrderedRing.le_iff z w
    have hstandard : @LE.le ℂ Complex.partialOrder.toLE z w ↔
        ∃ d, d ∈ AddSubmonoid.closure (Set.range fun s : ℂ => star s * s) ∧ w = z + d := by
      let : PartialOrder ℂ := Complex.partialOrder
      let : LE ℂ := Complex.partialOrder.toLE
      let : StarOrderedRing ℂ := RCLike.toStarOrderedRing
      exact StarOrderedRing.le_iff z w
    exact hspectral.trans hstandard.symm
  have hmonotone (x y : M) (hxy : @LE.le M (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE x y) :
      @LE.le ℂ (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ).toLE (φ x) (φ y) := ψ.monotone' hxy
  let t : M := star (a * p) * (a * p)
  have hpositive : @LE.le ℂ (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ).toLE 0 (φ t) :=
    ψ.map_nonneg (star_mul_self_nonneg (a * p))
  have hnorm : ‖φ t‖ = (φ t).re := by
    have hstandard := (horders 0 (φ t)).mp hpositive
    have h := congrArg (fun z : ℂ => z.re) (Complex.eq_coe_norm_of_nonneg hstandard)
    simpa only [Complex.ofReal_re] using h.symm
  have hcomparison := positiveCompression_re_le_of_local_vector_comparison M φ p hp ξ hlocal a
  have hcs : ‖φ (a * p)‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖φ 1‖ * ‖φ t‖ := by
    let : PartialOrder ℂ := Complex.partialOrder
    let : LE ℂ := Complex.partialOrder.toLE
    let f : PositiveLinearMap ℂ M ℂ :=
      { __ := φ.toLinearMap
        monotone' := by
          intro x y hxy
          exact (horders (φ x) (φ y)).mp (hmonotone x y hxy) }
    have hf (z : M) : f z = φ z := rfl
    have h := PositiveLinearMap.norm_map_star_mul_sq_le f (1 : M) (a * p)
    simpa only [hf, t, star_one, one_mul, mul_one] using h
  calc
    ‖ψ.toContinuousLinearMap (a * p)‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖φ 1‖ * ‖φ t‖ := hcs
    _ = ‖φ 1‖ * (φ t).re := by rw [hnorm]
    _ ≤ ‖φ 1‖ * ‖((a * p : M) : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ‖ ^ 2 :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcomparison (norm_nonneg _)

end

end VonNeumannAlgebra

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.Basic
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.PositiveFunctionalProjectionResidual

/-!
# The original positive functional's right-projection residual norm bound

The original source-facing name delegates to the generic unital C-star
positive-functional/projection theorem with the actual inherited norm and
canonical coefficient orders. All original functional/projection values
and zero-H cases are unchanged.
The residual value ψ(1-p) controls the continuous-dual norm error used by
finite-projection approximation; no normal membership or cutoff bound is
an input.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

namespace VonNeumannAlgebra

noncomputable section

universe u

variable {H : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

/-- The literal right-projection residual has its original positive-functional norm bound. -/
theorem positiveFunctional_rightProjection_residual_norm_le (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) :
    letI : PartialOrder M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M
    letI : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ
    ∀ (ψ : PositiveContinuousLinearMap ℂ M ℂ) (p : M), IsStarProjection p →
      ‖ψ.toContinuousLinearMap -
        ψ.toContinuousLinearMap.comp ((ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ M).flip p)‖ ≤
        Real.sqrt (‖ψ.toContinuousLinearMap‖ * ‖ψ.toContinuousLinearMap (1 - p)‖) := by
  let : PartialOrder M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M
  let : StarOrderedRing M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing M
  let : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ
  exact PositiveContinuousLinearMap.rightProjection_residual_norm_le (A := M)

end

end VonNeumannAlgebra

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.UltraweakOrder
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.ConjugationPredual
public import Mathlib.Topology.Compactness.Compact
public import Mathlib.Topology.ClusterPt

/-!
# A provided original bounded positive LUB is its ultraweak directed limit

The original positive family stays in the actual compact positive part of
its original norm bound. Closed comparisons force each cluster point to be
an upper bound of the same family and below its provided original LUB.
Uniqueness gives the actual ultraweak limit. Fixed literal star conjugation
then preserves that same LUB by its proved ultraweak continuity.

These are prerequisites for the actual normal-weight/GNS normality
construction. No supremum is supplied as a new model or chosen from an
open source existence/completeness theorem. The original directed family,
positive hypothesis, actual bound and actual IsLUB relation are retained.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open Filter Set
open scoped Topology

namespace VonNeumannAlgebra

noncomputable section

universe u v

variable {H : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
variable {I : Type v} [Preorder I]

/-- A bounded positive LUB is the actual ultraweak limit for a nonbottom original index filter. -/
theorem boundedPositiveIsLUB_tendsto_ultraweak [NeBot (atTop : Filter I)]
    (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (a : I → M) (s : M)
    (hmono : @Monotone I M inferInstance (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toPreorder a)
    (hpositive : ∀ i, @LE.le M (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE 0 (a i))
    (hbound : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ i, ‖a i‖ ≤ C)
    (hLUB : @IsLUB M (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE (Set.range a) s) :
    Tendsto (fun i => (ultraweakLinearEquiv M).symm (a i)) atTop
      (𝓝 ((ultraweakLinearEquiv M).symm s)) := by
  let : PartialOrder (Ultraweak M) := ultraweakPartialOrder M
  let : OrderClosedTopology (Ultraweak M) := ultraweakOrderClosedTopology M
  let f : I → Ultraweak M := fun i => (ultraweakLinearEquiv M).symm (a i)
  have hmonoUL : Monotone f := by
    intro i j hij
    apply (ultraweak_le_iff M (f i) (f j)).mpr
    simpa only [f, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] using hmono hij
  have hLUBUL : IsLUB (Set.range f) ((ultraweakLinearEquiv M).symm s) := by
    constructor
    · rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
      apply (ultraweak_le_iff M (f i) ((ultraweakLinearEquiv M).symm s)).mpr
      simpa only [f, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] using hLUB.1 (Set.mem_range_self i)
    · intro x hx
      apply (ultraweak_le_iff M ((ultraweakLinearEquiv M).symm s) x).mpr
      change @LE.le M (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE s (ultraweakLinearEquiv M x)
      apply hLUB.2
      rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
      have h := (ultraweak_le_iff M (f i) x).mp (hx (Set.mem_range_self i))
      simpa only [f, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] using h
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hbound
  let K : Set (Ultraweak M) := Ici (0 : Ultraweak M) ∩
    {x | ‖ultraweakLinearEquiv M x‖ ≤ C}
  have hcompact : IsCompact K := (ultraweakClosedBall_isCompact M C).inter_left isClosed_Ici
  have hmem : ∀ᶠ i in atTop, f i ∈ K := Eventually.of_forall fun i => by
    constructor
    · apply (ultraweak_le_iff M 0 (f i)).mpr
      simpa only [f, map_zero, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] using hpositive i
    · change ‖ultraweakLinearEquiv M ((ultraweakLinearEquiv M).symm (a i))‖ ≤ C
      simpa only [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] using hC i
  have hunique (y : Ultraweak M) (_hy : y ∈ K) (hy : MapClusterPt y atTop f) :
      y = (ultraweakLinearEquiv M).symm s := by
    have hycluster : ClusterPt y (Filter.map f atTop) := hy
    apply le_antisymm
    · have hupper : Iic ((ultraweakLinearEquiv M).symm s) ∈ Filter.map f atTop :=
        Filter.mem_map.mpr (Eventually.of_forall fun i => hLUBUL.1 (Set.mem_range_self i))
      exact isClosed_Iic.mem_of_nhdsWithin_neBot
        (hycluster.mono (le_principal_iff.mpr hupper))
    · apply hLUBUL.2
      rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
      have hlower : Ici (f i) ∈ Filter.map f atTop :=
        Filter.mem_map.mpr ((eventually_ge_atTop i).mono fun j hij => hmonoUL hij)
      exact isClosed_Ici.mem_of_nhdsWithin_neBot
        (hycluster.mono (le_principal_iff.mpr hlower))
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hycluster⟩ := hcompact.exists_mapClusterPt (u := f) (f := (atTop : Filter I))
    (le_principal_iff.mpr (Filter.mem_map.mpr hmem))
  have hyeq := hunique y hy hycluster
  have hlimit : Tendsto f atTop (𝓝 y) :=
    hcompact.tendsto_nhds_of_unique_mapClusterPt hmem
      (fun z hz hzcluster => (hunique z hz hzcluster).trans hyeq.symm)
  simpa only [hyeq, f] using hlimit

variable [IsDirectedOrder I] [Nonempty I]

/-- Literal fixed star conjugation preserves the same provided original bounded positive LUB. -/
theorem starConjugation_preserves_boundedPositiveIsLUB (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (x : M)
    (a : I → M) (s : M)
    (hmono : @Monotone I M inferInstance (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toPreorder a)
    (hpositive : ∀ i, @LE.le M (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE 0 (a i))
    (hbound : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ i, ‖a i‖ ≤ C)
    (hLUB : @IsLUB M (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE (Set.range a) s) :
    @IsLUB M (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE
      (Set.range fun i => star x * a i * x) (star x * s * x) := by
  let : PartialOrder M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M
  let : StarOrderedRing M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing M
  let : PartialOrder (Ultraweak M) := ultraweakPartialOrder M
  let : OrderClosedTopology (Ultraweak M) := ultraweakOrderClosedTopology M
  let f : I → Ultraweak M := fun i => (ultraweakLinearEquiv M).symm (star x * a i * x)
  let t : Ultraweak M := (ultraweakLinearEquiv M).symm (star x * s * x)
  have ha := boundedPositiveIsLUB_tendsto_ultraweak M a s hmono hpositive hbound hLUB
  have hc := (ultraweak_starConjugation_continuous M x).tendsto
    ((ultraweakLinearEquiv M).symm s) |>.comp ha
  have hlimit : Tendsto f atTop (𝓝 t) := by
    rw [Function.comp_def] at hc
    simpa only [f, t, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] using hc
  have hleSource : ∀ i, @LE.le M (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE
      (star x * a i * x) (star x * s * x) := fun i =>
    star_left_conjugate_le_conjugate (hLUB.1 (Set.mem_range_self i)) x
  have hle : ∀ i, f i ≤ t := fun i => by
    apply (ultraweak_le_iff M (f i) t).mpr
    simpa only [f, t, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] using hleSource i
  have ht : IsLUB (Set.range f) t := IsLUB.range_of_tendsto hle hlimit
  constructor
  · rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    exact hleSource i
  · intro b hb
    have hbUL : (ultraweakLinearEquiv M).symm b ∈ upperBounds (Set.range f) := by
      rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
      apply (ultraweak_le_iff M (f i) ((ultraweakLinearEquiv M).symm b)).mpr
      simpa only [f, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] using hb (Set.mem_range_self i)
    have h := (ultraweak_le_iff M t ((ultraweakLinearEquiv M).symm b)).mp (ht.2 hbUL)
    simpa only [t, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] using h

end

end VonNeumannAlgebra

Author: @toskua

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalFunctional
public import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.ContinuousFunctionalCalculus.Basic
public import Mathlib.Topology.Algebra.Module.ContinuousLinearMap.Positive

/-!
# Actual positive normal functionals through positive continuous linear maps

The index stores Mathlib's positive continuous linear map on the original
concrete algebra, together with membership of that same bounded functional
in the actual normal-functional space. The source and scalar orders are
the canonical spectral orders. A lossless equivalence retains the complete
original family of normal functionals with monotonicity.

Evaluation and norm use the original continuous linear map. Positivity,
linearity and continuity come from the existing positive-map bundle.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

namespace VonNeumannAlgebra

noncomputable section

universe u

variable {H : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

/-- An actual positive continuous linear map whose original bounded functional is normal. -/
def PositiveNormalFunctional (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) : Type u :=
  letI : PartialOrder M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M
  letI : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ
  {φ : M →P[ℂ] ℂ // φ.toContinuousLinearMap ∈ normalFunctionalSpace M}

namespace PositiveNormalFunctional

variable {M : VonNeumannAlgebra H}

/-- The same original functional as Mathlib's actual positive continuous linear map. -/
def toPositiveContinuousLinearMap (φ : PositiveNormalFunctional M) :
    letI : PartialOrder M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M
    letI : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ
    M →P[ℂ] ℂ := by
  letI : PartialOrder M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M
  letI : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ
  exact φ.1

/-- The original continuous linear functional underlying the positive normal map. -/
def toContinuousLinearMap (φ : PositiveNormalFunctional M) : StrongDual ℂ M := by
  letI : PartialOrder M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M
  letI : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ
  exact φ.1.toContinuousLinearMap

/-- The normal-functional subtype contains that literal original bounded functional. -/
def toNormalFunctionalSpace (φ : PositiveNormalFunctional M) : normalFunctionalSpace M :=
  ⟨φ.toContinuousLinearMap, φ.2⟩

instance : Coe (PositiveNormalFunctional M) (StrongDual ℂ M) :=
  ⟨toContinuousLinearMap⟩

instance : CoeFun (PositiveNormalFunctional M) (fun _ => M → ℂ) :=
  ⟨fun φ => φ.1⟩

/-- The bounded-functional and function views have exactly the same values. -/
@[simp]
theorem toContinuousLinearMap_apply (φ : PositiveNormalFunctional M) (x : M) :
    φ.toContinuousLinearMap x = φ x :=
  rfl

/-- Normal-space evaluation retains the same original functional values. -/
@[simp]
theorem toNormalFunctionalSpace_apply (φ : PositiveNormalFunctional M) (x : M) :
    (φ.toNormalFunctionalSpace : StrongDual ℂ M) x = φ x :=
  rfl

/-- The positive-map projection retains the original continuous linear map. -/
theorem toPositiveContinuousLinearMap_toContinuousLinearMap (φ : PositiveNormalFunctional M) :
    letI : PartialOrder M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M
    letI : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ
    φ.toPositiveContinuousLinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap = φ.toContinuousLinearMap := by
  let : PartialOrder M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M
  let : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ
  rfl

/-- The normal-space norm is the original continuous-dual operator norm. -/
theorem norm_toNormalFunctionalSpace (φ : PositiveNormalFunctional M) :
    ‖φ.toNormalFunctionalSpace‖ = ‖φ.toContinuousLinearMap‖ :=
  rfl

/-- The original functional is monotone for exactly the two canonical spectral orders. -/
theorem monotone (φ : PositiveNormalFunctional M) :
    letI : PartialOrder M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M
    letI : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ
    Monotone (φ : StrongDual ℂ M) := by
  let : PartialOrder M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M
  let : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ
  exact φ.1.monotone'

/-- Actual positive normal functionals preserve every canonically nonnegative element. -/
theorem apply_nonneg (φ : PositiveNormalFunctional M) (x : M) :
    letI : PartialOrder M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M
    letI : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ
    0 ≤ x → 0 ≤ φ x := by
  let : PartialOrder M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M
  let : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ
  intro hx
  exact φ.1.map_nonneg hx

/-- A Mathlib positive continuous linear map with actual normal membership gives the same index. -/
def ofPositiveContinuousLinearMap (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) :
    letI : PartialOrder M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M
    letI : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ
    (φ : M →P[ℂ] ℂ) → φ.toContinuousLinearMap ∈ normalFunctionalSpace M →
      PositiveNormalFunctional M := by
  letI : PartialOrder M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M
  letI : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ
  intro φ hφ
  exact ⟨φ, hφ⟩

/-- Package any member of the complete original normal-and-monotone family through Mathlib's bundle. -/
def ofNormalFunctional (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (φ : normalFunctionalSpace M)
    (hφ : letI : PartialOrder M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M
      letI : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ
      Monotone (φ : StrongDual ℂ M)) : PositiveNormalFunctional M := by
  letI : PartialOrder M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M
  letI : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ
  refine ⟨{ __ := (φ : StrongDual ℂ M), monotone' := hφ }, ?_⟩
  change (φ : StrongDual ℂ M) ∈ normalFunctionalSpace M
  exact φ.property

/-- Construction from an original normal functional preserves its literal bounded map. -/
theorem toContinuousLinearMap_ofNormalFunctional (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H)
    (φ : normalFunctionalSpace M)
    (hφ : letI : PartialOrder M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M
      letI : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ
      Monotone (φ : StrongDual ℂ M)) :
    (ofNormalFunctional M φ hφ : StrongDual ℂ M) = (φ : StrongDual ℂ M) :=
  rfl

/-- Construction recovers the same original normal-space element. -/
theorem toNormalFunctionalSpace_ofNormalFunctional (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H)
    (φ : normalFunctionalSpace M)
    (hφ : letI : PartialOrder M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M
      letI : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ
      Monotone (φ : StrongDual ℂ M)) :
    (ofNormalFunctional M φ hφ).toNormalFunctionalSpace = φ := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rfl

/-- The entire old normal-and-monotone family and the actual positive-map index are equivalent. -/
def equivNormalMonotone (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) :
    letI : PartialOrder M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M
    letI : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ
    PositiveNormalFunctional M ≃
      {φ : normalFunctionalSpace M // Monotone (φ : StrongDual ℂ M)} := by
  letI : PartialOrder M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M
  letI : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ
  refine
    { toFun := fun φ => ⟨φ.toNormalFunctionalSpace, φ.1.monotone'⟩
      invFun := fun φ => ofNormalFunctional M φ.1 φ.2
      left_inv := ?_
      right_inv := ?_ }
  · intro φ
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply PositiveContinuousLinearMap.ext
    intro x
    rfl
  · intro φ
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Subtype.ext
    rfl

end PositiveNormalFunctional

end

end VonNeumannAlgebra

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.MaximalLocalCutoffIdentity
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.FiniteNormalApproximation
public import Mathlib.Topology.Order.MonotoneConvergence
public import Mathlib.Topology.MetricSpace.Pseudo.Lemmas

/-!
# Original positive-LUB preservation constructs actual normal-functional membership

Original ψ preserves bounded increasing positive-family LUBs in its real
values. The internally constructed maximal local family has finite cutoffs
with original identity as LUB. Those values converge to ψ(1), so the actual
positive residual ψ(1-P) tends to zero. The proved residual norm estimate
makes the actual finite normal functionals approximate ψ in its original
dual norm. Closedness of the existing normal span gives actual membership.
No family, LUB, limit, vector, bound or normality model is an input.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open Filter Set CStarAlgebra.ScalarWeight
open scoped Topology BigOperators

namespace VonNeumannAlgebra

noncomputable section

universe u

variable {H : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

/-- Original bounded positive-LUB preservation yields actual membership in the canonical normal span. -/
theorem positiveFunctional_mem_normalFunctionalSpace_of_positiveLUBs (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) :
    letI : PartialOrder M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M
    letI : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ
    ∀ (ψ : PositiveContinuousLinearMap ℂ M ℂ),
      (∀ (I : Type u) [Preorder I] [IsDirectedOrder I] [Nonempty I]
        (a : I → PositiveElement M) (s : PositiveElement M),
        @Monotone I M inferInstance (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toPreorder (fun i => (a i : M)) →
        (∃ C : ℝ, ∀ i, ‖(a i : M)‖ ≤ C) →
        @IsLUB M (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE (Set.range fun i => (a i : M)) (s : M) →
        IsLUB (Set.range fun i => (ψ.toContinuousLinearMap (a i : M)).re)
          (ψ.toContinuousLinearMap (s : M)).re) →
      ψ.toContinuousLinearMap ∈ normalFunctionalSpace M := by
  classical
  let sourceOrder : PartialOrder M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M
  let : PartialOrder M := sourceOrder
  let : Preorder M := sourceOrder.toPreorder
  let : LE M := sourceOrder.toLE
  let : StarOrderedRing M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing M
  let : IsOrderedAddMonoid M := StarOrderedRing.toIsOrderedAddMonoid
  let : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ
  let : StarOrderedRing ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing ℂ
  intro ψ hnormal
  let φ : StrongDual ℂ M := ψ.toContinuousLinearMap
  let S := maximalLocalProjectionFamily M ψ
  let P := maximalLocalPositiveFiniteCutoffs M ψ
  let a := fun t : Finset S.val => P.val t
  have hidentity : @IsLUB M (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE
      (Set.range fun t => (a t : M)) 1 := by
    have h := maximalLocalCutoffSupremum_isLUB M ψ
    rw [maximalLocalCutoffSupremum_eq_one M ψ] at h
    exact h
  let one : PositiveElement M := ⟨1, (IsStarProjection.one M).nonneg⟩
  have hvalueLUB : IsLUB (Set.range fun t => (φ (a t : M)).re) (φ 1).re :=
    hnormal (Finset S.val) a one (maximalLocalPositiveFiniteCutoffs_monotone M ψ)
      ⟨1, maximalLocalPositiveFiniteCutoffs_norm_le_one M ψ⟩ hidentity
  have hmono : Monotone (fun t : Finset S.val => (φ (a t : M)).re) := by
    intro t v htv
    have h := ψ.monotone' ((maximalLocalPositiveFiniteCutoffs_monotone M ψ) htv)
    have hstandard : @LE.le ℂ Complex.partialOrder.toLE (φ (a t : M)) (φ (a v : M)) := by
      have hsource : @LE.le ℂ (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ).toLE
          (φ (a t : M)) (φ (a v : M)) := h
      have hspectral : @LE.le ℂ (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ).toLE
          (φ (a t : M)) (φ (a v : M)) ↔
          ∃ d, d ∈ AddSubmonoid.closure (Set.range fun z : ℂ => star z * z) ∧
            φ (a v : M) = φ (a t : M) + d := StarOrderedRing.le_iff _ _
      have hstock : @LE.le ℂ Complex.partialOrder.toLE (φ (a t : M)) (φ (a v : M)) ↔
          ∃ d, d ∈ AddSubmonoid.closure (Set.range fun z : ℂ => star z * z) ∧
            φ (a v : M) = φ (a t : M) + d := by
        let : PartialOrder ℂ := Complex.partialOrder
        let : LE ℂ := Complex.partialOrder.toLE
        let : StarOrderedRing ℂ := RCLike.toStarOrderedRing
        exact StarOrderedRing.le_iff _ _
      exact hstock.mpr (hspectral.mp hsource)
    exact hstandard.1
  have hvalueLimit := tendsto_atTop_isLUB hmono hvalueLUB
  have hrealResidual : Tendsto (fun t : Finset S.val => (φ (1 - (a t : M))).re) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    have h := (tendsto_const_nhds : Tendsto (fun _t : Finset S.val => (φ 1).re) atTop _).sub hvalueLimit
    simpa only [sub_self, φ.map_sub, Complex.sub_re] using h
  have hreal (t : Finset S.val) : φ (1 - (a t : M)) = ((φ (1 - (a t : M))).re : ℂ) := by
    have hpositive : 0 ≤ φ (1 - (a t : M)) :=
      ψ.map_nonneg (maximalLocalPositiveFiniteCutoffs_isStarProjection M ψ t).one_sub_nonneg
    have him : (φ (1 - (a t : M))).im = 0 :=
      (RCLike.im_eq_zero_iff_isSelfAdjoint).mpr (IsSelfAdjoint.of_nonneg hpositive)
    apply Complex.ext
    · exact (Complex.ofReal_re _).symm
    · exact him.trans (Complex.ofReal_im _).symm
  have hnormResidual : Tendsto (fun t : Finset S.val => ‖φ (1 - (a t : M))‖) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    have hnorm (t : Finset S.val) : ‖φ (1 - (a t : M))‖ = ‖(φ (1 - (a t : M))).re‖ := by
      rw [hreal t]
      exact Complex.norm_real _
    have hfunction : (fun t : Finset S.val => ‖φ (1 - (a t : M))‖) =
        (fun t : Finset S.val => ‖(φ (1 - (a t : M))).re‖) := funext hnorm
    rw [hfunction]
    have h := hrealResidual.norm
    rw [norm_zero] at h
    exact h
  have herrorLimit : Tendsto (fun t : Finset S.val =>
      Real.sqrt (‖φ‖ * ‖φ (1 - (a t : M))‖)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    have h := (Real.continuous_sqrt.continuousAt.tendsto).comp
      ((tendsto_const_nhds : Tendsto (fun _t : Finset S.val => ‖φ‖) atTop _).mul hnormResidual)
    simpa only [mul_zero, Real.sqrt_zero, Function.comp_def] using h
  let p : S.val → M := fun i => i.val
  have hp (i : S.val) : IsStarProjection (p i) := (S.property.1 i.val i.property).1
  let ξ (i : S.val) : H := Classical.choose (S.property.1 i.val i.property).2.2
  have hlocal (i : S.val) : ∀ b : PositiveElement M,
      @LE.le M (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE (b : M) (p i) →
      (φ (b : M)).re ≤ (vectorFunctional M (ξ i) (ξ i) (b : M)).re :=
    Classical.choose_spec (S.property.1 i.val i.property).2.2
  have horthogonal (i j : S.val) (hij : i ≠ j) : p i * p j = 0 :=
    S.property.2.1 i.property j.property (fun h => hij (Subtype.ext h))
  let ρ (t : Finset S.val) := finiteOrthogonalNormalApproximation M ψ p hp horthogonal ξ hlocal t
  have hbound (t : Finset S.val) : ‖φ - (ρ t).val.val‖ ≤
      Real.sqrt (‖φ‖ * ‖φ (1 - (a t : M))‖) := by
    have h := (ρ t).property.2
    rw [(maximalLocalPositiveFiniteCutoffs_value M ψ) t]
    exact h
  have hclosure : φ ∈ closure (normalFunctionalSpace M : Set (StrongDual ℂ M)) := by
    apply Metric.mem_closure_iff.mpr
    intro ε hε
    have heventually := herrorLimit.eventually_lt_const hε
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := heventually.exists
    refine ⟨(ρ t).val.val, (ρ t).val.property, ?_⟩
    rw [dist_eq_norm]
    exact (hbound t).trans_lt ht
  rw [(normalFunctionalSpace_isClosed M).closure_eq] at hclosure
  exact hclosure

end

end VonNeumannAlgebra

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.Basic
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.RangeProjection
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.ClosedRangeProjection
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Weight
public import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Projection.Submodule
public import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Adjoint

/-!
# The actual support projection of an original positive operator

The stock orthogonal projection onto the closure of the original positive
operator's range belongs to the same concrete von Neumann algebra. Every
original commutant operator and its adjoint preserve that closed range and
its orthogonal complement, hence commute with its original projection.
Double-commutant membership supplies the actual algebra element.

This is the support DATA needed for positive cutoff/local domination in
an actual order-normal/predual construction. No source projection, normal
functional, predual certificate or desired representation model is input.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open CStarAlgebra.ScalarWeight
open scoped InnerProductSpace

namespace VonNeumannAlgebra

noncomputable section

universe u

variable {H : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

/-- The original positive operator's generic closed-range projection is an actual algebra element. -/
def positiveRangeProjection (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (a : PositiveElement M) : M :=
  ⟨ContinuousLinearMap.closedRangeProjection ((a : M) : H →L[ℂ] H),
    closedRangeProjection_mem M ((a : M) : H →L[ℂ] H) (a : M).property⟩

/-- The constructed algebra element is exactly the stock projection onto the original closed range. -/
theorem positiveRangeProjection_coe (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (a : PositiveElement M) :
    (positiveRangeProjection M a : H →L[ℂ] H) =
      (LinearMap.range ((a : M) : H →L[ℂ] H).toLinearMap).topologicalClosure.starProjection :=
  rfl

/-- The same original closed-range projection is a genuine star projection. -/
theorem positiveRangeProjection_isStarProjection (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (a : PositiveElement M) :
    IsStarProjection (positiveRangeProjection M a : H →L[ℂ] H) := by
  rw [positiveRangeProjection_coe]
  exact isStarProjection_starProjection

/-- Its actual operator range is precisely the original operator's closed range. -/
theorem positiveRangeProjection_range (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (a : PositiveElement M) :
    (positiveRangeProjection M a : H →L[ℂ] H).range =
      (LinearMap.range ((a : M) : H →L[ℂ] H).toLinearMap).topologicalClosure := by
  rw [positiveRangeProjection_coe]
  exact Submodule.range_starProjection _

/-- The actual original support projection fixes the original positive operator. -/
theorem positiveRangeProjection_mul_self (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (a : PositiveElement M) :
    positiveRangeProjection M a * (a : M) = (a : M) := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change ContinuousLinearMap.closedRangeProjection ((a : M) : H →L[ℂ] H) *
    ((a : M) : H →L[ℂ] H) = ((a : M) : H →L[ℂ] H)
  exact ContinuousLinearMap.closedRangeProjection_mul_self _

/-- An original operator annihilating a positive operator annihilates its actual support. -/
theorem mul_positiveRangeProjection_eq_zero (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (a : PositiveElement M)
    (b : M) (hba : b * (a : M) = 0) : b * positiveRangeProjection M a = 0 := by
  have hBT : (b : H →L[ℂ] H).comp ((a : M) : H →L[ℂ] H) = 0 := by
    change (b : H →L[ℂ] H) * ((a : M) : H →L[ℂ] H) = 0
    exact congrArg (fun x : M => (x : H →L[ℂ] H)) hba
  apply Subtype.ext
  change (b : H →L[ℂ] H).comp
    (ContinuousLinearMap.closedRangeProjection ((a : M) : H →L[ℂ] H)) = 0
  exact ContinuousLinearMap.comp_closedRangeProjection_eq_zero _ _ hBT

end

end VonNeumannAlgebra

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.UltraweakOrder
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Weight
public import Mathlib.Topology.Compactness.Compact
public import Mathlib.Topology.ClusterPt

/-!
# Actual bounded positive suprema in the original concrete algebra

The actual compact positive part of an original norm bound contains the
original nonempty directed positive family. An actual cluster point is
positive and bounded; closed comparisons prove it is the original least
upper bound. The supremum carrier uses that proved witness and its exact
original value, without selecting an open source completeness theorem.

These DATA supply bounded comparison-chain suprema needed for the positive
order-normal/predual criterion and the actual GNS normal homomorphism.
No supplied supremum, predual/normality certificate or representation model
is an input. Original zero Hilbert/algebra and coefficient universes remain.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open Filter Set CStarAlgebra.ScalarWeight
open scoped Topology

namespace VonNeumannAlgebra

noncomputable section

universe u

variable {H : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

/-- An actual nonempty directed norm-bounded positive family has its original bounded supremum witness. -/
def boundedPositiveSupremum (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (S : Set (PositiveElement M))
    (hne : S.Nonempty)
    (hdir : DirectedOn (fun p q : PositiveElement M =>
      @LE.le M (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE (p : M) (q : M)) S)
    (C : ℝ) (hbound : ∀ p ∈ S, ‖(p : M)‖ ≤ C) :
    {s : PositiveElement M //
      @IsLUB M (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE
        ((fun p : PositiveElement M => (p : M)) '' S) (s : M) ∧ ‖(s : M)‖ ≤ C} := by
  classical
  letI : PartialOrder (Ultraweak M) := ultraweakPartialOrder M
  let : OrderClosedTopology (Ultraweak M) := ultraweakOrderClosedTopology M
  let J := {p : PositiveElement M // p ∈ S}
  let preJ : Preorder J := @Preorder.lift J M (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toPreorder
    (fun j => (j.val : M))
  letI : Preorder J := preJ
  letI : LE J := preJ.toLE
  letI : Nonempty J := by
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hne
    exact ⟨⟨p, hp⟩⟩
  let : IsDirectedOrder J :=
    ⟨fun i j => by
      obtain ⟨p, hp, hip, hjp⟩ := hdir i.val i.property j.val j.property
      exact ⟨⟨p, hp⟩, hip, hjp⟩⟩
  let f : J → Ultraweak M := fun j => (ultraweakLinearEquiv M).symm (j.val : M)
  have hmono : Monotone f := by
    intro i j hij
    change @LE.le M (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE (i.val : M) (j.val : M) at hij
    apply (ultraweak_le_iff M (f i) (f j)).mpr
    simpa only [f, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] using hij
  let K : Set (Ultraweak M) := Ici (0 : Ultraweak M) ∩
    {x | ‖ultraweakLinearEquiv M x‖ ≤ C}
  have hcompact : IsCompact K := (ultraweakClosedBall_isCompact M C).inter_left isClosed_Ici
  have hmem : ∀ᶠ j in atTop, f j ∈ K := Eventually.of_forall fun j => by
    constructor
    · apply (ultraweak_le_iff M 0 (f j)).mpr
      simpa only [f, map_zero, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] using j.val.property
    · simpa only [f, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] using hbound j.val j.property
  have hexists : ∃ s : PositiveElement M,
      @IsLUB M (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE
        ((fun p : PositiveElement M => (p : M)) '' S) (s : M) ∧ ‖(s : M)‖ ≤ C := by
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hycluster⟩ := hcompact.exists_mapClusterPt (f := atTop) (u := f)
      (tendsto_principal.mpr hmem)
    have hcluster : ClusterPt y (Filter.map f atTop) := hycluster
    have hpositive : @LE.le M (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE 0
        (ultraweakLinearEquiv M y) := by
      simpa only [map_zero] using (ultraweak_le_iff M 0 y).mp hy.1
    let s : PositiveElement M := ⟨ultraweakLinearEquiv M y, hpositive⟩
    refine ⟨s, ?_, hy.2⟩
    constructor
    · rintro _ ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
      let j : J := ⟨p, hp⟩
      have hlower : Ici (f j) ∈ Filter.map f atTop :=
        Filter.mem_map.mpr ((eventually_ge_atTop j).mono fun k hjk => hmono hjk)
      have hj : f j ≤ y := isClosed_Ici.mem_of_nhdsWithin_neBot
        (hcluster.mono (le_principal_iff.mpr hlower))
      simpa only [f, j, s, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] using (ultraweak_le_iff M (f j) y).mp hj
    · intro q hq
      have hupper : Iic ((ultraweakLinearEquiv M).symm q) ∈ Filter.map f atTop :=
        Filter.mem_map.mpr (Eventually.of_forall fun j => by
          apply (ultraweak_le_iff M (f j) ((ultraweakLinearEquiv M).symm q)).mpr
          simpa only [f, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] using hq ⟨j.val, j.property, rfl⟩)
      have hyq : y ≤ (ultraweakLinearEquiv M).symm q := isClosed_Iic.mem_of_nhdsWithin_neBot
        (hcluster.mono (le_principal_iff.mpr hupper))
      simpa only [s, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] using
        (ultraweak_le_iff M y ((ultraweakLinearEquiv M).symm q)).mp hyq
  exact ⟨Classical.choose hexists, Classical.choose_spec hexists⟩

/-- The actual selected bounded positive witness is the original least upper bound. -/
theorem boundedPositiveSupremum_isLUB (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (S : Set (PositiveElement M))
    (hne : S.Nonempty)
    (hdir : DirectedOn (fun p q : PositiveElement M =>
      @LE.le M (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE (p : M) (q : M)) S)
    (C : ℝ) (hbound : ∀ p ∈ S, ‖(p : M)‖ ≤ C) :
    @IsLUB M (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE
      ((fun p : PositiveElement M => (p : M)) '' S)
      (boundedPositiveSupremum M S hne hdir C hbound).val :=
  (boundedPositiveSupremum M S hne hdir C hbound).property.1

/-- The same original supremum retains the actual given norm bound. -/
theorem boundedPositiveSupremum_norm_le (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (S : Set (PositiveElement M))
    (hne : S.Nonempty)
    (hdir : DirectedOn (fun p q : PositiveElement M =>
      @LE.le M (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE (p : M) (q : M)) S)
    (C : ℝ) (hbound : ∀ p ∈ S, ‖(p : M)‖ ≤ C) :
    ‖((boundedPositiveSupremum M S hne hdir C hbound).val : M)‖ ≤ C :=
  (boundedPositiveSupremum M S hne hdir C hbound).property.2

end

end VonNeumannAlgebra
