module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalFunctional
public import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Operator.Bilinear
public import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Group.Submodule
public import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Module.Basic

/-!
# The actual normal functional space is a concrete predual

Evaluation identifies the original concrete von Neumann algebra with the
continuous dual of its norm-closed vector-functional span. For a functional
on that span, Fréchet–Riesz constructs the bounded operator having its actual
vector coefficients. Commutation with the original commutant places this
operator in the original algebra. Continuity extends coefficient agreement
to the complete closed span.

The pairing and norm are the original functional evaluation and operator
norm. The stock involution supplies the conjugate-linear convention of the
existing abstract `WStarAlgebra` predicate.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open scoped InnerProductSpace CStarAlgebra

namespace VonNeumannAlgebra

open MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra

universe u

variable {H : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

/-- The normal-functional carrier has the original restricted normed additive-group structure. -/
noncomputable instance normalFunctionalSpaceNormedAddCommGroup (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) :
    NormedAddCommGroup (normalFunctionalSpace M) :=
  Submodule.normedAddCommGroup (𝕜 := ℂ) (E := StrongDual ℂ M) (normalFunctionalSpace M)

/-- The normal-functional carrier has the original restricted complex normed-space structure. -/
noncomputable instance normalFunctionalSpaceNormedSpace (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) :
    NormedSpace ℂ (normalFunctionalSpace M) :=
  Submodule.normedSpace (𝕜 := ℂ) (R := ℂ) (E := StrongDual ℂ M) (normalFunctionalSpace M)

/-- An actual vector coefficient viewed in the canonical closed normal-functional space. -/
noncomputable def normalVectorFunctional (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (ξ η : H) :
    normalFunctionalSpace M :=
  ⟨vectorFunctional M ξ η, vectorFunctional_mem_normalFunctionalSpace M ξ η⟩

/-- Evaluation restricted to the actual closed normal-functional space. -/
noncomputable def normalFunctionalEvaluation (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) :
    M →L[ℂ] StrongDual ℂ (normalFunctionalSpace M) :=
  let ev : M → StrongDual ℂ (normalFunctionalSpace M) := fun x =>
    let l : normalFunctionalSpace M →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ :=
      { toFun := fun φ => (φ : StrongDual ℂ M) x
        map_add' := by
          intro φ ψ
          change ((φ : StrongDual ℂ M) + (ψ : StrongDual ℂ M)) x =
            (φ : StrongDual ℂ M) x + (ψ : StrongDual ℂ M) x
          rw [add_apply]
        map_smul' := by
          intro c φ
          change (c • (φ : StrongDual ℂ M)) x =
            (RingHom.id ℂ) c • (φ : StrongDual ℂ M) x
          simp only [smul_apply, RingHom.id_apply] }
    l.mkContinuous ‖x‖ (by
      intro φ
      change ‖(φ : StrongDual ℂ M) x‖ ≤ ‖x‖ * ‖φ‖
      calc
        ‖(φ : StrongDual ℂ M) x‖ ≤ ‖φ‖ * ‖x‖ := (φ : StrongDual ℂ M).le_opNorm x
        _ = ‖x‖ * ‖φ‖ := mul_comm _ _)
  let f : M →ₗ[ℂ] StrongDual ℂ (normalFunctionalSpace M) :=
    { toFun := ev
      map_add' := by
        intro x y
        apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
        intro φ
        change (φ : StrongDual ℂ M) (x + y) =
          (φ : StrongDual ℂ M) x + (φ : StrongDual ℂ M) y
        exact map_add (φ : StrongDual ℂ M) x y
      map_smul' := by
        intro c x
        apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
        intro φ
        change (φ : StrongDual ℂ M) (c • x) =
          (RingHom.id ℂ) c • (φ : StrongDual ℂ M) x
        simp only [map_smul, RingHom.id_apply] }
  f.mkContinuous 1 (by
    intro x
    change ‖ev x‖ ≤ 1 * ‖x‖
    rw [one_mul]
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (norm_nonneg x)
    intro φ
    change ‖(φ : StrongDual ℂ M) x‖ ≤ ‖x‖ * ‖φ‖
    calc
      ‖(φ : StrongDual ℂ M) x‖ ≤ ‖φ‖ * ‖x‖ := (φ : StrongDual ℂ M).le_opNorm x
      _ = ‖x‖ * ‖φ‖ := mul_comm _ _)

/-- The restricted evaluation pairing is ordinary evaluation in the original dual. -/
@[simp]
theorem normalFunctionalEvaluation_apply (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (x : M)
    (φ : normalFunctionalSpace M) :
    normalFunctionalEvaluation M x φ = (φ : StrongDual ℂ M) x :=
  rfl

/-- Vector coefficients determine every original operator in the concrete algebra. -/
theorem normalFunctionalEvaluation_injective (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) :
    Function.Injective (normalFunctionalEvaluation M) := by
  intro x y h
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro η
  apply ext_inner_left ℂ
  intro ξ
  have hc := congrArg
    (fun F : StrongDual ℂ (normalFunctionalSpace M) => F (normalVectorFunctional M ξ η)) h
  change vectorFunctional M ξ η x = vectorFunctional M ξ η y at hc
  simpa only [vectorFunctional_apply] using hc

/-- The normal vector coefficient has its inherited continuous-dual norm bound. -/
private theorem normalVectorFunctional_norm_le (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (ξ η : H) :
    ‖normalVectorFunctional M ξ η‖ ≤ ‖ξ‖ * ‖η‖ :=
  norm_vectorFunctional_le M ξ η

/-- Normal vector coefficients are additive in the first Hilbert argument. -/
private theorem normalVectorFunctional_add_left (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (ξ ζ η : H) :
    normalVectorFunctional M (ξ + ζ) η =
      normalVectorFunctional M ξ η + normalVectorFunctional M ζ η := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change vectorFunctional M (ξ + ζ) η = vectorFunctional M ξ η + vectorFunctional M ζ η
  simpa only [vectorFunctional] using
    representationCoefficient_add_right (A := M) M.toStarSubalgebra.subtype η ξ ζ

/-- Normal vector coefficients are conjugate-linear in the first Hilbert argument. -/
private theorem normalVectorFunctional_smul_left (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H)
    (c : ℂ) (ξ η : H) :
    normalVectorFunctional M (c • ξ) η = star c • normalVectorFunctional M ξ η := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change vectorFunctional M (c • ξ) η = star c • vectorFunctional M ξ η
  simpa only [vectorFunctional] using
    representationCoefficient_smul_right (A := M) M.toStarSubalgebra.subtype c η ξ

/-- Normal vector coefficients are additive in the second Hilbert argument. -/
private theorem normalVectorFunctional_add_right (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (ξ η ζ : H) :
    normalVectorFunctional M ξ (η + ζ) =
      normalVectorFunctional M ξ η + normalVectorFunctional M ξ ζ := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change vectorFunctional M ξ (η + ζ) = vectorFunctional M ξ η + vectorFunctional M ξ ζ
  simpa only [vectorFunctional] using
    representationCoefficient_add_left (A := M) M.toStarSubalgebra.subtype η ζ ξ

/-- Normal vector coefficients are linear in the second Hilbert argument. -/
private theorem normalVectorFunctional_smul_right (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H)
    (c : ℂ) (ξ η : H) :
    normalVectorFunctional M ξ (c • η) = c • normalVectorFunctional M ξ η := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change vectorFunctional M ξ (c • η) = c • vectorFunctional M ξ η
  simpa only [vectorFunctional] using
    representationCoefficient_smul_left (A := M) M.toStarSubalgebra.subtype c η ξ

/-- Riesz receives the actual conjugated coefficient functional at a fixed second vector. -/
private noncomputable def predualRieszForm (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H)
    (F : StrongDual ℂ (normalFunctionalSpace M)) (η : H) : StrongDual ℂ H :=
  let f : H →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ :=
    { toFun := fun ξ => star (F (normalVectorFunctional M ξ η))
      map_add' := by
        intro ξ ζ
        simp only [normalVectorFunctional_add_left, map_add, star_add]
      map_smul' := by
        intro c ξ
        simp only [normalVectorFunctional_smul_left, map_smul, star_smul, star_star, RingHom.id_apply] }
  f.mkContinuous (‖F‖ * ‖η‖) (by
    intro ξ
    calc
      ‖star (F (normalVectorFunctional M ξ η))‖ = ‖F (normalVectorFunctional M ξ η)‖ := norm_star _
      _ ≤ ‖F‖ * ‖normalVectorFunctional M ξ η‖ := F.le_opNorm _
      _ ≤ ‖F‖ * (‖ξ‖ * ‖η‖) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (normalVectorFunctional_norm_le M ξ η) (norm_nonneg F)
      _ = (‖F‖ * ‖η‖) * ‖ξ‖ := by ring)

/-- The fixed-vector Riesz functional retains the actual product norm bound. -/
private theorem predualRieszForm_norm_le (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H)
    (F : StrongDual ℂ (normalFunctionalSpace M)) (η : H) :
    ‖predualRieszForm M F η‖ ≤ ‖F‖ * ‖η‖ := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg F) (norm_nonneg η))
  intro ξ
  change ‖star (F (normalVectorFunctional M ξ η))‖ ≤ (‖F‖ * ‖η‖) * ‖ξ‖
  calc
    ‖star (F (normalVectorFunctional M ξ η))‖ = ‖F (normalVectorFunctional M ξ η)‖ := norm_star _
    _ ≤ ‖F‖ * ‖normalVectorFunctional M ξ η‖ := F.le_opNorm _
    _ ≤ ‖F‖ * (‖ξ‖ * ‖η‖) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (normalVectorFunctional_norm_le M ξ η) (norm_nonneg F)
    _ = (‖F‖ * ‖η‖) * ‖ξ‖ := by ring

/-- The actual bounded sesquilinear family supplied to the stock Riesz construction. -/
private noncomputable def predualRieszFormMap (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H)
    (F : StrongDual ℂ (normalFunctionalSpace M)) : H →L⋆[ℂ] StrongDual ℂ H :=
  let f : H →ₗ⋆[ℂ] StrongDual ℂ H :=
    { toFun := predualRieszForm M F
      map_add' := by
        intro η ζ
        apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
        intro ξ
        change star (F (normalVectorFunctional M ξ (η + ζ))) =
          star (F (normalVectorFunctional M ξ η)) + star (F (normalVectorFunctional M ξ ζ))
        simp only [normalVectorFunctional_add_right, map_add, star_add]
      map_smul' := by
        intro c η
        apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
        intro ξ
        change star (F (normalVectorFunctional M ξ (c • η))) =
          star c • star (F (normalVectorFunctional M ξ η))
        simp only [normalVectorFunctional_smul_right, map_smul, star_smul] }
  f.mkContinuous ‖F‖ (predualRieszForm_norm_le M F)

/-- The stock Riesz representation reconstructs the actual bounded Hilbert operator. -/
private noncomputable def reconstructedOperator (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H)
    (F : StrongDual ℂ (normalFunctionalSpace M)) : H →L[ℂ] H :=
  InnerProductSpace.continuousLinearMapOfBilin (predualRieszFormMap M F)

/-- The reconstructed operator has exactly the supplied normal vector coefficients. -/
private theorem reconstructedOperator_inner (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H)
    (F : StrongDual ℂ (normalFunctionalSpace M)) (ξ η : H) :
    ⟪ξ, reconstructedOperator M F η⟫_ℂ = F (normalVectorFunctional M ξ η) := by
  have h := InnerProductSpace.continuousLinearMapOfBilin_apply (predualRieszFormMap M F) η ξ
  have hs := congrArg (star : ℂ → ℂ) h
  change star ⟪reconstructedOperator M F η, ξ⟫_ℂ =
    star (star (F (normalVectorFunctional M ξ η))) at hs
  have hscalar : star ⟪reconstructedOperator M F η, ξ⟫_ℂ =
      ⟪ξ, reconstructedOperator M F η⟫_ℂ := by
    simpa only [starRingEnd_apply] using
      (inner_conj_symm (𝕜 := ℂ) ξ (reconstructedOperator M F η))
  exact hscalar.symm.trans (by simpa only [star_star] using hs)

/-- The actual reconstructed operator is bounded by the original functional norm. -/
private theorem norm_reconstructedOperator_le (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H)
    (F : StrongDual ℂ (normalFunctionalSpace M)) : ‖reconstructedOperator M F‖ ≤ ‖F‖ := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (norm_nonneg F)
  intro η
  calc
    ‖reconstructedOperator M F η‖ = ‖predualRieszFormMap M F η‖ :=
      (InnerProductSpace.toDual ℂ H).symm.norm_map _
    _ ≤ ‖F‖ * ‖η‖ := predualRieszForm_norm_le M F η

/-- The original commutant transports both vector arguments of every coefficient. -/
private theorem normalVectorFunctional_commutant (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H)
    (S : H →L[ℂ] H) (hS : S ∈ Set.centralizer (M : Set (H →L[ℂ] H))) (ξ η : H) :
    normalVectorFunctional M ((star S) ξ) η = normalVectorFunctional M ξ (S η) := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro x
  change vectorFunctional M ((star S) ξ) η x = vectorFunctional M ξ (S η) x
  rw [vectorFunctional_apply, vectorFunctional_apply]
  rw [ContinuousLinearMap.star_eq_adjoint, ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_left]
  have hcomm := hS (x : H →L[ℂ] H) x.property
  change ⟪ξ, (S * (x : H →L[ℂ] H)) η⟫_ℂ = ⟪ξ, ((x : H →L[ℂ] H) * S) η⟫_ℂ
  rw [hcomm]

/-- Commutation with the original commutant places the reconstruction in the original algebra. -/
private theorem reconstructedOperator_mem (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H)
    (F : StrongDual ℂ (normalFunctionalSpace M)) : reconstructedOperator M F ∈ M := by
  change reconstructedOperator M F ∈ (M : Set (H →L[ℂ] H))
  rw [← M.centralizer_centralizer]
  intro S hS
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro η
  apply ext_inner_left ℂ
  intro ξ
  change ⟪ξ, S (reconstructedOperator M F η)⟫_ℂ =
    ⟪ξ, reconstructedOperator M F (S η)⟫_ℂ
  calc
    ⟪ξ, S (reconstructedOperator M F η)⟫_ℂ =
        ⟪(star S) ξ, reconstructedOperator M F η⟫_ℂ := by
      simpa only [ContinuousLinearMap.star_eq_adjoint] using
        (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_left S (reconstructedOperator M F η) ξ).symm
    _ = F (normalVectorFunctional M ((star S) ξ) η) := reconstructedOperator_inner M F _ _
    _ = F (normalVectorFunctional M ξ (S η)) :=
      congrArg F (normalVectorFunctional_commutant M S hS ξ η)
    _ = ⟪ξ, reconstructedOperator M F (S η)⟫_ℂ := (reconstructedOperator_inner M F _ _).symm

/-- Continuous functionals on the actual closed span are determined by its vector coefficients. -/
private theorem normalFunctionalDual_ext (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H)
    (f g : StrongDual ℂ (normalFunctionalSpace M))
    (hvec : ∀ ξ η : H, f (normalVectorFunctional M ξ η) = g (normalVectorFunctional M ξ η)) :
    f = g := by
  let K : Submodule ℂ (normalFunctionalSpace M) := (f - g).ker
  let Q : Submodule ℂ (StrongDual ℂ M) := K.map (normalFunctionalSpace M).subtype
  have hQ : IsClosed (Q : Set (StrongDual ℂ M)) := by
    change IsClosed (((↑) : normalFunctionalSpace M → StrongDual ℂ M) ''
      (K : Set (normalFunctionalSpace M)))
    exact (normalFunctionalSpace_isClosed M).isClosedMap_subtype_val _ (f - g).isClosed_ker
  have hPQ : normalFunctionalSpace M ≤ Q := normalFunctionalSpace_le M hQ (by
    intro ξ η
    change ∃ z : normalFunctionalSpace M,
      z ∈ K ∧ (normalFunctionalSpace M).subtype z = vectorFunctional M ξ η
    refine ⟨normalVectorFunctional M ξ η, ?_, rfl⟩
    change (f - g) (normalVectorFunctional M ξ η) = 0
    rw [sub_apply]
    exact sub_eq_zero.mpr (hvec ξ η))
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro φ
  have hm := hPQ φ.property
  change ∃ z : normalFunctionalSpace M,
    z ∈ K ∧ (normalFunctionalSpace M).subtype z = (φ : StrongDual ℂ M) at hm
  rcases hm with ⟨z, hz, hval⟩
  have heq : z = φ := Subtype.ext hval
  change (f - g) z = 0 at hz
  rw [sub_apply, heq] at hz
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp hz

/-- Every actual functional on the closed normal span is evaluation at an original norm-bounded operator. -/
theorem normalFunctionalEvaluation_surjective_norm (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H)
    (F : StrongDual ℂ (normalFunctionalSpace M)) :
    ∃ x : M, normalFunctionalEvaluation M x = F ∧ ‖x‖ ≤ ‖F‖ := by
  let x : M := ⟨reconstructedOperator M F, reconstructedOperator_mem M F⟩
  refine ⟨x, ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply normalFunctionalDual_ext M
    intro ξ η
    change vectorFunctional M ξ η x = F (normalVectorFunctional M ξ η)
    rw [vectorFunctional_apply]
    exact reconstructedOperator_inner M F ξ η
  · exact norm_reconstructedOperator_le M F

/-- The original evaluation map is onto the actual normal-functional continuous dual. -/
theorem normalFunctionalEvaluation_surjective (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) :
    Function.Surjective (normalFunctionalEvaluation M) := by
  intro F
  obtain ⟨x, hx, _⟩ := normalFunctionalEvaluation_surjective_norm M F
  exact ⟨x, hx⟩

/-- Evaluation has the original operator-norm upper bound. -/
private theorem normalFunctionalEvaluation_norm_le (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (x : M) :
    ‖normalFunctionalEvaluation M x‖ ≤ ‖x‖ := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (norm_nonneg x)
  intro φ
  change ‖(φ : StrongDual ℂ M) x‖ ≤ ‖x‖ * ‖φ‖
  calc
    ‖(φ : StrongDual ℂ M) x‖ ≤ ‖φ‖ * ‖x‖ := (φ : StrongDual ℂ M).le_opNorm x
    _ = ‖x‖ * ‖φ‖ := mul_comm _ _

/-- Actual evaluation preserves the original operator norm, including the zero Hilbert space. -/
theorem normalFunctionalEvaluation_norm (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (x : M) :
    ‖normalFunctionalEvaluation M x‖ = ‖x‖ := by
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hnorm⟩ :=
    normalFunctionalEvaluation_surjective_norm M (normalFunctionalEvaluation M x)
  have hyx : y = x := normalFunctionalEvaluation_injective M hy
  apply le_antisymm (normalFunctionalEvaluation_norm_le M x)
  simpa only [hyx] using hnorm

/-- The canonical linear isometric equivalence uses the actual evaluation map and its proved surjectivity. -/
noncomputable def normalFunctionalEvaluationEquiv (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) :
    M ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] StrongDual ℂ (normalFunctionalSpace M) :=
  LinearIsometryEquiv.ofSurjective
    { toLinearMap := (normalFunctionalEvaluation M).toLinearMap
      norm_map' := normalFunctionalEvaluation_norm M }
    (normalFunctionalEvaluation_surjective M)

/-- The canonical isometric equivalence retains ordinary evaluation of the original functionals. -/
@[simp]
theorem normalFunctionalEvaluationEquiv_apply (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (x : M)
    (φ : normalFunctionalSpace M) :
    normalFunctionalEvaluationEquiv M x φ = (φ : StrongDual ℂ M) x :=
  rfl

/-- The original concrete algebra is the actual continuous dual of its normal functional space. -/
theorem normalFunctionalEvaluation_isometricEquivalence (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) :
    ∃ e : M ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] StrongDual ℂ (normalFunctionalSpace M),
      ∀ x : M, ∀ φ : normalFunctionalSpace M, e x φ = (φ : StrongDual ℂ M) x :=
  ⟨normalFunctionalEvaluationEquiv M, fun _ _ => rfl⟩

/-- The original involution supplies the conjugate-linear convention of the stock predual predicate. -/
noncomputable def normalFunctionalPredualConjugateEquiv (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) :
    StrongDual ℂ (normalFunctionalSpace M) ≃ₗᵢ⋆[ℂ] M where
  toLinearEquiv := (normalFunctionalEvaluationEquiv M).symm.toLinearEquiv.trans
    (starLinearEquiv ℂ : M ≃ₗ⋆[ℂ] M)
  norm_map' := by
    intro F
    change ‖star ((normalFunctionalEvaluationEquiv M).symm F)‖ = ‖F‖
    rw [norm_star]
    exact (normalFunctionalEvaluationEquiv M).symm.norm_map F

/-- The explicit original normal-functional Banach space witnesses the existing abstract von Neumann predicate. -/
noncomputable instance normalFunctionalInstWStarAlgebra (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) : WStarAlgebra M where
  exists_predual :=
    ⟨normalFunctionalSpace M, inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance,
      ⟨normalFunctionalPredualConjugateEquiv M⟩⟩

end VonNeumannAlgebra

/-
Author: @toskua
-/
module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalFunctional
public import Mathlib.Analysis.Complex.Norm
public import Mathlib.Analysis.Real.Sqrt

/-!
# An actual vector in a nonzero projection's range dominates the original functional value

A nonzero original projection acts nontrivially on some actual vector.
Its projected vector lies in the projection range. Scaling its norm by
sqrt(norm(phi(e))+1) gives a fixed vector whose exact diagonal projection
coefficient strictly exceeds the original bounded functional value.

This supplies the actual vector input for local positive comparison and
localized-functional construction. No basis, chosen normal functional,
normality certificate or source existence output is provided as data.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open scoped InnerProductSpace

namespace VonNeumannAlgebra

noncomputable section

universe u

variable {H : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

/-- An original nonzero star projection has an actual range vector with strictly dominating value. -/
def projectionVectorDominator (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (φ : StrongDual ℂ M)
    (e : M) (he : IsStarProjection e) (hne : e ≠ 0) :
    {ξ : H // (e : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ = ξ ∧ (φ e).re < (vectorFunctional M ξ ξ e).re} := by
  classical
  let T : H →L[ℂ] H := e
  have hT : T * T = T := congrArg (fun p : M => (p : H →L[ℂ] H)) he.isIdempotentElem.eq
  have hTNonzero : T ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    apply hne
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact hzero
  have hexists : ∃ v : H, T v ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra hnot
    apply hTNonzero
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
    intro v
    change T v = 0
    by_contra hv
    exact hnot ⟨v, hv⟩
  let v : H := Classical.choose hexists
  have hv : T v ≠ 0 := Classical.choose_spec hexists
  let w : H := T v
  have hwNonzero : w ≠ 0 := hv
  have hwNorm : 0 < ‖w‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hwNonzero
  have hwFixed : T w = w := by
    have h := congrArg (fun A : H →L[ℂ] H => A v) hT
    simpa only [mul_apply_eq_comp] using h
  let N : ℝ := ‖φ e‖ + 1
  have hN : 0 < N := by
    dsimp only [N]
    linarith [norm_nonneg (φ e)]
  let r : ℝ := Real.sqrt N / ‖w‖
  have hr : 0 ≤ r := div_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg N) hwNorm.le
  let ξ : H := r • w
  have hξFixed : T ξ = ξ := by
    change T (r • w) = r • w
    rw [T.map_smul_of_tower, hwFixed]
  have hξNorm : ‖ξ‖ = Real.sqrt N := by
    change ‖r • w‖ = Real.sqrt N
    rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg hr]
    dsimp only [r]
    rw [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hwNorm.ne', mul_one]
  have hξNormSq : ‖ξ‖ ^ 2 = N := by
    rw [hξNorm]
    exact Real.sq_sqrt hN.le
  have hvalue : (vectorFunctional M ξ ξ e).re = ‖ξ‖ ^ 2 := by
    rw [vectorFunctional_apply]
    change RCLike.re ⟪ξ, T ξ⟫_ℂ = ‖ξ‖ ^ 2
    rw [hξFixed]
    exact inner_self_eq_norm_sq (𝕜 := ℂ) ξ
  have hstrict : (φ e).re < (vectorFunctional M ξ ξ e).re := by
    rw [hvalue, hξNormSq]
    exact (Complex.re_le_norm (φ e)).trans_lt (by dsimp only [N]; linarith)
  exact ⟨ξ, hξFixed, hstrict⟩

end

end VonNeumannAlgebra

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.Basic
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.ClosedRangeProjection
public import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Adjoint

/-!
# The generic closed-range projection of an algebra element belongs to its algebra

The original commutant and its adjoints preserve the actual closed range and
its orthogonal complement. Double-commutant membership then proves the generic
Hilbert-space projection belongs to M. No positive element or weight/predual
model is a premise.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open scoped InnerProductSpace

namespace VonNeumannAlgebra

noncomputable section

universe u

variable {H : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

/-- Every actual algebra element has its generic closed-range projection in the same algebra. -/
theorem closedRangeProjection_mem (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : T ∈ M) :
    ContinuousLinearMap.closedRangeProjection T ∈ M := by
  let R : Submodule ℂ H := T.range.topologicalClosure
  have hRclosed : IsClosed (R : Set H) := Submodule.isClosed_topologicalClosure _
  have hinvariant (B : H →L[ℂ] H) (hBT : B * T = T * B) : ∀ v ∈ R, B v ∈ R := by
    let U : Submodule ℂ H := R.comap B.toLinearMap
    have hUclosed : IsClosed (U : Set H) := by
      change IsClosed (B ⁻¹' (R : Set H))
      exact hRclosed.preimage B.continuous
    have hrange : T.range ≤ U := by
      rintro v ⟨w, rfl⟩
      change B (T w) ∈ R
      have h := congrArg (fun A : H →L[ℂ] H => A w) hBT
      simp only [mul_apply_eq_comp] at h
      rw [h]
      exact Submodule.le_topologicalClosure _ ⟨B w, rfl⟩
    have hle : R ≤ U := Submodule.topologicalClosure_minimal _ hrange hUclosed
    exact fun v hv => hle hv
  change R.starProjection ∈ (M : Set (H →L[ℂ] H))
  rw [← M.centralizer_centralizer]
  change ∀ B ∈ Set.centralizer (M : Set (H →L[ℂ] H)), B * R.starProjection = R.starProjection * B
  intro B hB
  have hTB : T * B = B * T := (Set.mem_centralizer_iff.mp hB) T hT
  have hBT : B * T = T * B := hTB.symm
  have hstarTB : star T * B = B * star T :=
    (Set.mem_centralizer_iff.mp hB) (star T) (M.toStarSubalgebra.star_mem' hT)
  have hstarBT : star B * T = T * star B := by
    have h := congrArg (star : (H →L[ℂ] H) → (H →L[ℂ] H)) hstarTB
    simpa only [star_mul, star_star] using h
  have hBinv := hinvariant B hBT
  have hstarBinv := hinvariant (star B) hstarBT
  have horthogonal : ∀ v ∈ Rᗮ, B v ∈ Rᗮ := by
    intro v hv
    apply (R.mem_orthogonal (B v)).mpr
    intro w hw
    have hadjoint : ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint B w ∈ R := by
      rw [← ContinuousLinearMap.star_eq_adjoint]
      exact hstarBinv w hw
    rw [← ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_left B v w]
    exact (R.mem_orthogonal v).mp hv _ hadjoint
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro v
  simp only [mul_apply_eq_comp]
  have hprojection : R.starProjection (B v) = B (R.starProjection v) := by
    apply Submodule.eq_starProjection_of_mem_orthogonal
    · exact hBinv _ (Submodule.starProjection_apply_mem R v)
    · rw [← map_sub]
      exact horthogonal _ (Submodule.sub_starProjection_mem_orthogonal (K := R) v)
  exact hprojection.symm

end

end VonNeumannAlgebra

Author: @toskua

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.TensorProduct
public import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Module.RCLike.Real

/-!
# Left operators extracted from the original full-right tensor commutant

A rank-one right operator factors through insertion and its actual Hilbert
adjoint. Commutation with these operators computes the left factor. The
original source-algebra generators then put that factor in its commutant.
This is the constructor prerequisite for actual spatial coefficient range.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open UniformSpace
open scoped TensorProduct Topology InnerProductSpace

namespace VonNeumannAlgebra

noncomputable section

universe uH uK

variable {H : Type uH} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
variable {K : Type uK} [NormedAddCommGroup K] [InnerProductSpace ℂ K] [CompleteSpace K]

/-- The full-right spatial commutant consists of actual left operators from the source commutant. -/
theorem exists_mapLCompletion_id_of_mem_commutant_spatialTensorProduct_top
    (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (A : Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] K) →L[ℂ] Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] K))
    (hA : A ∈ (spatialTensorProduct M (⊤ : VonNeumannAlgebra K)).commutant) :
    ∃ B : H →L[ℂ] H, B ∈ M.commutant ∧ A =
      TensorProduct.mapLCompletion B (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ K) := by
  classical
  let T := Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] K)
  let m : PseudoMetricSpace T := (inferInstance : SeminormedAddCommGroup T).toPseudoMetricSpace
  have hUniform : m.toUniformSpace = Completion.uniformSpace (H ⊗[ℂ] K) := by
    apply UniformSpace.ext
    exact (@PseudoMetricSpace.uniformity_dist _ m).trans
      (Completion.uniformity_dist (α := H ⊗[ℂ] K)).symm
  have htop : m.toUniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace =
      (Completion.uniformSpace (H ⊗[ℂ] K)).toTopologicalSpace :=
    congrArg (fun w : UniformSpace T => @UniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace T w) hUniform
  have toStockClosed (s : Set T) (hs : @IsClosed T m.toUniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace s) :
      @IsClosed T (Completion.uniformSpace (H ⊗[ℂ] K)).toTopologicalSpace s := by
    rw [htop] at hs
    exact hs
  rcases subsingleton_or_nontrivial K with hK | hK
  · let _ := hK
    have hz (z : T) : z = 0 := by
      refine Completion.induction_on z
        (toStockClosed _ (isClosed_eq continuous_id continuous_const)) ?_
      intro z
      have he : z = (0 : H ⊗[ℂ] K) := Subsingleton.elim _ _
      rw [he, Completion.coe_zero]
    refine ⟨0, zero_mem M.commutant, ?_⟩
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
    intro z
    exact (hz (A z)).trans (hz (TensorProduct.mapLCompletion 0 (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ K) z)).symm
  · let _ := hK
    let _ : NormedSpace ℝ K := NormedSpace.restrictScalars ℝ ℂ K
    obtain ⟨ξ, hξ⟩ : ∃ ξ : K, ‖ξ‖ = 1 := exists_norm_eq K zero_le_one
    let ι (η : K) : H →L[ℂ] T :=
      (Completion.toComplL : H ⊗[ℂ] K →L[ℂ] T).comp ((TensorProduct.mkL ℂ H K).flip η)
    have hslice (h : H) (η : K) :
        (ι ξ).adjoint ((h ⊗ₜ[ℂ] η : H ⊗[ℂ] K) : T) = inner ℂ ξ η • h := by
      apply ext_inner_left ℂ
      intro h'
      rw [ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_right]
      change inner ℂ ((h' ⊗ₜ[ℂ] ξ : H ⊗[ℂ] K) : T)
          ((h ⊗ₜ[ℂ] η : H ⊗[ℂ] K) : T) = inner ℂ h' (inner ℂ ξ η • h)
      simp only [Completion.inner_coe, TensorProduct.inner_tmul, inner_smul_right]
      exact mul_comm _ _
    have hrank (η : K) :
        TensorProduct.mapLCompletion (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ H) (InnerProductSpace.rankOne ℂ η ξ) =
          (ι η).comp (ι ξ).adjoint := by
      apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
      intro z
      refine Completion.induction_on z (toStockClosed _
        (isClosed_eq
          (TensorProduct.mapLCompletion (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ H)
            (InnerProductSpace.rankOne ℂ η ξ)).continuous
          ((ι η).continuous.comp (ι ξ).adjoint.continuous))) ?_
      intro z
      induction z using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
      | tmul h k =>
        change TensorProduct.mapLCompletion (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ H)
            (InnerProductSpace.rankOne ℂ η ξ) ((h ⊗ₜ[ℂ] k : H ⊗[ℂ] K) : T) =
          ι η ((ι ξ).adjoint ((h ⊗ₜ[ℂ] k : H ⊗[ℂ] K) : T))
        rw [TensorProduct.mapLCompletion_tmul, hslice]
        change ((h ⊗ₜ[ℂ] (InnerProductSpace.rankOne ℂ η ξ k) : H ⊗[ℂ] K) : T) =
          (((inner ℂ ξ k • h) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] η : H ⊗[ℂ] K) : T)
        rw [InnerProductSpace.rankOne_apply]
        apply congrArg (fun z : H ⊗[ℂ] K => (z : T))
        exact (TensorProduct.smul_tmul (inner ℂ ξ k) h η).symm
      | add z w hz hw => simp only [Completion.coe_add, map_add, hz, hw]
    let B : H →L[ℂ] H := (ι ξ).adjoint.comp (A.comp (ι ξ))
    have hright (R : K →L[ℂ] K) :
        A * TensorProduct.mapLCompletion (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ H) R =
          TensorProduct.mapLCompletion (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ H) R * A := by
      have hmem := tensorOperator_mem_spatialTensorProduct M (⊤ : VonNeumannAlgebra K)
        (1 : M) (⟨R, by
          change R ∈ (⊤ : StarSubalgebra ℂ (K →L[ℂ] K))
          trivial⟩ : (⊤ : VonNeumannAlgebra K))
      have he := mem_commutant_iff.mp hA _ hmem
      change TensorProduct.mapLCompletion (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ H) R * A =
        A * TensorProduct.mapLCompletion (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ H) R at he
      exact he.symm
    have hvalue (h : H) (η : K) :
        A ((h ⊗ₜ[ℂ] η : H ⊗[ℂ] K) : T) = ((B h ⊗ₜ[ℂ] η : H ⊗[ℂ] K) : T) := by
      have hunit : inner ℂ ξ ξ = 1 := by simp [inner_self_eq_norm_sq_to_K, hξ]
      have hfirst : TensorProduct.mapLCompletion (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ H)
          (InnerProductSpace.rankOne ℂ η ξ) (ι ξ h) = ι η h := by
        change TensorProduct.mapLCompletion (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ H)
            (InnerProductSpace.rankOne ℂ η ξ) ((h ⊗ₜ[ℂ] ξ : H ⊗[ℂ] K) : T) =
          ((h ⊗ₜ[ℂ] η : H ⊗[ℂ] K) : T)
        rw [TensorProduct.mapLCompletion_tmul]
        simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply, InnerProductSpace.rankOne_apply, hunit, one_smul]
      have he := congrArg (fun C : T →L[ℂ] T => C (ι ξ h))
        (hright (InnerProductSpace.rankOne ℂ η ξ))
      change A (TensorProduct.mapLCompletion (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ H)
          (InnerProductSpace.rankOne ℂ η ξ) (ι ξ h)) =
        TensorProduct.mapLCompletion (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ H)
          (InnerProductSpace.rankOne ℂ η ξ) (A (ι ξ h)) at he
      rw [hfirst, hrank] at he
      change A ((h ⊗ₜ[ℂ] η : H ⊗[ℂ] K) : T) = ((B h ⊗ₜ[ℂ] η : H ⊗[ℂ] K) : T) at he
      exact he
    have hAB : A = TensorProduct.mapLCompletion B (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ K) := by
      apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
      intro z
      refine Completion.induction_on z (toStockClosed _
        (isClosed_eq A.continuous
          (TensorProduct.mapLCompletion B (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ K)).continuous)) ?_
      intro z
      induction z using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
      | tmul h k =>
        simpa only [TensorProduct.mapLCompletion_tmul, ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply] using hvalue h k
      | add z w hz hw => simp only [Completion.coe_add, map_add, hz, hw]
    let I : H →ₗᵢ[ℂ] T :=
      { toLinearMap := (ι ξ).toLinearMap
        norm_map' := fun h => by
          change ‖((h ⊗ₜ[ℂ] ξ : H ⊗[ℂ] K) : T)‖ = ‖h‖
          rw [Completion.norm_coe, TensorProduct.norm_tmul, hξ, mul_one] }
    have hBM : B ∈ M.commutant := by
      rw [mem_commutant_iff]
      intro b hb
      have hmem := tensorOperator_mem_spatialTensorProduct M (⊤ : VonNeumannAlgebra K)
        (⟨b, hb⟩ : M) (1 : (⊤ : VonNeumannAlgebra K))
      have he := mem_commutant_iff.mp hA _ hmem
      change TensorProduct.mapLCompletion b (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ K) * A =
        A * TensorProduct.mapLCompletion b (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ K) at he
      rw [hAB] at he
      apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
      intro h
      change b (B h) = B (b h)
      apply I.injective
      have hpure := congrArg (fun C : T →L[ℂ] T => C ((h ⊗ₜ[ℂ] ξ : H ⊗[ℂ] K) : T)) he
      change TensorProduct.mapLCompletion b (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ K)
          (TensorProduct.mapLCompletion B (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ K)
            ((h ⊗ₜ[ℂ] ξ : H ⊗[ℂ] K) : T)) =
        TensorProduct.mapLCompletion B (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ K)
          (TensorProduct.mapLCompletion b (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ K)
            ((h ⊗ₜ[ℂ] ξ : H ⊗[ℂ] K) : T)) at hpure
      change ((b (B h) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] ξ : H ⊗[ℂ] K) : T) =
        ((B (b h) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] ξ : H ⊗[ℂ] K) : T)
      simpa only [TensorProduct.mapLCompletion_tmul, ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply] using hpure
    exact ⟨B, hBM, hAB⟩

end

end VonNeumannAlgebra

Author: @toskua

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.Generated
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.TensorProduct.CompletionAdjoint

/-!
# Actual spatial tensor products of concrete von Neumann algebras

The carrier is the von Neumann algebra generated by the original bounded
factor operators on the stock completed Hilbert tensor. Their pure values,
norm bounds, products and adjoints are the existing completed operator laws.
The given Hilbert spaces and their original norms are retained.

This is the spatial tensor target in Takesaki Theorem 4.5 and Connes V
Appendix A Theorem 4. The construction applies to arbitrary complete complex
Hilbert spaces and concrete factor algebras.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open UniformSpace
open scoped TensorProduct

namespace VonNeumannAlgebra

universe u v

variable {H : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
variable {K : Type v} [NormedAddCommGroup K] [InnerProductSpace ℂ K] [CompleteSpace K]

/-- The spatial von Neumann tensor generated by the actual completed factor operators. -/
noncomputable def spatialTensorProduct (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (N : VonNeumannAlgebra K) :
    VonNeumannAlgebra (Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] K)) :=
  generatedBy (Set.range fun p : M × N =>
    TensorProduct.mapLCompletion (p.1 : H →L[ℂ] H) (p.2 : K →L[ℂ] K))

/-- Every actual completed factor operator belongs to the spatial tensor algebra. -/
theorem tensorOperator_mem_spatialTensorProduct (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H)
    (N : VonNeumannAlgebra K) (x : M) (y : N) :
    TensorProduct.mapLCompletion (x : H →L[ℂ] H) (y : K →L[ℂ] K) ∈ spatialTensorProduct M N :=
  subset_generatedBy _ (Set.mem_range_self (x, y))

/-- An original factor pair viewed as an element of its actual spatial tensor algebra. -/
noncomputable def spatialTensor (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (N : VonNeumannAlgebra K)
    (x : M) (y : N) : spatialTensorProduct M N :=
  ⟨TensorProduct.mapLCompletion (x : H →L[ℂ] H) (y : K →L[ℂ] K),
    tensorOperator_mem_spatialTensorProduct M N x y⟩

/-- The spatial tensor element is the original completed bounded factor operator. -/
@[simp]
theorem spatialTensor_coe (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (N : VonNeumannAlgebra K)
    (x : M) (y : N) :
    (spatialTensor M N x y : Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] K) →L[ℂ] Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] K)) =
      TensorProduct.mapLCompletion (x : H →L[ℂ] H) (y : K →L[ℂ] K) :=
  rfl

/-- On the original pure Hilbert tensor, a spatial factor pair has its literal factor values. -/
theorem spatialTensor_apply_tmul (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (N : VonNeumannAlgebra K)
    (x : M) (y : N) (ξ : H) (η : K) :
    (spatialTensor M N x y : Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] K) →L[ℂ] Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] K))
        (ξ ⊗ₜ[ℂ] η : Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] K)) =
      ((x : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ ⊗ₜ[ℂ] (y : K →L[ℂ] K) η : Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] K)) :=
  TensorProduct.mapLCompletion_tmul (x : H →L[ℂ] H) (y : K →L[ℂ] K) ξ η

/-- The inherited spatial operator norm retains the original product upper bound. -/
theorem norm_spatialTensor_le (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (N : VonNeumannAlgebra K)
    (x : M) (y : N) : ‖spatialTensor M N x y‖ ≤ ‖x‖ * ‖y‖ :=
  TensorProduct.norm_mapLCompletion_le (x : H →L[ℂ] H) (y : K →L[ℂ] K)

/-- Taking the actual operator adjoint acts separately on the original factor elements. -/
@[simp]
theorem star_spatialTensor (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (N : VonNeumannAlgebra K)
    (x : M) (y : N) :
    star (spatialTensor M N x y) = spatialTensor M N (star x) (star y) := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact TensorProduct.star_mapLCompletion (x : H →L[ℂ] H) (y : K →L[ℂ] K)

/-- Multiplication of spatial factor pairs is multiplication in both original algebras. -/
theorem spatialTensor_mul (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (N : VonNeumannAlgebra K)
    (x₁ x₂ : M) (y₁ y₂ : N) :
    spatialTensor M N (x₁ * x₂) (y₁ * y₂) =
      spatialTensor M N x₁ y₁ * spatialTensor M N x₂ y₂ := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact TensorProduct.mapLCompletion_mul
    (x₁ : H →L[ℂ] H) (x₂ : H →L[ℂ] H) (y₁ : K →L[ℂ] K) (y₂ : K →L[ℂ] K)

/-- Identity factors give the actual identity element of the spatial tensor algebra. -/
@[simp]
theorem spatialTensor_one_one (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (N : VonNeumannAlgebra K) :
    spatialTensor M N (1 : M) (1 : N) = 1 := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact TensorProduct.mapLCompletion_id_id ℂ H K

/-- Containment of the spatial tensor algebra is equivalent to containment of its factor operators. -/
theorem spatialTensorProduct_le_iff (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (N : VonNeumannAlgebra K)
    {P : VonNeumannAlgebra (Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] K))} :
    spatialTensorProduct M N ≤ P ↔
      ∀ x : M, ∀ y : N,
        TensorProduct.mapLCompletion (x : H →L[ℂ] H) (y : K →L[ℂ] K) ∈ P := by
  change generatedBy _ ≤ P ↔ _
  rw [generatedBy_le_iff]
  constructor
  · intro h x y
    exact h (Set.mem_range_self (x, y))
  · intro h _ hp
    rcases hp with ⟨⟨x, y⟩, rfl⟩
    exact h x y

/-- The spatial tensor carrier is closed in the actual weak operator topology. -/
theorem spatialTensorProduct_isClosedWOT (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (N : VonNeumannAlgebra K) :
    IsClosed {T : Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] K) →WOT[ℂ] Completion (H ⊗[ℂ] K) |
      T.toCLM ∈ spatialTensorProduct M N} :=
  generatedBy_isClosedWOT _

end VonNeumannAlgebra

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.Ultraweak
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.PositiveNormalFunctional
public import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.PositiveLinearMap
public import Mathlib.Analysis.Real.Sqrt
public import Mathlib.Topology.Order

/-!
# The actual ultrastrong star topology

Every positive functional in the original normal-functional space supplies
the quadratic gauge from both original star squares. Translated gauge balls
at every original algebra element generate the topology on a named copy of
those same elements. Convergence is tested by every translated subbasic
neighborhood containing the proposed limit.

The positive-functional index uses the canonical C-star orders. All square
operations and functional values belong to the original concrete algebra.
This is the sigma-strong star view used in Takesaki Sections 2 and 3.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open Filter
open scoped Topology

namespace VonNeumannAlgebra

noncomputable section

universe u v

variable {H : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

/-- The actual normal-functional quadratic gauge retains both original star squares. -/
def ultrastrongStarGauge (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (φ : PositiveNormalFunctional M)
    (x : M) : ℝ :=
  Real.sqrt (((φ.1 : StrongDual ℂ M) (star x * x + x * star x)).re)

/-- The original zero element has zero quadratic gauge. -/
theorem ultrastrongStarGauge_zero (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (φ : PositiveNormalFunctional M) :
    ultrastrongStarGauge M φ (0 : M) = 0 := by
  simp only [ultrastrongStarGauge, star_zero, mul_zero, add_zero,
    map_zero, Complex.zero_re, Real.sqrt_zero]

/-- The ultrastrong star view has exactly the original algebra elements. -/
def UltraStrongStar (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) : Type u := M

/-- The view identifies every element with the same original algebra element. -/
def ultrastrongStarEquiv (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) : UltraStrongStar M ≃ M :=
  Equiv.refl M

/-- A translated quadratic gauge ball is centered at an original algebra element. -/
def ultrastrongStarBall (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (φ : PositiveNormalFunctional M)
    (a : M) (r : ℝ) : Set (UltraStrongStar M) :=
  {x | ultrastrongStarGauge M φ (ultrastrongStarEquiv M x - a) < r}

/-- All positive-radius translated balls for every actual positive normal functional. -/
def ultrastrongStarSubbasis (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) : Set (Set (UltraStrongStar M)) :=
  {s | ∃ φ : PositiveNormalFunctional M, ∃ a : M, ∃ r : ℝ,
    0 < r ∧ s = ultrastrongStarBall M φ a r}

/-- The ultrastrong star topology is generated by the actual translated quadratic gauge balls. -/
instance ultrastrongStarTopologicalSpace (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) :
    TopologicalSpace (UltraStrongStar M) :=
  TopologicalSpace.generateFrom (ultrastrongStarSubbasis M)

/-- Each positive-radius translated gauge ball is open in the actual generated topology. -/
theorem ultrastrongStarBall_isOpen (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (φ : PositiveNormalFunctional M)
    (a : M) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) : IsOpen (ultrastrongStarBall M φ a r) :=
  TopologicalSpace.isOpen_generateFrom_of_mem ⟨φ, a, r, hr, rfl⟩

/-- The actual center belongs to every one of its positive-radius gauge balls. -/
theorem mem_ultrastrongStarBall_center (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H)
    (φ : PositiveNormalFunctional M) (a : M) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    (ultrastrongStarEquiv M).symm a ∈ ultrastrongStarBall M φ a r := by
  change ultrastrongStarGauge M φ (a - a) < r
  simpa only [sub_self, ultrastrongStarGauge_zero] using hr

/-- Convergence is the exact test by every translated subbasic neighborhood containing the limit. -/
theorem ultrastrongStar_tendsto_iff (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H)
    {I : Type v} {l : Filter I} {f : I → UltraStrongStar M} {x : UltraStrongStar M} :
    Tendsto f l (𝓝 x) ↔
      ∀ (φ : PositiveNormalFunctional M) (a : M) (r : ℝ),
        0 < r → ultrastrongStarGauge M φ (ultrastrongStarEquiv M x - a) < r →
          ∀ᶠ i in l, ultrastrongStarGauge M φ (ultrastrongStarEquiv M (f i) - a) < r := by
  change Tendsto f l (@nhds (UltraStrongStar M)
    (TopologicalSpace.generateFrom (ultrastrongStarSubbasis M)) x) ↔ _
  rw [TopologicalSpace.tendsto_nhds_generateFrom_iff]
  constructor
  · intro h φ a r hr hx
    exact h (ultrastrongStarBall M φ a r) ⟨φ, a, r, hr, rfl⟩ hx
  · intro h s hs hx
    rcases hs with ⟨φ, a, r, hr, rfl⟩
    exact h φ a r hr hx


/-- The quadratic gauge uses the original normal-space functional and both original star squares. -/
theorem ultrastrongStarGauge_eq_normalFunctional (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H)
    (φ : PositiveNormalFunctional M) (x : M) :
    ultrastrongStarGauge M φ x =
      Real.sqrt (((φ.toNormalFunctionalSpace : StrongDual ℂ M)
        (star x * x + x * star x)).re) :=
  rfl

/-- The complete original normal-and-monotone family gives exactly the same subbasis. -/
theorem ultrastrongStarSubbasis_eq_normal_monotone (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) :
    letI : PartialOrder M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M
    letI : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ
    ultrastrongStarSubbasis M =
      {s | ∃ φ : normalFunctionalSpace M, Monotone (φ : StrongDual ℂ M) ∧
        ∃ a : M, ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧
          s = {x : UltraStrongStar M |
            Real.sqrt (((φ : StrongDual ℂ M)
              (star (ultrastrongStarEquiv M x - a) * (ultrastrongStarEquiv M x - a) +
                (ultrastrongStarEquiv M x - a) * star (ultrastrongStarEquiv M x - a))).re) < r}} := by
  let : PartialOrder M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M
  let : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ
  apply Set.ext
  intro s
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨φ, a, r, hr, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨φ.toNormalFunctionalSpace, φ.monotone, a, r, hr, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨φ, hφ, a, r, hr, hs⟩
    exact ⟨PositiveNormalFunctional.ofNormalFunctional M φ hφ, a, r, hr, hs⟩

/-- Reusing the positive-map bundle retains the topology generated by every original normal positive functional. -/
theorem ultrastrongStarTopologicalSpace_eq_normal_monotone (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) :
    letI : PartialOrder M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M
    letI : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ
    ultrastrongStarTopologicalSpace M =
      TopologicalSpace.generateFrom
        {s | ∃ φ : normalFunctionalSpace M, Monotone (φ : StrongDual ℂ M) ∧
          ∃ a : M, ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧
            s = {x : UltraStrongStar M |
              Real.sqrt (((φ : StrongDual ℂ M)
                (star (ultrastrongStarEquiv M x - a) * (ultrastrongStarEquiv M x - a) +
                  (ultrastrongStarEquiv M x - a) * star (ultrastrongStarEquiv M x - a))).re) < r}} := by
  let : PartialOrder M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M
  let : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ
  change TopologicalSpace.generateFrom (ultrastrongStarSubbasis M) = _
  rw [ultrastrongStarSubbasis_eq_normal_monotone]

end

end VonNeumannAlgebra

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.Predual
public import Mathlib.Topology.Algebra.Module.Spaces.WeakDual

/-!
# The actual ultraweak topology of a concrete von Neumann algebra

The weak copy retains the original algebra elements and operations. Its
topology is the stock `WeakBilin` topology for ordinary evaluation against
the actual normal-functional Banach space. The proved evaluation equivalence
identifies this copy with the stock weak-star dual of that same space.

Convergence and continuity are tested by the original functionals. The
original norm topology and the ultraweak topology remain distinct views.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open Filter
open scoped Topology

namespace VonNeumannAlgebra

universe u v

variable {H : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

/-- The original evaluation pairing with the actual normal-functional space. -/
noncomputable def normalFunctionalPairing (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) :
    M →ₗ[ℂ] normalFunctionalSpace M →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ where
  toFun x := (normalFunctionalEvaluation M x).toLinearMap
  map_add' := by
    intro x y
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro φ
    change (φ : StrongDual ℂ M) (x + y) =
      (φ : StrongDual ℂ M) x + (φ : StrongDual ℂ M) y
    exact map_add (φ : StrongDual ℂ M) x y
  map_smul' := by
    intro c x
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro φ
    change (φ : StrongDual ℂ M) (c • x) =
      (RingHom.id ℂ) c • (φ : StrongDual ℂ M) x
    simp only [map_smul, RingHom.id_apply]

/-- The actual bilinear pairing evaluates the original continuous functional. -/
@[simp]
theorem normalFunctionalPairing_apply (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (x : M)
    (φ : normalFunctionalSpace M) :
    normalFunctionalPairing M x φ = (φ : StrongDual ℂ M) x :=
  rfl

/-- The actual normal-functional pairing separates the original algebra elements. -/
theorem normalFunctionalPairing_injective (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) :
    Function.Injective (normalFunctionalPairing M) := by
  intro x y h
  apply normalFunctionalEvaluation_injective M
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro φ
  have he := congrArg (fun f : normalFunctionalSpace M →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ => f φ) h
  exact he

/-- Original algebra elements equipped with the evaluation-induced ultraweak topology. -/
noncomputable def Ultraweak (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) : Type u :=
  WeakBilin (normalFunctionalPairing M)

/-- The weak copy retains the original additive monoid operations. -/
noncomputable instance ultraweakAddCommMonoid (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) :
    AddCommMonoid (Ultraweak M) :=
  inferInstanceAs (AddCommMonoid (WeakBilin (normalFunctionalPairing M)))

/-- Complex scalar multiplication has its original algebra-element values. -/
noncomputable instance ultraweakSMul (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) : SMul ℂ (Ultraweak M) :=
  inferInstanceAs (SMul ℂ (WeakBilin (normalFunctionalPairing M)))

/-- The original complex module structure is retained in the weak copy. -/
noncomputable instance ultraweakModule (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) : Module ℂ (Ultraweak M) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Module ℂ (WeakBilin (normalFunctionalPairing M)))

/-- Multiplication, identity and ring operations are the original algebra operations. -/
noncomputable instance ultraweakRing (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) : Ring (Ultraweak M) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Ring M)

/-- The weak copy uses the original complex algebra action. -/
noncomputable instance ultraweakAlgebra (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) : Algebra ℂ (Ultraweak M) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Algebra ℂ M)

/-- The original operator involution is the weak copy's star operation. -/
noncomputable instance ultraweakStarRing (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) : StarRing (Ultraweak M) :=
  inferInstanceAs (StarRing M)

/-- The original conjugate scalar law for star is preserved. -/
noncomputable instance ultraweakStarModule (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) : StarModule ℂ (Ultraweak M) :=
  inferInstanceAs (StarModule ℂ M)

/-- The topology is exactly the stock weak topology of the actual evaluation pairing. -/
noncomputable instance ultraweakTopologicalSpace (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) :
    TopologicalSpace (Ultraweak M) :=
  inferInstanceAs (TopologicalSpace (WeakBilin (normalFunctionalPairing M)))

/-- Forgetting the ultraweak view retains every original complex vector-space value. -/
noncomputable def ultraweakLinearEquiv (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) : Ultraweak M ≃ₗ[ℂ] M where
  toFun x := x
  invFun x := x
  left_inv _ := rfl
  right_inv _ := rfl
  map_add' _ _ := rfl
  map_smul' _ _ := rfl

/-- The underlying value of a weak algebra element is its original value. -/
@[simp]
theorem ultraweakLinearEquiv_apply (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (x : Ultraweak M) :
    ultraweakLinearEquiv M x = x :=
  rfl

/-- Forgetting the weak topology preserves all original star-algebra operations. -/
noncomputable def ultraweakStarAlgEquiv (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) : Ultraweak M ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] M where
  toRingEquiv :=
    { toFun := fun x => x
      invFun := fun x => x
      left_inv := fun _ => rfl
      right_inv := fun _ => rfl
      map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl
      map_mul' := fun _ _ => rfl }
  map_smul' _ _ := rfl
  map_star' _ := rfl

/-- The star-algebra and linear identifications retain the same original element. -/
@[simp]
theorem ultraweakStarAlgEquiv_apply (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (x : Ultraweak M) :
    ultraweakStarAlgEquiv M x = ultraweakLinearEquiv M x :=
  rfl

/-- Every actual normal functional is continuous on the ultraweak view. -/
theorem ultraweak_eval_continuous (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (φ : normalFunctionalSpace M) :
    Continuous fun x : Ultraweak M => (φ : StrongDual ℂ M) (ultraweakLinearEquiv M x) :=
  WeakBilin.eval_continuous (normalFunctionalPairing M) φ

/-- Continuity into the ultraweak copy is tested by all actual normal functionals. -/
theorem ultraweak_continuous_iff (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H)
    {A : Type v} [TopologicalSpace A] {f : A → Ultraweak M} :
    Continuous f ↔ ∀ φ : normalFunctionalSpace M,
      Continuous fun a => (φ : StrongDual ℂ M) (ultraweakLinearEquiv M (f a)) := by
  constructor
  · intro hf φ
    exact (ultraweak_eval_continuous M φ).comp hf
  · intro h
    exact WeakBilin.continuous_of_continuous_eval (normalFunctionalPairing M) h

/-- Convergence in the ultraweak copy is exactly convergence of its original normal evaluations. -/
theorem ultraweak_tendsto_iff (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H)
    {A : Type v} {l : Filter A} {f : A → Ultraweak M} {x : Ultraweak M} :
    Tendsto f l (𝓝 x) ↔ ∀ φ : normalFunctionalSpace M,
      Tendsto (fun a => (φ : StrongDual ℂ M) (ultraweakLinearEquiv M (f a))) l
        (𝓝 ((φ : StrongDual ℂ M) (ultraweakLinearEquiv M x))) :=
  WeakBilin.tendsto_iff_forall_eval_tendsto
    (normalFunctionalPairing M) (normalFunctionalPairing_injective M)

/-- Addition of the original algebra elements is jointly ultraweak continuous. -/
noncomputable instance ultraweakContinuousAdd (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) : ContinuousAdd (Ultraweak M) where
  continuous_add := by
    apply (ultraweak_continuous_iff M).2
    intro φ
    have hf := (ultraweak_eval_continuous M φ).comp
      (continuous_fst : Continuous fun p : Ultraweak M × Ultraweak M => p.1)
    have hg := (ultraweak_eval_continuous M φ).comp
      (continuous_snd : Continuous fun p : Ultraweak M × Ultraweak M => p.2)
    have he :
        (fun p : Ultraweak M × Ultraweak M =>
          (φ : StrongDual ℂ M) (ultraweakLinearEquiv M (p.1 + p.2))) =
        ((fun x : Ultraweak M => (φ : StrongDual ℂ M) (ultraweakLinearEquiv M x)) ∘ Prod.fst) +
          ((fun x : Ultraweak M => (φ : StrongDual ℂ M) (ultraweakLinearEquiv M x)) ∘ Prod.snd) := by
      funext p
      rw [Pi.add_apply]
      simp only [Function.comp_apply, map_add]
    rw [he]
    exact hf.add hg

/-- The original complex scalar action is jointly ultraweak continuous. -/
noncomputable instance ultraweakContinuousSMul (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) :
    ContinuousSMul ℂ (Ultraweak M) where
  continuous_smul := by
    apply (ultraweak_continuous_iff M).2
    intro φ
    have hf := (ultraweak_eval_continuous M φ).comp
      (continuous_snd : Continuous fun p : ℂ × Ultraweak M => p.2)
    have hc : Continuous fun p : ℂ × Ultraweak M => p.1 := continuous_fst
    have he :
        (fun p : ℂ × Ultraweak M =>
          (φ : StrongDual ℂ M) (ultraweakLinearEquiv M (p.1 • p.2))) =
        (fun p : ℂ × Ultraweak M => p.1) •
          ((fun x : Ultraweak M => (φ : StrongDual ℂ M) (ultraweakLinearEquiv M x)) ∘ Prod.snd) := by
      funext p
      rw [Pi.smul_apply']
      simp only [Function.comp_apply, map_smul]
    rw [he]
    exact hc.smul hf

/-- The actual evaluation equivalence identifies the ultraweak copy with the stock weak-star dual. -/
noncomputable def ultraweakWeakDualHomeomorph (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) :
    Ultraweak M ≃ₜ WeakDual ℂ (normalFunctionalSpace M) :=
  let e : Ultraweak M ≃ WeakDual ℂ (normalFunctionalSpace M) :=
    { toFun := fun x =>
        (normalFunctionalEvaluationEquiv M (ultraweakLinearEquiv M x)).toWeakDual
      invFun := fun F =>
        (ultraweakLinearEquiv M).symm ((normalFunctionalEvaluationEquiv M).symm F.toStrongDual)
      left_inv := by
        intro x
        change (ultraweakLinearEquiv M).symm
          ((normalFunctionalEvaluationEquiv M).symm
            ((normalFunctionalEvaluationEquiv M (ultraweakLinearEquiv M x)).toWeakDual.toStrongDual)) = x
        rw [StrongDual.toStrongDual_toWeakDual, LinearIsometryEquiv.symm_apply_apply,
          LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
      right_inv := by
        intro F
        change (normalFunctionalEvaluationEquiv M
          (ultraweakLinearEquiv M
            ((ultraweakLinearEquiv M).symm
              ((normalFunctionalEvaluationEquiv M).symm F.toStrongDual)))).toWeakDual = F
        rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, LinearIsometryEquiv.apply_symm_apply,
          WeakDual.toWeakDual_toStrongDual] }
  ⟨e, by
    change Continuous fun x : Ultraweak M =>
      (normalFunctionalEvaluationEquiv M (ultraweakLinearEquiv M x)).toWeakDual
    apply WeakDual.continuous_of_continuous_eval
    intro φ
    simpa only [StrongDual.toWeakDual_apply, normalFunctionalEvaluationEquiv_apply] using
      ultraweak_eval_continuous M φ,
    by
      change Continuous fun F : WeakDual ℂ (normalFunctionalSpace M) =>
        (ultraweakLinearEquiv M).symm ((normalFunctionalEvaluationEquiv M).symm F.toStrongDual)
      apply (ultraweak_continuous_iff M).2
      intro φ
      have hfun :
          (fun F : WeakDual ℂ (normalFunctionalSpace M) =>
            (φ : StrongDual ℂ M)
              ((normalFunctionalEvaluationEquiv M).symm F.toStrongDual)) =
          (fun F : WeakDual ℂ (normalFunctionalSpace M) => F φ) := by
        funext F
        have he := congrArg (fun g : StrongDual ℂ (normalFunctionalSpace M) => g φ)
          ((normalFunctionalEvaluationEquiv M).apply_symm_apply F.toStrongDual)
        simpa only [normalFunctionalEvaluationEquiv_apply, WeakDual.toStrongDual_apply] using he
      change Continuous fun F : WeakDual ℂ (normalFunctionalSpace M) =>
        (φ : StrongDual ℂ M) ((normalFunctionalEvaluationEquiv M).symm F.toStrongDual)
      rw [hfun]
      exact WeakDual.eval_continuous φ⟩

/-- The homeomorphism uses the original normal-functional evaluation on every element. -/
@[simp]
theorem ultraweakWeakDualHomeomorph_apply (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (x : Ultraweak M)
    (φ : normalFunctionalSpace M) :
    ultraweakWeakDualHomeomorph M x φ = (φ : StrongDual ℂ M) (ultraweakLinearEquiv M x) :=
  rfl

/-- The actual ultraweak topology is Hausdorff by its proved weak-star dual identification. -/
noncomputable instance ultraweakT2Space (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) : T2Space (Ultraweak M) :=
  (ultraweakWeakDualHomeomorph M).isEmbedding.t2Space

/-- The identity from the original norm topology into the ultraweak topology is continuous. -/
theorem continuous_toUltraweak (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) :
    Continuous (ultraweakLinearEquiv M).symm := by
  apply (ultraweak_continuous_iff M).2
  intro φ
  simpa only [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] using (φ : StrongDual ℂ M).continuous

end VonNeumannAlgebra

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.Ultraweak
public import Mathlib.Analysis.LocallyConvex.WeakDual

/-!
# Continuous functionals on the actual ultraweak view

The proved weak representation theorem identifies every ultraweak-continuous
linear functional with evaluation against an element of the original normal
functional space. This membership certificate permits literal functional
pullback along normal maps to land in the actual predual subtype.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

namespace VonNeumannAlgebra

universe u

variable {H : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

/-- Ultraweak continuity certifies membership in the actual closed normal-functional space. -/
theorem mem_normalFunctionalSpace_of_ultraweak_continuous (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H)
    (ψ : StrongDual ℂ M)
    (hψ : Continuous fun x : Ultraweak M => ψ (ultraweakLinearEquiv M x)) :
    ψ ∈ normalFunctionalSpace M := by
  let F : StrongDual ℂ (Ultraweak M) :=
    { toLinearMap := ψ.toLinearMap.comp (ultraweakLinearEquiv M).toLinearMap
      cont := hψ }
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ⟩ := LinearMap.dualEmbedding_surjective (normalFunctionalPairing M) F
  have hval : (φ : StrongDual ℂ M) = ψ := by
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
    intro x
    have hx := congrArg
      (fun f : StrongDual ℂ (Ultraweak M) => f ((ultraweakLinearEquiv M).symm x)) hφ
    change (φ : StrongDual ℂ M)
        (ultraweakLinearEquiv M ((ultraweakLinearEquiv M).symm x)) =
      ψ (ultraweakLinearEquiv M ((ultraweakLinearEquiv M).symm x)) at hx
    simpa only [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] using hx
  exact hval ▸ φ.property

end VonNeumannAlgebra

Author: @toskua

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.Ultraweak
public import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.StarOrder
public import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Hom
public import Mathlib.Analysis.Complex.Basic
public import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Module.WeakDual
public import Mathlib.Topology.Order.OrderClosed

/-!
# The original spectral order and bounded compact sets in the ultraweak view

The ultraweak copy carries exactly the original concrete algebra's spectral
order. Original vector evaluations express operator positivity, so its order
relation is closed for the actual ultraweak topology. The proved original
normal-evaluation isometry and homeomorphism transport stock weak-star
compact dual balls to the same original norm bounds.

These are actual order/topology prerequisites for a bounded positive
family with a provided original LUB. No supremum, normal representation or
predual/norm certificate is supplied or selected as a new model.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open scoped InnerProductSpace

namespace VonNeumannAlgebra

noncomputable section

universe u

variable {H : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

/-- The ultraweak view has exactly the original algebra's canonical spectral order. -/
@[instance_reducible]
def ultraweakPartialOrder (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) : PartialOrder (Ultraweak M) :=
  @PartialOrder.lift (Ultraweak M) M (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M)
    (ultraweakLinearEquiv M) (ultraweakLinearEquiv M).injective

/-- The constructed order compares exactly the original algebra elements. -/
theorem ultraweak_le_iff (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (a b : Ultraweak M) :
    @LE.le (Ultraweak M) (ultraweakPartialOrder M).toLE a b ↔
      @LE.le M (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE
        (ultraweakLinearEquiv M a) (ultraweakLinearEquiv M b) :=
  Iff.rfl

/-- Original operator positivity makes the actual ultraweak spectral order closed. -/
theorem ultraweakOrderClosedTopology (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) :
    @OrderClosedTopology (Ultraweak M) inferInstance (ultraweakPartialOrder M).toPreorder := by
  let : PartialOrder M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M
  let : StarOrderedRing M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing M
  let : PartialOrder (Ultraweak M) := ultraweakPartialOrder M
  let ι : M →⋆ₐ[ℂ] (H →L[ℂ] H) := M.toStarSubalgebra.subtype
  have horder (a b : M) : @LE.le M (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE a b ↔
      ((b - a : M) : H →L[ℂ] H).IsPositive := by
    have hembed : (a : H →L[ℂ] H) ≤ (b : H →L[ℂ] H) ↔
        @LE.le M (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE a b :=
      NonUnitalStarAlgHom.map_le_map_iff (A := M) (B := H →L[ℂ] H) ι Subtype.val_injective
    have hpositive : (a : H →L[ℂ] H) ≤ (b : H →L[ℂ] H) ↔
        ((b - a : M) : H →L[ℂ] H).IsPositive := by
      rw [ContinuousLinearMap.le_def]
      rfl
    exact hembed.symm.trans hpositive
  let f (ξ : H) (p : Ultraweak M × Ultraweak M) : ℂ :=
    star (vectorFunctional M ξ ξ (ultraweakLinearEquiv M p.2 - ultraweakLinearEquiv M p.1))
  have hcontinuous (ξ : H) : Continuous (f ξ) := by
    let ψ : normalFunctionalSpace M :=
      ⟨vectorFunctional M ξ ξ, vectorFunctional_mem_normalFunctionalSpace M ξ ξ⟩
    have hleft := (ultraweak_eval_continuous M ψ).comp
      (continuous_fst : Continuous fun p : Ultraweak M × Ultraweak M => p.1)
    have hright := (ultraweak_eval_continuous M ψ).comp
      (continuous_snd : Continuous fun p : Ultraweak M × Ultraweak M => p.2)
    have h := (hright.sub hleft).star
    convert h using 1
    funext p
    simp only [f, ψ, Function.comp_apply, Pi.sub_apply, map_sub]
  let t : Set (Ultraweak M × Ultraweak M) :=
    ⋂ ξ : H, {p | Complex.ofReal (f ξ p).re = f ξ p ∧ 0 ≤ (f ξ p).re}
  have hreal (ξ : H) : Continuous (fun p : Ultraweak M × Ultraweak M => (f ξ p).re) :=
    Complex.continuous_re.comp (hcontinuous ξ)
  have hclosed : IsClosed t := by
    apply isClosed_iInter
    intro ξ
    exact (isClosed_eq (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp (hreal ξ)) (hcontinuous ξ)).inter
      (isClosed_le continuous_const (hreal ξ))
  have hset : {p : Ultraweak M × Ultraweak M |
      @LE.le (Ultraweak M) (ultraweakPartialOrder M).toLE p.1 p.2} = t := by
    ext p
    simp only [t, Set.mem_iInter, Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
    change @LE.le M (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE
      (ultraweakLinearEquiv M p.1) (ultraweakLinearEquiv M p.2) ↔
      ∀ ξ : H, Complex.ofReal (f ξ p).re = f ξ p ∧ 0 ≤ (f ξ p).re
    rw [horder, ContinuousLinearMap.isPositive_iff_complex]
    apply forall_congr'
    intro ξ
    have hvalue : f ξ p =
        ⟪((ultraweakLinearEquiv M p.2 - ultraweakLinearEquiv M p.1 : M) : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ, ξ⟫_ℂ := by
      dsimp only [f]
      rw [vectorFunctional_apply]
      exact inner_conj_symm _ _
    simp only [hvalue, RCLike.re_eq_complex_re]
  exact { isClosed_le' := hset.symm ▸ hclosed }

/-- Original norm-bounded closed balls are compact in the actual ultraweak view. -/
theorem ultraweakClosedBall_isCompact (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (r : ℝ) :
    IsCompact {x : Ultraweak M | ‖ultraweakLinearEquiv M x‖ ≤ r} := by
  let e := ultraweakWeakDualHomeomorph M
  let s : Set (WeakDual ℂ (normalFunctionalSpace M)) :=
    WeakDual.toStrongDual ⁻¹' Metric.closedBall (0 : StrongDual ℂ (normalFunctionalSpace M)) r
  have hs : IsCompact s := WeakDual.isCompact_closedBall 0 r
  have hset : {x : Ultraweak M | ‖ultraweakLinearEquiv M x‖ ≤ r} = e ⁻¹' s := by
    ext x
    change ‖ultraweakLinearEquiv M x‖ ≤ r ↔
      dist ((e x).toStrongDual) (0 : StrongDual ℂ (normalFunctionalSpace M)) ≤ r
    rw [dist_zero_right]
    change ‖ultraweakLinearEquiv M x‖ ≤ r ↔
      ‖normalFunctionalEvaluationEquiv M (ultraweakLinearEquiv M x)‖ ≤ r
    rw [(normalFunctionalEvaluationEquiv M).norm_map]
  rw [hset]
  exact e.isCompact_preimage.mpr hs

end

end VonNeumannAlgebra

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.Ultraweak
public import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.WeakOperatorTopology

/-!
# Original ultraweak elements map continuously to the weak operator carrier

Every original vector coefficient belongs to the actual normal-functional
space. Its ultraweak evaluation is continuous, and the stock Hilbert weak
operator topology is tested by precisely these vector coefficients. This
continuous original-value map transfers compact norm-ball images to WOT;
no norm, continuity, range or topology certificate is supplied.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open scoped Topology InnerProductSpace

namespace VonNeumannAlgebra

noncomputable section

universe u

variable {H : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

/-- Original ultraweak algebra elements, as original operators, vary continuously in WOT. -/
theorem ultraweak_toWOT_continuous (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) :
    Continuous (fun x : Ultraweak M =>
      ContinuousLinearMapWOT.ofCLM (ultraweakLinearEquiv M x : H →L[ℂ] H)) := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMapWOT.continuous_iff.mpr
  intro ξ η
  have hvalue (x : Ultraweak M) :
      (normalVectorFunctional M η ξ : StrongDual ℂ M) (ultraweakLinearEquiv M x) =
        ⟪η, (ultraweakLinearEquiv M x : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ⟫_ℂ :=
    vectorFunctional_apply M η ξ (ultraweakLinearEquiv M x)
  simpa only [hvalue, ContinuousLinearMapWOT.ofCLM_apply] using
    ultraweak_eval_continuous M (normalVectorFunctional M η ξ)

end

end VonNeumannAlgebra

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.UnitaryConjugation
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalAction
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.PointNormAction.CovariantRepresentation
public import Mathlib.Topology.MetricSpace.UniformConvergence
public import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Operator.BoundedLinearMaps

/-!
# The normal action of an actual normalizing unitary representation

The original unitary conjugations form their actual normal automorphism
homomorphism. Strong vector continuity supplies norm-continuous vector
functional inverse orbits; bounded functional pullbacks and the original
closed normal span extend this to the actual predual.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open scoped InnerProductSpace CStarAlgebra UniformConvergence

namespace VonNeumannAlgebra

noncomputable section

universe uG uH

variable {G : Type uG} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G]
variable {H : Type uH} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
variable (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (ρ : StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation G H)
variable (hEq : ∀ g : G,
  (fun T : H →L[ℂ] H => (ρ g : H →L[ℂ] H) * T * star (ρ g : H →L[ℂ] H)) ''
    (M : Set (H →L[ℂ] H)) = (M : Set (H →L[ℂ] H)))

/-- Actual normalizing unitary conjugations form the original normal automorphism group homomorphism. -/
def unitaryConjugationNormalHom : G →* NormalStarAlgEquiv M M where
  toFun g := unitaryConjugationNormalEquivOfEq M (ρ g) (hEq g)
  map_one' := by
    apply NormalStarAlgEquiv.ext
    apply StarAlgEquiv.ext
    intro x
    apply Subtype.ext
    change (unitaryConjugationNormalEquivOfEq M (ρ 1) (hEq 1) x : H →L[ℂ] H) =
      (x : H →L[ℂ] H)
    rw [unitaryConjugationNormalEquivOfEq_apply]
    have hU := ρ.toMonoidHom.map_one
    change ρ 1 = (1 : unitary (H →L[ℂ] H)) at hU
    rw [hU]
    simp only [Submonoid.coe_one, star_one, one_mul, mul_one]
  map_mul' g h := by
    apply NormalStarAlgEquiv.ext
    apply StarAlgEquiv.ext
    intro x
    apply Subtype.ext
    change (unitaryConjugationNormalEquivOfEq M (ρ (g * h)) (hEq (g * h)) x : H →L[ℂ] H) =
      (unitaryConjugationNormalEquivOfEq M (ρ g) (hEq g)
        (unitaryConjugationNormalEquivOfEq M (ρ h) (hEq h) x) : H →L[ℂ] H)
    simp only [unitaryConjugationNormalEquivOfEq_apply]
    have hU := ρ.toMonoidHom.map_mul g h
    change ρ (g * h) = ρ g * ρ h at hU
    rw [hU]
    simp only [Submonoid.coe_mul, star_mul, mul_assoc]

/-- The normal automorphism group map keeps the literal original unitary conjugation value. -/
@[simp]
theorem unitaryConjugationNormalHom_apply (g : G) (x : M) :
    (unitaryConjugationNormalHom M ρ hEq g x : H →L[ℂ] H) =
      (ρ g : H →L[ℂ] H) * (x : H →L[ℂ] H) * star (ρ g : H →L[ℂ] H) :=
  rfl

/-- The inverse predual action sends original vector functionals to the actual represented vectors. -/
theorem unitaryConjugation_predual_vectorFunctional (g : G) (ξ η : H) :
    (NormalStarAlgEquiv.predualActionHom M (unitaryConjugationNormalHom M ρ hEq g)
      ⟨vectorFunctional M ξ η, vectorFunctional_mem_normalFunctionalSpace M ξ η⟩ : StrongDual ℂ M) =
      vectorFunctional M ((ρ g : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ) ((ρ g : H →L[ℂ] H) η) := by
  let α := unitaryConjugationNormalHom M ρ hEq
  have hinv : (α g).symm = α g⁻¹ := by
    change (α g)⁻¹ = α g⁻¹
    exact (α.map_inv g).symm
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro x
  rw [NormalStarAlgEquiv.predualActionHom_apply, hinv]
  simp only [vectorFunctional_apply]
  change ⟪ξ, (unitaryConjugationNormalHom M ρ hEq g⁻¹ x : H →L[ℂ] H) η⟫_ℂ =
    ⟪(ρ g : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ, (x : H →L[ℂ] H) ((ρ g : H →L[ℂ] H) η)⟫_ℂ
  rw [unitaryConjugationNormalHom_apply]
  have hU := ρ.toMonoidHom.map_inv g
  change ρ g⁻¹ = star (ρ g) at hU
  rw [hU]
  simp only [Unitary.coe_star, star_star]
  change ⟪ξ, (star (ρ g) : H →L[ℂ] H)
      ((x : H →L[ℂ] H) ((ρ g : H →L[ℂ] H) η))⟫_ℂ =
    ⟪(ρ g : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ, (x : H →L[ℂ] H) ((ρ g : H →L[ℂ] H) η)⟫_ℂ
  calc
    _ = ⟪(star (star (ρ g)) : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ,
        (x : H →L[ℂ] H) ((ρ g : H →L[ℂ] H) η)⟫_ℂ :=
      (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_left (star (ρ g) : H →L[ℂ] H)
        ((x : H →L[ℂ] H) ((ρ g : H →L[ℂ] H) η)) ξ).symm
    _ = _ := by rw [star_star]

/-- Every original predual inverse orbit is norm continuous for the actual unitary representation. -/
theorem unitaryConjugation_predual_continuous (φ : normalFunctionalSpace M) :
    Continuous fun g : G =>
      NormalStarAlgEquiv.predualActionHom M (unitaryConjugationNormalHom M ρ hEq g) φ := by
  let α := unitaryConjugationNormalHom M ρ hEq
  let A : G → StrongDual ℂ M →L[ℂ] StrongDual ℂ M := fun g =>
    (ContinuousLinearMap.compL ℂ M M ℂ).flip (α g).symm.toNormalStarAlgHom.toContinuousLinearMap
  have hbound (g : G) (ψ : StrongDual ℂ M) : ‖A g ψ‖ ≤ ‖ψ‖ := by
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (norm_nonneg ψ)
    intro x
    change ‖ψ ((α g).symm x)‖ ≤ ‖ψ‖ * ‖x‖
    calc
      _ ≤ ‖ψ‖ * ‖(α g).symm x‖ := ψ.le_opNorm _
      _ ≤ ‖ψ‖ * ‖x‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (NonUnitalStarAlgHom.norm_apply_le (α g).symm.toNormalStarAlgHom.toStarAlgHom x)
        (norm_nonneg ψ)
  have hLip (g : G) : LipschitzWith 1 (A g) := by
    apply LipschitzWith.mk_one
    intro ψ θ
    simp only [dist_eq_norm]
    rw [← map_sub]
    exact hbound g (ψ - θ)
  let P : Submodule ℂ (StrongDual ℂ M) :=
    { carrier := {ψ | Continuous fun g : G => A g ψ}
      zero_mem' := by
        simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, map_zero]
        exact continuous_const
      add_mem' := by
        intro ψ θ hψ hθ
        have hcψ : Continuous fun g : G => A g ψ := hψ
        have hcθ : Continuous fun g : G => A g θ := hθ
        simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
        have hfun : (fun g : G => A g (ψ + θ)) =
            (fun g : G => A g ψ) + (fun g : G => A g θ) := by
          funext g
          rw [Pi.add_apply]
          exact map_add (A g) ψ θ
        rw [hfun]
        exact hcψ.add hcθ
      smul_mem' := by
        intro c ψ hψ
        have hcψ : Continuous fun g : G => A g ψ := hψ
        simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
        have hfun : (fun g : G => A g (c • ψ)) =
            (fun _ : G => c) • (fun g : G => A g ψ) := by
          funext g
          rw [Pi.smul_apply']
          exact map_smul (A g) c ψ
        rw [hfun]
        exact (continuous_const : Continuous fun _ : G => c).smul hcψ }
  have hOrbitLip : LipschitzWith 1
      (fun ψ : StrongDual ℂ M => UniformFun.ofFun (fun g : G => A g ψ)) :=
    UniformFun.lipschitzWith_ofFun_iff.mpr hLip
  have hPclosed : IsClosed (P : Set (StrongDual ℂ M)) := by
    change IsClosed ((fun ψ : StrongDual ℂ M => UniformFun.ofFun (fun g : G => A g ψ)) ⁻¹'
      {f : G →ᵤ StrongDual ℂ M | Continuous (UniformFun.toFun f)})
    exact (UniformFun.isClosed_setOfPred_continuous (α := G) (β := StrongDual ℂ M)).preimage
      hOrbitLip.continuous
  let R₀ : M →ₗ[ℂ] (H →L[ℂ] H) := LinearMap.ofClass M.toStarSubalgebra.subtype
  let R : M →L[ℂ] (H →L[ℂ] H) := R₀.mkContinuous 1 (by
    intro x
    change ‖(x : H →L[ℂ] H)‖ ≤ 1 * ‖x‖
    rw [one_mul]
    exact le_rfl)
  let E : H →L[ℂ] (H →L[ℂ] H) →L[ℂ] H := ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℂ H
  let J : H →L[ℂ] M →L[ℂ] H := (E.flip.comp R).flip
  let B : H →L⋆[ℂ] H →L[ℂ] StrongDual ℂ M :=
    ContinuousLinearMap.bilinearComp (ContinuousLinearMap.compL ℂ M H ℂ) (innerSL ℂ) J
  have hR (x : M) : R x = (x : H →L[ℂ] H) := by
    dsimp only [R]
    rw [LinearMap.mkContinuous_apply]
    rfl
  have hE (ξ : H) (T : H →L[ℂ] H) : E ξ T = T ξ := by
    dsimp only [E]
    exact ContinuousLinearMap.apply_apply ξ T
  have hJ (ξ : H) (x : M) : J ξ x = (R x) ξ := by
    dsimp only [J]
    rw [ContinuousLinearMap.flip_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.flip_apply]
    exact hE ξ (R x)
  have hEval (ξ η : H) (x : M) : B ξ η x = ⟪ξ, (x : H →L[ℂ] H) η⟫_ℂ := by
    calc
      B ξ η x = innerSL ℂ ξ (J η x) := by
        simp only [B, ContinuousLinearMap.bilinearComp_apply,
          ContinuousLinearMap.compL_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply]
      _ = ⟪ξ, (R x) η⟫_ℂ := by rw [hJ, innerSL_apply_apply]
      _ = ⟪ξ, (x : H →L[ℂ] H) η⟫_ℂ := by rw [hR]
  have hB (ξ η : H) : B ξ η = vectorFunctional M ξ η := by
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
    intro x
    exact (hEval ξ η x).trans (vectorFunctional_apply M ξ η x).symm
  have hvec (ξ η : H) : vectorFunctional M ξ η ∈ P := by
    change Continuous fun g : G => A g (vectorFunctional M ξ η)
    have he (g : G) : A g (vectorFunctional M ξ η) =
        B ((ρ g : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ) ((ρ g : H →L[ℂ] H) η) := by
      have h := unitaryConjugation_predual_vectorFunctional M ρ hEq g ξ η
      change A g (vectorFunctional M ξ η) =
        vectorFunctional M ((ρ g : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ) ((ρ g : H →L[ℂ] H) η) at h
      exact h.trans (hB ((ρ g : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ) ((ρ g : H →L[ℂ] H) η)).symm
    have hfun : (fun g : G => A g (vectorFunctional M ξ η)) =
        (fun g : G => B ((ρ g : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ) ((ρ g : H →L[ℂ] H) η)) := by
      funext g
      exact he g
    rw [hfun]
    exact (B.continuous.comp (ρ.continuous_orbit ξ)).clm_apply (ρ.continuous_orbit η)
  have hAll := normalFunctionalSpace_le M hPclosed hvec
  apply continuous_induced_rng.2
  change Continuous fun g : G => A g (φ : StrongDual ℂ M)
  exact hAll φ.property

/-- The actual normalized strongly continuous unitary representation defines its original normal action. -/
def unitaryConjugationNormalAction : NormalAction G M where
  toMonoidHom := unitaryConjugationNormalHom M ρ hEq
  continuous_predual_orbit := unitaryConjugation_predual_continuous M ρ hEq

end

end VonNeumannAlgebra
