Author: @toskua
-/
module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalEquiv
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.Generated
public import Mathlib.Algebra.Star.UnitaryStarAlgAut

/-!
# Spatial normal conjugation on the original concrete algebra

An actual unitary which normalizes a concrete von Neumann algebra restricts
the stock conjugation automorphism to that same operator subtype. Its vector
functionals pull back to the original functionals on the adjoint-transformed
vectors. Bounded functional pullback preserves their actual norm-closed span,
so both original conjugation maps are ultraweak continuous.

This supplies the spatial normal-equivalence constructor needed by normal
dual actions. The carrier conditions express the actual unitary normalization;
normality and predual preservation are proved from the original unitary.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open scoped InnerProductSpace CStarAlgebra

namespace VonNeumannAlgebra

noncomputable section

universe u

variable {H : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

section Restricted

variable (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (U : unitary (H →L[ℂ] H))
variable (hU : ∀ T : H →L[ℂ] H, T ∈ M → (U : H →L[ℂ] H) * T * (star U : H →L[ℂ] H) ∈ M)
variable (hUstar : ∀ T : H →L[ℂ] H, T ∈ M →
  (star U : H →L[ℂ] H) * T * (U : H →L[ℂ] H) ∈ M)

/-- Restrict the stock unitary conjugation and its actual inverse to the original algebra. -/
def unitaryConjugationStarAlgEquiv : M ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] M := by
  let e := Unitary.conjStarAlgAut ℂ (H →L[ℂ] H) U
  exact
    { toRingEquiv :=
        { toFun := fun x => ⟨(U : H →L[ℂ] H) * (x : H →L[ℂ] H) * (star U : H →L[ℂ] H),
            hU x.val x.property⟩
          invFun := fun x => ⟨(star U : H →L[ℂ] H) * (x : H →L[ℂ] H) * (U : H →L[ℂ] H),
            hUstar x.val x.property⟩
          left_inv := by
            intro x
            apply Subtype.ext
            change e.symm (e (x : H →L[ℂ] H)) = (x : H →L[ℂ] H)
            exact e.symm_apply_apply _
          right_inv := by
            intro x
            apply Subtype.ext
            change e (e.symm (x : H →L[ℂ] H)) = (x : H →L[ℂ] H)
            exact e.apply_symm_apply _
          map_mul' := by
            intro x y
            apply Subtype.ext
            change e ((x : H →L[ℂ] H) * (y : H →L[ℂ] H)) =
              e (x : H →L[ℂ] H) * e (y : H →L[ℂ] H)
            exact map_mul e _ _
          map_add' := by
            intro x y
            apply Subtype.ext
            change e ((x : H →L[ℂ] H) + (y : H →L[ℂ] H)) =
              e (x : H →L[ℂ] H) + e (y : H →L[ℂ] H)
            exact map_add e _ _ }
      map_smul' := by
        intro c x
        apply Subtype.ext
        change e (c • (x : H →L[ℂ] H)) = c • e (x : H →L[ℂ] H)
        exact map_smul e _ _
      map_star' := by
        intro x
        apply Subtype.ext
        change e (star (x : H →L[ℂ] H)) = star (e (x : H →L[ℂ] H))
        exact map_star e _ }

/-- The restricted automorphism keeps the original spatial operator value. -/
@[simp]
theorem unitaryConjugationStarAlgEquiv_apply (x : M) :
    (unitaryConjugationStarAlgEquiv M U hU hUstar x : H →L[ℂ] H) =
      (U : H →L[ℂ] H) * (x : H →L[ℂ] H) * (star U : H →L[ℂ] H) :=
  rfl

/-- The restricted inverse is the original adjoint-unitary conjugation. -/
theorem unitaryConjugationStarAlgEquiv_symm_apply (x : M) :
    ((unitaryConjugationStarAlgEquiv M U hU hUstar).symm x : H →L[ℂ] H) =
      (star U : H →L[ℂ] H) * (x : H →L[ℂ] H) * (U : H →L[ℂ] H) :=
  rfl

/-- Spatial pullback is the actual vector functional on the adjoint-transformed vectors. -/
theorem unitaryConjugation_vectorFunctional (ξ η : H) (x : M) :
    vectorFunctional M ξ η (unitaryConjugationStarAlgEquiv M U hU hUstar x) =
      vectorFunctional M ((star U : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ) ((star U : H →L[ℂ] H) η) x := by
  simp only [vectorFunctional_apply, unitaryConjugationStarAlgEquiv_apply]
  change ⟪ξ, (U : H →L[ℂ] H) ((x : H →L[ℂ] H) ((star U : H →L[ℂ] H) η))⟫_ℂ =
    ⟪(star U : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ, (x : H →L[ℂ] H) ((star U : H →L[ℂ] H) η)⟫_ℂ
  exact (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_left (U : H →L[ℂ] H)
    ((x : H →L[ℂ] H) ((star U : H →L[ℂ] H) η)) ξ).symm

/-- Actual spatial normalization gives the original normal automorphism in both directions. -/
def unitaryConjugationNormalEquiv : NormalStarAlgEquiv M M := by
  let e := unitaryConjugationStarAlgEquiv M U hU hUstar
  have hnormal (f : M ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] M) (V : unitary (H →L[ℂ] H))
      (hf : ∀ x : M, (f x : H →L[ℂ] H) =
        Unitary.conjStarAlgAut ℂ (H →L[ℂ] H) V (x : H →L[ℂ] H)) :
      Continuous fun x : Ultraweak M =>
        (ultraweakLinearEquiv M).symm (f (ultraweakLinearEquiv M x)) := by
    let T : M →L[ℂ] M := ⟨LinearMap.ofClass f.toStarAlgHom, map_continuous f.toStarAlgHom⟩
    let B : StrongDual ℂ M →L[ℂ] StrongDual ℂ M := (ContinuousLinearMap.compL ℂ M M ℂ).flip T
    let P := (normalFunctionalSpace M).comap B.toLinearMap
    have hPclosed : IsClosed (P : Set (StrongDual ℂ M)) := by
      change IsClosed (B ⁻¹' (normalFunctionalSpace M : Set (StrongDual ℂ M)))
      exact (normalFunctionalSpace_isClosed M).preimage B.continuous
    have hvec (ξ η : H) : vectorFunctional M ξ η ∈ P := by
      change B (vectorFunctional M ξ η) ∈ normalFunctionalSpace M
      have hB : B (vectorFunctional M ξ η) =
          vectorFunctional M ((star V : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ) ((star V : H →L[ℂ] H) η) := by
        apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
        intro x
        change vectorFunctional M ξ η (f x) =
          vectorFunctional M ((star V : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ) ((star V : H →L[ℂ] H) η) x
        simp only [vectorFunctional_apply]
        rw [hf]
        change ⟪ξ, (V : H →L[ℂ] H) ((x : H →L[ℂ] H) ((star V : H →L[ℂ] H) η))⟫_ℂ =
          ⟪(star V : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ, (x : H →L[ℂ] H) ((star V : H →L[ℂ] H) η)⟫_ℂ
        exact (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_left (V : H →L[ℂ] H)
          ((x : H →L[ℂ] H) ((star V : H →L[ℂ] H) η)) ξ).symm
      rw [hB]
      exact vectorFunctional_mem_normalFunctionalSpace M _ _
    have hPall := normalFunctionalSpace_le M hPclosed hvec
    apply (ultraweak_continuous_iff M).2
    intro φ
    have hmem := hPall φ.property
    change B (φ : StrongDual ℂ M) ∈ normalFunctionalSpace M at hmem
    change Continuous fun x : Ultraweak M => (φ : StrongDual ℂ M) (f (ultraweakLinearEquiv M x))
    have hfun : (fun x : Ultraweak M => (φ : StrongDual ℂ M) (f (ultraweakLinearEquiv M x))) =
        (fun x : Ultraweak M => (B (φ : StrongDual ℂ M)) (ultraweakLinearEquiv M x)) := by
      funext x
      rfl
    rw [hfun]
    exact ultraweak_eval_continuous M ⟨B (φ : StrongDual ℂ M), hmem⟩
  exact
    { toStarAlgEquiv := e
      continuous_ultraweak := hnormal e U (by intro x; rfl)
      continuous_ultraweak_symm := hnormal e.symm (star U) (by
        intro x
        change ((unitaryConjugationStarAlgEquiv M U hU hUstar).symm x : H →L[ℂ] H) = _
        simp only [unitaryConjugationStarAlgEquiv_symm_apply, Unitary.conjStarAlgAut_apply,
          Unitary.coe_star, star_star]) }

/-- The normal bundle retains the original unitary-conjugation value. -/
@[simp]
theorem unitaryConjugationNormalEquiv_apply (x : M) :
    (unitaryConjugationNormalEquiv M U hU hUstar x : H →L[ℂ] H) =
      (U : H →L[ℂ] H) * (x : H →L[ℂ] H) * (star U : H →L[ℂ] H) :=
  rfl

/-- The actual normal inverse retains the original adjoint-conjugation value. -/
theorem unitaryConjugationNormalEquiv_symm_apply (x : M) :
    ((unitaryConjugationNormalEquiv M U hU hUstar).symm x : H →L[ℂ] H) =
      (star U : H →L[ℂ] H) * (x : H →L[ℂ] H) * (U : H →L[ℂ] H) :=
  rfl

include hU hUstar in
/-- The two original carrier inclusions give the printed spatial normalization equality. -/
theorem unitaryConjugationStarAlgEquiv_image :
    (fun T : H →L[ℂ] H => (U : H →L[ℂ] H) * T * (star U : H →L[ℂ] H)) ''
      (M : Set (H →L[ℂ] H)) = (M : Set (H →L[ℂ] H)) := by
  let e := Unitary.conjStarAlgAut ℂ (H →L[ℂ] H) U
  apply Set.ext
  intro T
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨S, hS, rfl⟩
    exact hU S hS
  · intro hT
    refine ⟨(star U : H →L[ℂ] H) * T * (U : H →L[ℂ] H), hUstar T hT, ?_⟩
    change e (e.symm T) = T
    exact e.apply_symm_apply T

/-- The exact source equality U M U* = M constructs the same original normal spatial automorphism. -/
def unitaryConjugationNormalEquivOfEq
    (hEq : (fun T : H →L[ℂ] H => (U : H →L[ℂ] H) * T * (star U : H →L[ℂ] H)) ''
      (M : Set (H →L[ℂ] H)) = (M : Set (H →L[ℂ] H))) : NormalStarAlgEquiv M M := by
  let e := Unitary.conjStarAlgAut ℂ (H →L[ℂ] H) U
  have heq : e '' (M : Set (H →L[ℂ] H)) = (M : Set (H →L[ℂ] H)) := hEq
  have hfwd (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : T ∈ M) :
      (U : H →L[ℂ] H) * T * (star U : H →L[ℂ] H) ∈ M := by
    change e T ∈ (M : Set (H →L[ℂ] H))
    rw [← heq]
    exact Set.mem_image_of_mem e hT
  have hbwd (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (hT : T ∈ M) :
      (star U : H →L[ℂ] H) * T * (U : H →L[ℂ] H) ∈ M := by
    have hmem : T ∈ e '' (M : Set (H →L[ℂ] H)) := by
      rw [heq]
      exact hT
    rcases hmem with ⟨S, hS, hST⟩
    change e.symm T ∈ (M : Set (H →L[ℂ] H))
    rw [← hST, StarAlgEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
    exact hS
  exact unitaryConjugationNormalEquiv M U hfwd hbwd

/-- The exact-equality constructor retains the original unitary conjugation formula. -/
@[simp]
theorem unitaryConjugationNormalEquivOfEq_apply
    (hEq : (fun T : H →L[ℂ] H => (U : H →L[ℂ] H) * T * (star U : H →L[ℂ] H)) ''
      (M : Set (H →L[ℂ] H)) = (M : Set (H →L[ℂ] H))) (x : M) :
    (unitaryConjugationNormalEquivOfEq M U hEq x : H →L[ℂ] H) =
      (U : H →L[ℂ] H) * (x : H →L[ℂ] H) * (star U : H →L[ℂ] H) :=
  rfl

end Restricted

/-- Preserving the original star adjoin preserves its actual generated double commutant. -/
theorem unitaryConjugation_generatedBy_mem (s : Set (H →L[ℂ] H)) (U : unitary (H →L[ℂ] H))
    (hs : ∀ a : H →L[ℂ] H, a ∈ s →
      (U : H →L[ℂ] H) * a * (star U : H →L[ℂ] H) ∈ StarAlgebra.adjoin ℂ s)
    (x : H →L[ℂ] H) (hx : x ∈ generatedBy s) :
    (U : H →L[ℂ] H) * x * (star U : H →L[ℂ] H) ∈ generatedBy s := by
  let A := StarAlgebra.adjoin ℂ s
  let e := Unitary.conjStarAlgAut ℂ (H →L[ℂ] H) U
  have hA : A ≤ A.comap e.toStarAlgHom := by
    apply StarAlgebra.adjoin_le
    intro a ha
    change e a ∈ A
    exact hs a ha
  have hx' : x ∈ Set.centralizer (Set.centralizer (A : Set (H →L[ℂ] H))) := by
    change x ∈ (generatedBy s : Set (H →L[ℂ] H)) at hx
    rw [coe_generatedBy] at hx
    exact hx
  change e x ∈ (generatedBy s : Set (H →L[ℂ] H))
  rw [coe_generatedBy]
  change ∀ b : H →L[ℂ] H, b ∈ Set.centralizer (A : Set (H →L[ℂ] H)) → b * e x = e x * b
  intro b hb
  have hpre : e.symm b ∈ Set.centralizer (A : Set (H →L[ℂ] H)) := by
    intro a ha
    apply e.injective
    calc
      e (a * e.symm b) = e a * e (e.symm b) := map_mul e _ _
      _ = e a * b := congrArg (fun z : H →L[ℂ] H => e a * z) (e.apply_symm_apply b)
      _ = b * e a := hb (e a) (hA ha)
      _ = e (e.symm b) * e a :=
        congrArg (fun z : H →L[ℂ] H => z * e a) (e.apply_symm_apply b).symm
      _ = e (e.symm b * a) := (map_mul e _ _).symm
  calc
    b * e x = e (e.symm b) * e x :=
      congrArg (fun z : H →L[ℂ] H => z * e x) (e.apply_symm_apply b).symm
    _ = e (e.symm b * x) := (map_mul e _ _).symm
    _ = e (x * e.symm b) := congrArg e (hx' (e.symm b) hpre)
    _ = e x * e (e.symm b) := map_mul e _ _
    _ = e x * b := congrArg (fun z : H →L[ℂ] H => e x * z) (e.apply_symm_apply b)

end

end VonNeumannAlgebra

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.GNS.UniversalRepresentation
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.OperatorBidual
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.Normed.Operator.Arens
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.Normed.Module.StrongDualStar
public import Mathlib.Topology.Algebra.Module.Spaces.ContinuousLinearMap

/-!
# The original universal representation on the actual bidual

The canonical operator-bidual retraction is composed with the two bounded
strong-dual precomposition maps of the original all-state representation.
Its coefficient is exactly F(a ↦ ⟪η, π(a)ξ⟫), with the original A* and A**
operator norms. Both Arens products and the intrinsic bidual involution are
preserved by evaluating these original vector functionals.

No C-star or W-star structure on A** is assumed or selected. The original
algebra may be nonunital or zero, and its universal Hilbert sum is the existing
arbitrary-state-index completion. The future compatible bidual C-star/W-star
existence theorem remains a separate whole source obligation.

These strict constructors and characteristics provide the operator map in
`universal-operator-bidual-extension.md`, needed by the canonical A** objects
in Blackadar 15.8.1(3). The iterated Arens/coefficient formulas are the adopted
unpacking recorded in `blackadar-bidual-amenability.md`, not additional formulas
attributed verbatim to the printed theorem.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open scoped InnerProductSpace StrongDual

attribute [local instance]
  ContinuousLinearMap.arensDualSeminormed
  ContinuousLinearMap.arensDualNormedSpace
  ContinuousLinearMap.arensDualTargetSeminormed
  ContinuousLinearMap.arensDualTargetNormedSpace
  ContinuousLinearMap.arensDualTargetTopologicalAddGroup
  ContinuousLinearMap.arensMapSeminormed
  ContinuousLinearMap.arensMapNormedSpace
  ContinuousLinearMap.arensMapTopologicalAddGroup
  ContinuousLinearMap.arensBidualSeminormed
  ContinuousLinearMap.arensBidualNormedSpace
  ContinuousLinearMap.arensBidualMapSeminormed
  ContinuousLinearMap.arensBidualMapNormedSpace
  ContinuousLinearMap.arensBidualMapTopologicalAddGroup

namespace CStarAlgebra

universe uA

variable (A : Type uA) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]

/-- The original all-state coefficient map, bundled with its existing contraction bound. -/
def universalStateGNSRepresentationCLM :
    A →L[ℂ] (UniversalStateGNSpace A →L[ℂ] UniversalStateGNSpace A) :=
  LinearMap.mkContinuous
    ({ toFun := universalStateGNSRepresentation A
       map_add' := map_add (universalStateGNSRepresentation A)
       map_smul' := map_smul (universalStateGNSRepresentation A) } :
      A →ₗ[ℂ] (UniversalStateGNSpace A →L[ℂ] UniversalStateGNSpace A))
    1 fun a => by
      change ‖universalStateGNSRepresentation A a‖ ≤ 1 * ‖a‖
      simpa only [one_mul] using norm_universalStateGNSRepresentation_le A a

/-- The bounded coefficient map retains the original nonunital star-homomorphism value. -/
@[simp]
theorem universalStateGNSRepresentationCLM_apply (a : A) :
    universalStateGNSRepresentationCLM A a = universalStateGNSRepresentation A a := rfl

/-- The original universal coefficient map has operator norm at most one. -/
theorem norm_universalStateGNSRepresentationCLM_le :
    ‖universalStateGNSRepresentationCLM A‖ ≤ 1 := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound (universalStateGNSRepresentationCLM A) zero_le_one
  intro a
  rw [universalStateGNSRepresentationCLM_apply, one_mul]
  exact norm_universalStateGNSRepresentation_le A a

/-- The actual A* vector coefficient, formed by original bounded precomposition. -/
def universalStateGNSCoefficient (ξ η : UniversalStateGNSpace A) : StrongDual ℂ A :=
  (MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.operatorCoefficient ξ η).comp
    (universalStateGNSRepresentationCLM A)

/-- The actual coefficient functional evaluates the original representation and vectors. -/
@[simp]
theorem universalStateGNSCoefficient_apply (ξ η : UniversalStateGNSpace A) (a : A) :
    universalStateGNSCoefficient A ξ η a = ⟪η, universalStateGNSRepresentation A a ξ⟫_ℂ := by
  simp only [universalStateGNSCoefficient, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,
    universalStateGNSRepresentationCLM_apply,
    MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.operatorCoefficient_apply]

/-- The original coefficient-functional norm is bounded by the original two vector norms. -/
theorem norm_universalStateGNSCoefficient_le (ξ η : UniversalStateGNSpace A) :
    ‖universalStateGNSCoefficient A ξ η‖ ≤ ‖ξ‖ * ‖η‖ := by
  calc
    ‖universalStateGNSCoefficient A ξ η‖ ≤
        ‖MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.operatorCoefficient ξ η‖ *
          ‖universalStateGNSRepresentationCLM A‖ :=
      ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_comp_le _ _
    _ ≤ (‖ξ‖ * ‖η‖) * ‖universalStateGNSRepresentationCLM A‖ :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
        (MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.norm_operatorCoefficient_le ξ η)
        (ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_nonneg (universalStateGNSRepresentationCLM A))
    _ ≤ (‖ξ‖ * ‖η‖) * 1 :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (norm_universalStateGNSRepresentationCLM_le A)
        (mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg ξ) (norm_nonneg η))
    _ = ‖ξ‖ * ‖η‖ := mul_one _

/-- The canonical continuous linear extension on the literal original strong bidual.
`precomp` is the pinned Mathlib strong-dual map; applying it twice is π**. -/
def universalBidualExtension :
    StrongDual ℂ (StrongDual ℂ A) →L[ℂ]
      (UniversalStateGNSpace A →L[ℂ] UniversalStateGNSpace A) :=
  MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.operatorBidualRetraction.comp
    (((universalStateGNSRepresentationCLM A).precomp (G := ℂ)).precomp (G := ℂ))

/-- Every original bidual coefficient is the literal original A* evaluation. -/
theorem universalBidualExtension_inner (p : StrongDual ℂ (StrongDual ℂ A))
    (ξ η : UniversalStateGNSpace A) :
    ⟪η, universalBidualExtension A p ξ⟫_ℂ = p (universalStateGNSCoefficient A ξ η) := by
  change ⟪η, MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.operatorBidualRetraction
    ((((universalStateGNSRepresentationCLM A).precomp (G := ℂ)).precomp (G := ℂ)) p) ξ⟫_ℂ =
      p (universalStateGNSCoefficient A ξ η)
  rw [MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.operatorBidualRetraction_inner]
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.precomp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply]
  rfl

/-- The canonical extension restricts to the original representation under η(a)(φ)=φ(a). -/
@[simp]
theorem universalBidualExtension_inclusionInDoubleDual (a : A) :
    universalBidualExtension A (NormedSpace.inclusionInDoubleDual ℂ A a) =
      universalStateGNSRepresentation A a := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro ξ
  apply ext_inner_left ℂ
  intro η
  calc
    ⟪η, universalBidualExtension A (NormedSpace.inclusionInDoubleDual ℂ A a) ξ⟫_ℂ =
        NormedSpace.inclusionInDoubleDual ℂ A a (universalStateGNSCoefficient A ξ η) :=
      universalBidualExtension_inner A (NormedSpace.inclusionInDoubleDual ℂ A a) ξ η
    _ = universalStateGNSCoefficient A ξ η a :=
      NormedSpace.dual_def ℂ A a (universalStateGNSCoefficient A ξ η)
    _ = ⟪η, universalStateGNSRepresentation A a ξ⟫_ℂ :=
      universalStateGNSCoefficient_apply A ξ η a

/-- Every extension value is contractive for the original iterated-dual operator norm. -/
theorem norm_universalBidualExtension_apply_le (p : StrongDual ℂ (StrongDual ℂ A)) :
    ‖universalBidualExtension A p‖ ≤ ‖p‖ := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (norm_nonneg p)
  intro ξ
  rw [← innerSL_apply_norm ℂ (universalBidualExtension A p ξ)]
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg p) (norm_nonneg ξ))
  intro η
  calc
    ‖innerSL ℂ (universalBidualExtension A p ξ) η‖ =
        ‖⟪η, universalBidualExtension A p ξ⟫_ℂ‖ := by
      rw [innerSL_apply_apply, norm_inner_symm]
    _ = ‖p (universalStateGNSCoefficient A ξ η)‖ := by rw [universalBidualExtension_inner]
    _ ≤ ‖p‖ * ‖universalStateGNSCoefficient A ξ η‖ :=
      ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm (E := StrongDual ℂ A) (F := ℂ)
        (σ₁₂ := RingHom.id ℂ) p _
    _ ≤ ‖p‖ * (‖ξ‖ * ‖η‖) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (norm_universalStateGNSCoefficient_le A ξ η) (norm_nonneg p)
    _ = (‖p‖ * ‖ξ‖) * ‖η‖ := by rw [mul_assoc]

/-- The canonical continuous linear extension has operator norm at most one. -/
theorem norm_universalBidualExtension_le : ‖universalBidualExtension A‖ ≤ 1 := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ zero_le_one
  intro p
  simpa only [one_mul] using norm_universalBidualExtension_apply_le A p

/-- Original left multiplication translates a vector functional through the actual adjoint. -/
theorem universalStateGNSCoefficient_mul_left (a : A) (ξ η : UniversalStateGNSpace A) :
    (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ A).dualBilinear (universalStateGNSCoefficient A ξ η) a =
      universalStateGNSCoefficient A ξ (star (universalStateGNSRepresentation A a) η) := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro b
  rw [ContinuousLinearMap.dualBilinear_apply,
    universalStateGNSCoefficient_apply, universalStateGNSCoefficient_apply]
  change ⟪η, universalStateGNSRepresentation A (a * b) ξ⟫_ℂ =
    ⟪star (universalStateGNSRepresentation A a) η, universalStateGNSRepresentation A b ξ⟫_ℂ
  rw [map_mul]
  change ⟪η, universalStateGNSRepresentation A a (universalStateGNSRepresentation A b ξ)⟫_ℂ = _
  rw [ContinuousLinearMap.star_eq_adjoint]
  exact (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_left (universalStateGNSRepresentation A a)
    (universalStateGNSRepresentation A b ξ) η).symm

/-- Original right multiplication translates the original first vector, with no adjoint change. -/
theorem universalStateGNSCoefficient_mul_right (b : A) (ξ η : UniversalStateGNSpace A) :
    (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ A).flip.dualBilinear
        (universalStateGNSCoefficient A ξ η) b =
      universalStateGNSCoefficient A (universalStateGNSRepresentation A b ξ) η := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro a
  rw [ContinuousLinearMap.dualBilinear_apply,
    universalStateGNSCoefficient_apply, universalStateGNSCoefficient_apply]
  change ⟪η, universalStateGNSRepresentation A (a * b) ξ⟫_ℂ =
    ⟪η, universalStateGNSRepresentation A a (universalStateGNSRepresentation A b ξ)⟫_ℂ
  rw [map_mul]
  rfl

/-- The first literal Arens product maps to the original operator product. -/
theorem universalBidualExtension_arensFirst (p q : StrongDual ℂ (StrongDual ℂ A)) :
    universalBidualExtension A ((ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ A).arensFirst p q) =
      universalBidualExtension A p * universalBidualExtension A q := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro ξ
  apply ext_inner_left ℂ
  intro η
  have hcoeff : (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ A).dualBilinear.dualBilinear q
        (universalStateGNSCoefficient A ξ η) =
      universalStateGNSCoefficient A (universalBidualExtension A q ξ) η := by
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
    intro a
    calc
      (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ A).dualBilinear.dualBilinear q
          (universalStateGNSCoefficient A ξ η) a =
          q ((ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ A).dualBilinear
            (universalStateGNSCoefficient A ξ η) a) :=
        ContinuousLinearMap.dualBilinear_apply (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ A).dualBilinear
          q (universalStateGNSCoefficient A ξ η) a
      _ = q (universalStateGNSCoefficient A ξ (star (universalStateGNSRepresentation A a) η)) :=
        congrArg q (universalStateGNSCoefficient_mul_left A a ξ η)
      _ = ⟪star (universalStateGNSRepresentation A a) η, universalBidualExtension A q ξ⟫_ℂ :=
        (universalBidualExtension_inner A q ξ (star (universalStateGNSRepresentation A a) η)).symm
      _ = ⟪η, universalStateGNSRepresentation A a (universalBidualExtension A q ξ)⟫_ℂ := by
        rw [ContinuousLinearMap.star_eq_adjoint]
        exact ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_left (universalStateGNSRepresentation A a)
          (universalBidualExtension A q ξ) η
      _ = universalStateGNSCoefficient A (universalBidualExtension A q ξ) η a :=
        (universalStateGNSCoefficient_apply A (universalBidualExtension A q ξ) η a).symm
  calc
    ⟪η, universalBidualExtension A ((ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ A).arensFirst p q) ξ⟫_ℂ =
        (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ A).arensFirst p q (universalStateGNSCoefficient A ξ η) :=
      universalBidualExtension_inner A ((ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ A).arensFirst p q) ξ η
    _ = p ((ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ A).dualBilinear.dualBilinear q
        (universalStateGNSCoefficient A ξ η)) :=
      ContinuousLinearMap.arensFirst_apply (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ A) p q
        (universalStateGNSCoefficient A ξ η)
    _ = p (universalStateGNSCoefficient A (universalBidualExtension A q ξ) η) :=
      congrArg p hcoeff
    _ = ⟪η, universalBidualExtension A p (universalBidualExtension A q ξ)⟫_ℂ :=
      (universalBidualExtension_inner A p (universalBidualExtension A q ξ) η).symm
    _ = ⟪η, (universalBidualExtension A p * universalBidualExtension A q) ξ⟫_ℂ := by
      rw [mul_apply_eq_comp]

/-- The second literal Arens product has the same original operator-product image. -/
theorem universalBidualExtension_arensSecond (p q : StrongDual ℂ (StrongDual ℂ A)) :
    universalBidualExtension A ((ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ A).arensSecond p q) =
      universalBidualExtension A p * universalBidualExtension A q := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro ξ
  apply ext_inner_left ℂ
  intro η
  have h : (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ A).flip.dualBilinear.dualBilinear p
        (universalStateGNSCoefficient A ξ η) =
      universalStateGNSCoefficient A ξ (star (universalBidualExtension A p) η) := by
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
    intro b
    calc
      (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ A).flip.dualBilinear.dualBilinear p
          (universalStateGNSCoefficient A ξ η) b =
          p ((ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ A).flip.dualBilinear
            (universalStateGNSCoefficient A ξ η) b) :=
        ContinuousLinearMap.dualBilinear_apply (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ A).flip.dualBilinear
          p (universalStateGNSCoefficient A ξ η) b
      _ = p (universalStateGNSCoefficient A (universalStateGNSRepresentation A b ξ) η) :=
        congrArg p (universalStateGNSCoefficient_mul_right A b ξ η)
      _ = ⟪η, universalBidualExtension A p (universalStateGNSRepresentation A b ξ)⟫_ℂ :=
        (universalBidualExtension_inner A p (universalStateGNSRepresentation A b ξ) η).symm
      _ = ⟪star (universalBidualExtension A p) η,
          universalStateGNSRepresentation A b ξ⟫_ℂ := by
        rw [ContinuousLinearMap.star_eq_adjoint]
        exact (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_left (universalBidualExtension A p)
          (universalStateGNSRepresentation A b ξ) η).symm
      _ = universalStateGNSCoefficient A ξ (star (universalBidualExtension A p) η) b :=
        (universalStateGNSCoefficient_apply A ξ (star (universalBidualExtension A p) η) b).symm
  calc
    ⟪η, universalBidualExtension A ((ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ A).arensSecond p q) ξ⟫_ℂ =
        (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ A).arensSecond p q (universalStateGNSCoefficient A ξ η) :=
      universalBidualExtension_inner A ((ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ A).arensSecond p q) ξ η
    _ = q ((ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ A).flip.dualBilinear.dualBilinear p
        (universalStateGNSCoefficient A ξ η)) :=
      ContinuousLinearMap.arensSecond_apply (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ A) p q
        (universalStateGNSCoefficient A ξ η)
    _ = q (universalStateGNSCoefficient A ξ (star (universalBidualExtension A p) η)) :=
      congrArg q h
    _ = ⟪star (universalBidualExtension A p) η, universalBidualExtension A q ξ⟫_ℂ :=
      (universalBidualExtension_inner A q ξ (star (universalBidualExtension A p) η)).symm
    _ = ⟪η, universalBidualExtension A p (universalBidualExtension A q ξ)⟫_ℂ := by
      rw [ContinuousLinearMap.star_eq_adjoint]
      exact ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_left (universalBidualExtension A p)
        (universalBidualExtension A q ξ) η
    _ = ⟪η, (universalBidualExtension A p * universalBidualExtension A q) ξ⟫_ℂ := by
      rw [mul_apply_eq_comp]

/-- The original intrinsic A* involution interchanges the two actual vector coefficients. -/
@[simp]
theorem universalStateGNSCoefficient_star (ξ η : UniversalStateGNSpace A) :
    star (universalStateGNSCoefficient A ξ η) = universalStateGNSCoefficient A η ξ := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro a
  rw [StrongDual.star_apply, universalStateGNSCoefficient_apply,
    universalStateGNSCoefficient_apply, map_star, ContinuousLinearMap.star_eq_adjoint,
    ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_right]
  simpa only [RCLike.star_def] using
    (inner_conj_symm ξ (universalStateGNSRepresentation A a η))

/-- The literal original bidual involution maps to the original Hilbert-operator adjoint. -/
theorem universalBidualExtension_star (p : StrongDual ℂ (StrongDual ℂ A)) :
    universalBidualExtension A (star p) = star (universalBidualExtension A p) := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro ξ
  apply ext_inner_left ℂ
  intro η
  rw [universalBidualExtension_inner, StrongDual.star_bidual_apply,
    universalStateGNSCoefficient_star, ← universalBidualExtension_inner A p η ξ,
    ContinuousLinearMap.star_eq_adjoint, ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_right]
  simpa only [RCLike.star_def] using
    (inner_conj_symm (universalBidualExtension A p η) ξ)

end CStarAlgebra

/-!
# The actual concrete envelope of the all-state GNS representation

Use the already constructed original all-normalized-state Hilbert sum and
its original coordinate representation. The stock generatedBy construction
gives its actual concrete von Neumann algebra and includes every coefficient.
No faithful representation or source theorem output is an input.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

noncomputable section

namespace CStarAlgebra

universe uA

variable (A : Type uA) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]

/-- The actual concrete VN algebra generated by the fixed original all-state representation. -/
def universalStateEnvelopingAlgebra : VonNeumannAlgebra (UniversalStateGNSpace A) :=
  VonNeumannAlgebra.generatedBy (Set.range (universalStateGNSRepresentation A))

/-- Every original coefficient belongs to its actual generated envelope. -/
theorem universalStateGNSRepresentation_mem_envelope (a : A) :
    universalStateGNSRepresentation A a ∈ universalStateEnvelopingAlgebra A :=
  VonNeumannAlgebra.subset_generatedBy (Set.range (universalStateGNSRepresentation A)) ⟨a, rfl⟩

/-- The actual source coefficient homomorphism into the fixed generated VN carrier. -/
def toUniversalStateEnvelopingAlgebra : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] (universalStateEnvelopingAlgebra A) :=
  (universalStateGNSRepresentation A).codRestrict
    (universalStateEnvelopingAlgebra A).toStarSubalgebra.toNonUnitalStarSubalgebra
    (universalStateGNSRepresentation_mem_envelope A)

/-- The original inclusion of the concrete envelope into its original bounded operators. -/
def universalStateEnvelopingInclusion : (universalStateEnvelopingAlgebra A) →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ]
    (UniversalStateGNSpace A →L[ℂ] UniversalStateGNSpace A) :=
  NonUnitalStarSubalgebraClass.subtype
    (universalStateEnvelopingAlgebra A).toStarSubalgebra.toNonUnitalStarSubalgebra

/-- The original coefficient value is unchanged by the actual envelope codomain restriction. -/
@[simp]
theorem universalStateEnvelopingInclusion_apply (a : A) :
    universalStateEnvelopingInclusion A (toUniversalStateEnvelopingAlgebra A a) =
      universalStateGNSRepresentation A a := rfl

/-- The actual generated carrier is closed in the original weak operator topology. -/
theorem universalStateEnvelopingAlgebra_isClosedWOT :
    IsClosed {T : UniversalStateGNSpace A →WOT[ℂ] UniversalStateGNSpace A |
      T.toCLM ∈ universalStateEnvelopingAlgebra A} :=
  VonNeumannAlgebra.generatedBy_isClosedWOT (Set.range (universalStateGNSRepresentation A))

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Weight
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.Ultraweak
public import Mathlib.Order.Bounds.Basic
public import Mathlib.Order.Directed

/-!
# Faithful, normal and semifinite weights on the original concrete algebra

A global scalar weight is an additive, positively homogeneous map from
the original positive cone to extended nonnegative real numbers.
The existing `ScalarWeight.Weight` supplies exactly those values and laws.

Normality below preserves actual least upper bounds of every nonempty,
norm-bounded directed positive set. This expresses the source relation
without choosing a supremum from a theorem. Semifiniteness is totality of
the literal finite-positive set for the proved concrete ultraweak topology:
its complex linear span is ultraweak dense. Faithfulness is the zero-value
condition on every original positive element.

No finite-square domain replaces the finite-positive set. The carrier
contains no modular action, chosen supremum, predual or representation.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open scoped NNReal ENNReal

namespace VonNeumannAlgebra

noncomputable section

universe u

variable {H : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

attribute [local instance] CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing

/-- A faithful weight vanishes only at zero in the original positive cone. -/
def IsFaithfulWeight (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (φ : CStarAlgebra.ScalarWeight.Weight M) : Prop :=
  ∀ a : CStarAlgebra.ScalarWeight.PositiveElement M, φ.value a = 0 → (a : M) = 0

/-- Normality preserves the actual LUB of every bounded directed positive family.
Directed subsets cover ranges of families indexed in any universe. -/
def IsNormalWeight (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (φ : CStarAlgebra.ScalarWeight.Weight M) : Prop :=
  ∀ S : Set (CStarAlgebra.ScalarWeight.PositiveElement M), S.Nonempty →
    DirectedOn (fun a b : CStarAlgebra.ScalarWeight.PositiveElement M => (a : M) ≤ (b : M)) S →
    (∃ C : ℝ, ∀ a ∈ S, ‖(a : M)‖ ≤ C) →
    ∀ s : CStarAlgebra.ScalarWeight.PositiveElement M,
      IsLUB ((fun a : CStarAlgebra.ScalarWeight.PositiveElement M => (a : M)) '' S) (s : M) →
      IsLUB (φ.value '' S) (φ.value s)

/-- Semifiniteness is ultraweak totality of the literal finite-positive set.
The span and the identity into the ultraweak view are the existing actual objects. -/
def IsSemifiniteWeight (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (φ : CStarAlgebra.ScalarWeight.Weight M) : Prop :=
  Dense ((φ.finiteIntegrationDomain.map (ultraweakLinearEquiv M).symm.toLinearMap :
    Submodule ℂ (Ultraweak M)) : Set (Ultraweak M))

/-- Faithful normal semifinite weights retain the same original global scalar weight. -/
abbrev NormalSemifiniteFaithfulWeight (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) : Type u :=
  {φ : CStarAlgebra.ScalarWeight.Weight M //
    IsNormalWeight M φ ∧ IsSemifiniteWeight M φ ∧ IsFaithfulWeight M φ}

end

end VonNeumannAlgebra

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Weight.PositiveCompression
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Weight.GNSPositiveFunctional
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.Weight
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.PositiveLUBLimit
public import Mathlib.Topology.Order.MonotoneConvergence
public import Mathlib.Topology.Instances.ENNReal.Lemmas

/-!
# Original normal-weight values make the same GNS diagonal coefficient order normal

Original finite-square elements have finite positive compressed weight
values, by the original conjugation norm bound and scalar-weight monotonicity.
Normality of the same global weight applies to the literal compressed
positive family and its proved original LUB. Finite values and the actual
positive coefficient identity give preservation of the real diagonal LUB.

The bounded coefficient is the existing positive continuous linear map.
No normal-predual membership or selected representation model is an input.
That membership criterion and the computed GNS normal homomorphism remain
separate, as do full scalar extension and Tomita/modular/polar constructors.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open Filter Set CStarAlgebra.ScalarWeight
open scoped Topology

noncomputable section

namespace VonNeumannAlgebra

universe u v

variable {H : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
variable {I : Type v} [Preorder I] [IsDirectedOrder I] [Nonempty I]

/-- A normal scalar weight makes its actual positive diagonal coefficient preserve positive LUBs. -/
theorem gnsDiagonalPositiveFunctional_preserves_boundedPositiveIsLUB
    (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (φ : Weight M) (hφ : IsNormalWeight M φ)
    (x : φ.finiteSquareSubmodule) (a : I → PositiveElement M) (s : PositiveElement M)
    (hmono : @Monotone I M inferInstance (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toPreorder (fun i => (a i : M)))
    (hbound : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ i, ‖(a i : M)‖ ≤ C)
    (hLUB : @IsLUB M (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE (Set.range fun i => (a i : M)) (s : M)) :
    IsLUB (Set.range fun i => (φ.gnsDiagonalPositiveFunctional x (a i : M)).re)
      (φ.gnsDiagonalPositiveFunctional x (s : M)).re := by
  let : PartialOrder M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M
  let : LE M := (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE
  let : StarOrderedRing M := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing M
  let : PartialOrder ℂ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder ℂ
  let : PartialOrder (H →L[ℂ] H) := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder (H →L[ℂ] H)
  let : StarOrderedRing (H →L[ℂ] H) := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing (H →L[ℂ] H)
  let ι : M →⋆ₐ[ℂ] (H →L[ℂ] H) := M.toStarSubalgebra.subtype
  let operatorLE : LE M :=
    ⟨fun p q : M => @LE.le (H →L[ℂ] H) (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder (H →L[ℂ] H)).toLE
      (p : H →L[ℂ] H) (q : H →L[ℂ] H)⟩
  have horders (p q : M) : @LE.le M (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE p q ↔
      @LE.le M operatorLE p q := by
    exact (NonUnitalStarAlgHom.map_le_map_iff (A := M) (B := H →L[ℂ] H)
      ι Subtype.val_injective).symm
  let b : I → PositiveElement M := fun i =>
    ⟨star (x : M) * (a i : M) * (x : M), star_left_conjugate_nonneg (a i).property (x : M)⟩
  let t : PositiveElement M :=
    ⟨star (x : M) * (s : M) * (x : M), star_left_conjugate_nonneg s.property (x : M)⟩
  have hmonoB : @Monotone I M inferInstance (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toPreorder
      (fun i => (b i : M)) := by
    intro i j hij
    exact star_left_conjugate_le_conjugate (hmono hij) (x : M)
  have hdir : DirectedOn (fun p q : PositiveElement M =>
      @LE.le M (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE (p : M) (q : M)) (Set.range b) := by
    rintro p ⟨i, rfl⟩ q ⟨j, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨k, hik, hjk⟩ := exists_ge_ge i j
    exact ⟨b k, Set.mem_range_self k, hmonoB hik, hmonoB hjk⟩
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hbound
  have hboundB : ∃ D : ℝ, ∀ p ∈ Set.range b, ‖(p : M)‖ ≤ D := by
    refine ⟨‖(x : M)‖ * C * ‖(x : M)‖, ?_⟩
    rintro p ⟨i, rfl⟩
    change ‖star (x : M) * (a i : M) * (x : M)‖ ≤ ‖(x : M)‖ * C * ‖(x : M)‖
    calc
      _ ≤ (‖star (x : M)‖ * ‖(a i : M)‖) * ‖(x : M)‖ :=
        (norm_mul_le _ _).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (norm_mul_le _ _) (norm_nonneg _))
      _ ≤ ‖(x : M)‖ * C * ‖(x : M)‖ := by
        rw [norm_star]
        gcongr
        exact hC i
  have hconjugate := starConjugation_preserves_boundedPositiveIsLUB M (x : M)
    (fun i => (a i : M)) (s : M) hmono (fun i => (a i).property) ⟨C, hC⟩ hLUB
  have himage : ((fun p : PositiveElement M => (p : M)) '' Set.range b) =
      Set.range (fun i => (b i : M)) := by
    ext y
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨p, ⟨i, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      exact Set.mem_range_self i
    · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨b i, Set.mem_range_self i, rfl⟩
  have hLUBB : @IsLUB M (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder M).toLE
      ((fun p : PositiveElement M => (p : M)) '' Set.range b) (t : M) := by
    rw [himage]
    exact hconjugate
  have hdirOperator : DirectedOn (fun p q : PositiveElement M =>
      @LE.le M operatorLE (p : M) (q : M)) (Set.range b) := by
    intro p hp q hq
    obtain ⟨r, hr, hpr, hqr⟩ := hdir p hp q hq
    exact ⟨r, hr, (horders (p : M) (r : M)).mp hpr, (horders (q : M) (r : M)).mp hqr⟩
  have hLUBOperator : @IsLUB M operatorLE
      ((fun p : PositiveElement M => (p : M)) '' Set.range b) (t : M) := by
    constructor
    · intro p hp
      exact (horders p (t : M)).mp (hLUBB.1 hp)
    · intro q hq
      apply (horders (t : M) q).mp
      apply hLUBB.2
      intro p hp
      exact (horders p q).mpr (hq hp)
  have hnormal := hφ (Set.range b) (Set.range_nonempty b)
    hdirOperator hboundB t hLUBOperator
  have hvalueImage : (φ.value '' Set.range b) = Set.range (fun i => φ.value (b i)) := by
    ext y
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨p, ⟨i, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      exact Set.mem_range_self i
    · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨b i, Set.mem_range_self i, rfl⟩
  have hvalueLUB : IsLUB (Set.range fun i => φ.value (b i)) (φ.value t) := by
    rw [← hvalueImage]
    exact hnormal
  have hmonoValue : Monotone (fun i => φ.value (b i)) := by
    intro i j hij
    exact φ.value_mono (b i) (b j) (hmonoB hij)
  have htFinite : φ.value t ≠ ⊤ := (φ.value_positiveConjugate_lt_top x s).ne
  have hvalueLimit := tendsto_atTop_isLUB hmonoValue hvalueLUB
  have hrealLimit : Tendsto (fun i => (φ.value (b i)).toReal) atTop
      (𝓝 (φ.value t).toReal) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def] using (ENNReal.tendsto_toReal htFinite).comp hvalueLimit
  have hrealUpper : ∀ i, (φ.value (b i)).toReal ≤ (φ.value t).toReal := fun i =>
    ENNReal.toReal_mono htFinite (hvalueLUB.1 (Set.mem_range_self i))
  have hrealLUB : IsLUB (Set.range fun i => (φ.value (b i)).toReal) (φ.value t).toReal :=
    IsLUB.range_of_tendsto hrealUpper hrealLimit
  have hcoefficient (p : PositiveElement M) :
      (φ.gnsDiagonalPositiveFunctional x (p : M)).re =
        (φ.value ⟨star (x : M) * (p : M) * (x : M),
          star_left_conjugate_nonneg p.property (x : M)⟩).toReal := by
    change ((φ.gnsDiagonalPositiveFunctional x).toContinuousLinearMap (p : M)).re = _
    rw [φ.gnsDiagonalPositiveFunctional_toContinuousLinearMap,
      φ.gnsCoefficient_positive_value (p : M) p.property x]
    simp only [RCLike.ofReal_eq_complex_ofReal, Complex.ofReal_re]
  have hfunction : (fun i => (φ.gnsDiagonalPositiveFunctional x (a i : M)).re) =
      (fun i => (φ.value (b i)).toReal) := by
    funext i
    exact hcoefficient (a i)
  have hpoint : (φ.gnsDiagonalPositiveFunctional x (s : M)).re = (φ.value t).toReal :=
    hcoefficient s
  rw [hfunction, hpoint]
  exact hrealLUB

end VonNeumannAlgebra

end

The original finite-positive integration span lies in the exact
finite-square module by the neutral scalar-weight compression APIs.
Source semifiniteness transfers its actual ultraweak density to that same

@[expose] public section

/-- Source finite-positive-span semifiniteness gives density of the actual original square module. -/
theorem weightFiniteSquareUltraweakDense (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H)

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.Weight.GNSNormalHom
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.Weight.GNSInjective
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.NormalHom.ImageEquiv

/-!
# The original NSF weight's actual normal GNS image and equivalence

The original normal GNS map has the same computed coefficient operators.
Source semifiniteness and faithfulness prove its injectivity. The generic
proved image construction and bilateral normal equivalence then give its
literal von Neumann operator range and actual normal equivalence. Every
operator value is the original weight GNS value; no alternate Hilbert
model, range, inverse or source existence output is selected.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

namespace VonNeumannAlgebra

noncomputable section

universe u

variable {H : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

/-- Original semifiniteness and faithfulness give injectivity of the same computed normal GNS map. -/
theorem normalSemifiniteFaithfulWeightGNSStarAlgHom_injective
    (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (φ : NormalSemifiniteFaithfulWeight M) :
    Function.Injective (normalWeightGNSStarAlgHom M φ.val φ.property.1) := by
  intro a b h
  apply φ.val.gnsLeftStarAlgHom_injective M φ.property.2.1 φ.property.2.2
  have hvalue := congrArg
    (fun T : (⊤ : VonNeumannAlgebra φ.val.GNS) => (T : φ.val.GNS →L[ℂ] φ.val.GNS)) h
  rw [normalWeightGNSStarAlgHom_apply, normalWeightGNSStarAlgHom_apply] at hvalue
  exact hvalue

/-- The original NSF weight's computed GNS representation has its literal VN operator image. -/
def normalSemifiniteFaithfulWeightGNSImage
    (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (φ : NormalSemifiniteFaithfulWeight M) : VonNeumannAlgebra φ.val.GNS :=
  (normalWeightGNSStarAlgHom M φ.val φ.property.1).imageVonNeumannAlgebra
    (normalSemifiniteFaithfulWeightGNSStarAlgHom_injective M φ)

/-- The actual normal equivalence identifies the original algebra with its literal computed GNS image. -/
def normalSemifiniteFaithfulWeightGNSImageEquiv
    (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (φ : NormalSemifiniteFaithfulWeight M) :
    NormalStarAlgEquiv M (normalSemifiniteFaithfulWeightGNSImage M φ) :=
  (normalWeightGNSStarAlgHom M φ.val φ.property.1).imageEquiv
    (normalSemifiniteFaithfulWeightGNSStarAlgHom_injective M φ)

/-- The actual NSF GNS image carrier consists exactly of the original computed GNS operators. -/
theorem coe_normalSemifiniteFaithfulWeightGNSImage
    (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (φ : NormalSemifiniteFaithfulWeight M) :
    (normalSemifiniteFaithfulWeightGNSImage M φ : Set (φ.val.GNS →L[ℂ] φ.val.GNS)) =
      Set.range φ.val.gnsLeftStarAlgHom := by
  let f := normalWeightGNSStarAlgHom M φ.val φ.property.1
  change (f.imageVonNeumannAlgebra (normalSemifiniteFaithfulWeightGNSStarAlgHom_injective M φ) :
    Set (φ.val.GNS →L[ℂ] φ.val.GNS)) = Set.range φ.val.gnsLeftStarAlgHom
  rw [f.coe_imageVonNeumannAlgebra]
  simp only [f, normalWeightGNSStarAlgHom_apply]

/-- The actual normal NSF GNS equivalence keeps every original computed coefficient operator. -/
theorem normalSemifiniteFaithfulWeightGNSImageEquiv_apply
    (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (φ : NormalSemifiniteFaithfulWeight M) (a : M) :
    (normalSemifiniteFaithfulWeightGNSImageEquiv M φ a : φ.val.GNS →L[ℂ] φ.val.GNS) =
      φ.val.gnsLeftStarAlgHom a := by
  let f := normalWeightGNSStarAlgHom M φ.val φ.property.1
  have h := f.imageEquiv_apply (normalSemifiniteFaithfulWeightGNSStarAlgHom_injective M φ) a
  exact h.trans (normalWeightGNSStarAlgHom_apply M φ.val φ.property.1 a)

end

end VonNeumannAlgebra

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.MultiplicationPredual
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.Weight.GNSFaithfulDomain
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Weight.GNSLeftUnital

/-!
# The actual source-faithful semifinite GNS coefficient map is injective

A zero coefficient operator annihilates the actual dense-domain map.
Original weight faithfulness makes that map injective, hence original
left multiplication annihilates the literal finite-square domain.
Source semifiniteness supplies that domain's actual ultraweak density,
and proved fixed-left ultraweak continuity extends the annihilation to
the original algebra. Original multiplication by one gives zero coefficient.

These proofs supply the actual representation-injectivity prerequisite
for the faithful normal-range constructor. No source existence, range or
normality output and no extra density/model certificate is selected.
Representation normality, full scalar extension and Tomita/modular/polar
objects remain separate; original source theorem proofs stay wholly open.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

namespace CStarAlgebra.ScalarWeight

noncomputable section

universe u

variable {H : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

/-- A zero actual source-faithful semifinite coefficient operator has zero original coefficient. -/
theorem Weight.gnsLeftStarAlgHom_eq_zero_implies (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (φ : Weight M)
    (hsem : VonNeumannAlgebra.IsSemifiniteWeight M φ)
    (hfaith : VonNeumannAlgebra.IsFaithfulWeight M φ) (a : M)
    (ha : φ.gnsLeftStarAlgHom a = 0) : a = 0 := by
  have hann : ∀ x : φ.finiteSquareSubmodule, a * (x : M) = 0 := by
    intro x
    have hmap : φ.gnsMap (φ.finiteSquareLeftMul a x) = φ.gnsMap 0 := by
      rw [map_zero]
      calc
        φ.gnsMap (φ.finiteSquareLeftMul a x) = φ.gnsLeftStarAlgHom a (φ.gnsMap x) :=
          (φ.gnsLeftStarAlgHom_gnsMap a x).symm
        _ = 0 := by rw [ha]; rfl
    have hzero : φ.finiteSquareLeftMul a x = 0 := φ.gnsMap_injective hfaith hmap
    have hvalue := congrArg (fun y : φ.finiteSquareSubmodule => (y : M)) hzero
    change a * (x : M) = 0 at hvalue
    exact hvalue
  let f : VonNeumannAlgebra.Ultraweak M → VonNeumannAlgebra.Ultraweak M :=
    fun z => (VonNeumannAlgebra.ultraweakLinearEquiv M).symm
      (a * VonNeumannAlgebra.ultraweakLinearEquiv M z)
  have hcontinuous : Continuous f := VonNeumannAlgebra.ultraweak_left_mul_continuous M a
  have hclosed : IsClosed {z | f z = 0} := isClosed_eq hcontinuous continuous_const
  have hdense := VonNeumannAlgebra.weightFiniteSquareUltraweakDense M φ hsem
  have hsubset :
      (φ.finiteSquareSubmodule.map (VonNeumannAlgebra.ultraweakLinearEquiv M).symm.toLinearMap :
        Set (VonNeumannAlgebra.Ultraweak M)) ⊆ {z | f z = 0} := by
    change (VonNeumannAlgebra.ultraweakLinearEquiv M).symm '' (φ.finiteSquareSubmodule : Set M) ⊆ _
    rintro z ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    have hxzero : a * x = 0 := hann ⟨x, hx⟩
    change (VonNeumannAlgebra.ultraweakLinearEquiv M).symm
      (a * VonNeumannAlgebra.ultraweakLinearEquiv M
        ((VonNeumannAlgebra.ultraweakLinearEquiv M).symm x)) = 0
    rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, hxzero, map_zero]
  have hall : ∀ z, f z = 0 := fun z => (closure_minimal hsubset hclosed) (hdense z)
  have hone := hall ((VonNeumannAlgebra.ultraweakLinearEquiv M).symm (1 : M))
  have horiginal := congrArg (VonNeumannAlgebra.ultraweakLinearEquiv M) hone
  change a * VonNeumannAlgebra.ultraweakLinearEquiv M
    ((VonNeumannAlgebra.ultraweakLinearEquiv M).symm (1 : M)) =
      VonNeumannAlgebra.ultraweakLinearEquiv M (0 : VonNeumannAlgebra.Ultraweak M) at horiginal
  rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, mul_one, map_zero] at horiginal
  exact horiginal

/-- Source semifiniteness and original weight faithfulness make the computed coefficient map injective. -/
theorem Weight.gnsLeftStarAlgHom_injective (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (φ : Weight M)
    (hsem : VonNeumannAlgebra.IsSemifiniteWeight M φ)
    (hfaith : VonNeumannAlgebra.IsFaithfulWeight M φ) : Function.Injective φ.gnsLeftStarAlgHom := by
  intro a b hab
  have hzero : φ.gnsLeftStarAlgHom (a - b) = 0 := by
    rw [map_sub, hab, sub_self]
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp (φ.gnsLeftStarAlgHom_eq_zero_implies M hsem hfaith (a - b) hzero)

end

end CStarAlgebra.ScalarWeight

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.Weight.GNSNormalOffDiagonalFunctional
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.RepresentationCoefficientContinuity
public import Mathlib.Topology.DenseEmbedding

/-!
# All original GNS vector coefficients of a normal weight are normal functionals

The actual original-domain GNS map is dense in its constructed Hilbert
completion. Its finite-square off-diagonal coefficients are already actual
normal-functional members. Original coefficient continuity in each vector
makes membership a closed property. Two dense-range extensions therefore
give normal membership for every pair of original completed GNS vectors.
No density, normality, GNS model or coefficient-bound certificate is input.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open CStarAlgebra.ScalarWeight
open MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra

namespace VonNeumannAlgebra

noncomputable section

universe u

variable {H : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

/-- Original normal weight gives actual normal-functional membership for all completed GNS vector coefficients. -/
theorem normalWeightGNSCoefficient_mem (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (φ : Weight M)
    (hφ : IsNormalWeight M φ) (g h : φ.GNS) :
    representationCoefficient φ.gnsLeftStarAlgHom g h ∈ normalFunctionalSpace M := by
  have hdense := φ.gnsMap_denseRange
  have hclosed := normalFunctionalSpace_isClosed M
  have hdomain (x : φ.finiteSquareSubmodule) (h : φ.GNS) :
      representationCoefficient φ.gnsLeftStarAlgHom (φ.gnsMap x) h ∈ normalFunctionalSpace M := by
    refine hdense.induction_on
      (p := fun h : φ.GNS => representationCoefficient φ.gnsLeftStarAlgHom (φ.gnsMap x) h ∈
        normalFunctionalSpace M) h ?_ ?_
    · exact hclosed.preimage (representationCoefficient_continuous_right φ.gnsLeftStarAlgHom (φ.gnsMap x))
    · intro y
      let ρ := normalWeightGNSOffDiagonalFunctional M φ hφ x y
      rw [← ρ.property]
      exact ρ.val.property
  refine hdense.induction_on
    (p := fun g : φ.GNS => representationCoefficient φ.gnsLeftStarAlgHom g h ∈
      normalFunctionalSpace M) g ?_ ?_
  · exact hclosed.preimage (representationCoefficient_continuous_left φ.gnsLeftStarAlgHom h)
  · intro x
    exact hdomain x h

end

end VonNeumannAlgebra
